=== FILE: app/src/debug/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/ReleaseUpdateChecker.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.Firebase
import com.google.firebase.appdistribution.appDistribution

object ReleaseUpdateChecker {
    fun checkForUpdates() {
        try {
            Firebase.appDistribution.updateIfNewReleaseAvailable()
                .addOnSuccessListener {
                    Log.d("SahabApp", "Firebase App Distribution update check completed")
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { e ->
                    Log.w("SahabApp", "Firebase App Distribution update check failed: ${e.message}")
                }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w("SahabApp", "Unable to check for App Distribution updates", e)
        }
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab

import android.app.PictureInPictureParams
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Rational
import com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.player.SahabMediaSessionBridge
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.activity.enableEdgeToEdge
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.collectAsState
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.core.splashscreen.SplashScreen.Companion.installSplashScreen
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.AppRoot
import com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.LocalContainer
import com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.LocalIsTv
import com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.theme.SahabTheme
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ThemePreferences
import com.saydlawy.sahab.util.isTelevision
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private var isAppReady by mutableStateOf(false)

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        val splashScreen = installSplashScreen()
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        splashScreen.setKeepOnScreenCondition { !isAppReady }

        // سقف أمان 3 ثوانٍ لإزالة شاشة البداية حتى لا يُحجب الإقلاع إذا تأخر التحميل الأولي
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            delay(3_000L)
            isAppReady = true
        }

        enableEdgeToEdge(
            statusBarStyle = androidx.activity.SystemBarStyle.dark(android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT),
            navigationBarStyle = androidx.activity.SystemBarStyle.dark(android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT),
        )
        androidx.core.view.WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, window.decorView).apply {
            isAppearanceLightStatusBars = false
            isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = false
        }
        hideSystemBarsNow()
        val container = (application as SahabApp).container
        val tv = isTelevision(this)

        setContent {
            val themeSettings by container.prefs.themePreferences.collectAsState(initial = ThemePreferences())
            SahabTheme(settings = themeSettings) {
                LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
                    delay(3000L)
                    checkForUpdates()
                }
                CompositionLocalProvider(
                    LocalContainer provides container,
                    LocalIsTv provides tv,
                ) {
                    AppRoot(container = container, onReady = { isAppReady = true })
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun hideSystemBarsNow() {
        androidx.core.view.WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, window.decorView).apply {
            systemBarsBehavior = androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
            hide(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
        }
    }

    override fun dispatchTouchEvent(ev: android.view.MotionEvent?): Boolean {
        if (ev != null && !isTelevision(this)) {
            val action = ev.actionMasked
            if (action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN || action == android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN) {
                hideSystemBarsNow()
            }
        }
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev)
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemBarsNow()
        }
    }

    private fun checkForUpdates() {
        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
            ReleaseUpdateChecker.checkForUpdates()
        }
    }

    override fun onUserLeaveHint() {
        super.onUserLeaveHint()
        if (!isTelevision(this) &&
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O &&
            SahabMediaSessionBridge.pipAllowed &&
            packageManager.hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_PICTURE_IN_PICTURE)
        ) {
            runCatching {
                enterPictureInPictureMode(
                    PictureInPictureParams.Builder()
                        .setAspectRatio(Rational(16, 9))
                        .build(),
                )
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onPictureInPictureModeChanged(
        isInPictureInPictureMode: Boolean,
        newConfig: Configuration,
    ) {
        super.onPictureInPictureModeChanged(isInPictureInPictureMode, newConfig)
        SahabMediaSessionBridge.inPipMode.value = isInPictureInPictureMode
    }

    override fun onStop() {
        super.onStop()
        (application as? SahabApp)?.container?.flushRecents()
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab

import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.util.Log
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessagingService
import com.google.firebase.messaging.RemoteMessage
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.UserSyncService
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class MyFirebaseMessagingService : FirebaseMessagingService() {

    private val serviceScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)

    override fun onNewToken(token: [REDACTED]
        super.onNewToken(token)
        savePendingToken(this, token)
        if (FirebaseAuth.getInstance().currentUser != null) {
            serviceScope.launch {
                val syncService = (applicationContext as? SahabApp)?.container?.userSyncService ?: UserSyncService()
                runCatching { syncService.saveFcmToken(token) }
                    .onSuccess { Log.d("SahabFcm", "FCM token synced to Firestore") }
                    .onFailure { Log.w("SahabFcm", "Failed to sync FCM token: [REDACTED]
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onMessageReceived(remoteMessage: RemoteMessage) {
        super.onMessageReceived(remoteMessage)
        val data = remoteMessage.data
        val title = data["title"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: remoteMessage.notification?.title?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: "سحاب"
        val body = data["body"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: data["message"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: remoteMessage.notification?.body?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: "لديك تحديث جديد"
        showNotification(title, body)
    }

    private fun showNotification(title: String, body: String) {
        val channelId = CHANNEL_ID
        val notificationManager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                channelId,
                "إشعارات سحاب",
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH
            ).apply {
                description = "تنبيهات الأفلام والمباريات والتحديثات من سحاب"
            }
            notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }

        val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP
        }
        val requestCode = (System.currentTimeMillis() and 0x7FFFFFFF).toInt()
        val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            requestCode,
            intent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_ONE_SHOT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )

        val notificationBuilder = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, channelId)
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_stat_notification)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(body)
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(body))
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH)

        val notificationId = (System.currentTimeMillis() and 0x7FFFFFFF).toInt()
        notificationManager.notify(notificationId, notificationBuilder.build())
    }

    companion object {
        private const val CHANNEL_ID = "sahab_notifications"
        private const val FCM_PREFS = "sahab_fcm_prefs"
        private const val KEY_FCM_TOKEN = [REDACTED]

        fun savePendingToken(context: [REDACTED]
            if (token.isBlank()) return
            context.applicationContext
                .getSharedPreferences(FCM_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .putString(KEY_FCM_TOKEN, token)
                .apply()
        }

        fun getSavedToken(context: Context): String? = [REDACTED]
            context.applicationContext
                .getSharedPreferences(FCM_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString(KEY_FCM_TOKEN, null)
    }
}

class AppContainer(context: Context) {

    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    val prefs = Prefs(context)
    val diskCache = DiskCache(context)
    val gemini by lazy { com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiStoryService(client) }
    val aiKeys by lazy { com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.ApiKeyManager(context.applicationContext) }
    val catalogDb by lazy { CatalogDatabase.getInstance(context.applicationContext) }
    val catalogSync by lazy { CatalogSync(catalogDb.movieDao(), firebaseCatalog) }
    val channelDb by lazy { ChannelDatabase.getInstance(context.applicationContext) }
    val channelSync by lazy { ChannelSync(channelDb.channelDao()) }
    val epgSync by lazy { EpgSync(channelDb.channelDao()) }
    val firebaseCatalog by lazy { com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.FirebaseCatalogService() }
    val authManager by lazy { com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.AuthManager() }
    val userSyncService by lazy {
        com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.UserSyncService { prefs.getCloudSyncPin() }
    }
    val weather by lazy { com.saydlawy.sahab.data.weather.WeatherService(client, context.applicationContext) }

    val client: OkHttpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .cache(Cache(File(context.applicationContext.cacheDir, "http_cache"), 50L * 1024L * 1024L))
        .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(45, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .addInterceptor(CleartextGuardInterceptor())
        .addInterceptor { chain ->
            chain.proceed(chain.request().newBuilder().header("User-Agent", USER_AGENT).build())
        }
        .addInterceptor(RetryInterceptor())
        .build()

    val tmdb = [REDACTED]
    val repo = Repository(XtreamApi(client), tmdb, diskCache, prefs, channelDao = channelDb.channelDao(), okHttpClient = client)

    /** Outlives screens, so progress can still be saved while the player is closing. */
    val appScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)

    /** What the player screen should play; set right before navigating to it. */
    @Volatile
    var playback: PlayRequest? = null

    private val pendingPlaybackLock = Any()
    private val pendingPlaybackFile by lazy { File(appContext.filesDir, "pending_playback.json") }
    private val playbackJson by lazy {
        kotlinx.serialization.json.Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; encodeDefaults = true }
    }

    /** M-18: Persist a bounded window around [request.startIndex] so Process Death on PlayerScreen recovers cleanly. */
    fun savePendingPlayback(request: PlayRequest) {
        val safeIdx = request.startIndex.coerceIn(0, (request.items.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
        val windowStart = (safeIdx - 40).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val windowEnd = (safeIdx + 41).coerceAtMost(request.items.size)
        val bounded = if (request.items.size > 81) {
            request.copy(
                items = request.items.subList(windowStart, windowEnd),
                startIndex = safeIdx - windowStart,
            )
        } else {
            request
        }
        val payload = playbackJson.encodeToString(PlayRequest.serializer(), bounded)
        appScope.launch {
            runCatching {
                synchronized(pendingPlaybackLock) {
                    val tmpFile = File(pendingPlaybackFile.parentFile, "pending_playback.json.tmp")
                    tmpFile.writeText(payload)
                    if (!tmpFile.renameTo(pendingPlaybackFile)) {
                        pendingPlaybackFile.writeText(payload)
                        tmpFile.delete()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun restorePendingPlayback(): PlayRequest? = runCatching {
        synchronized(pendingPlaybackLock) {
            if (!pendingPlaybackFile.exists()) return null
            playbackJson.decodeFromString(PlayRequest.serializer(), pendingPlaybackFile.readText())
                .also { playback = it }
        }
    }.getOrNull()

    fun clearPendingPlayback() {
        playback = null
        appScope.launch {
            runCatching {
                synchronized(pendingPlaybackLock) {
                    pendingPlaybackFile.delete()
                    File(pendingPlaybackFile.parentFile, "pending_playback.json.tmp").delete()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Short stable hash of (id + server + user + type). Used to isolate the video cache per account
     *  without exposing credentials. Returns "anon" before login. */
    val accountHash: String
        get() {
            val a = repo.account ?: return "anon"
            val identity = if (a.type == "M3U") "${a.id}|m3u|${a.m3uUrl}" else "${a.id}|${a.server}|${a.user}"
            val bytes = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                .digest(identity.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            return bytes.take(4).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
        }

    val mergeCoordinator = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.CloudMergeCoordinator()
    val syncCoordinator by lazy { com.saydlawy.sahab.data.SyncCoordinator(this) }

    val favoritesMergeDone: Boolean
        get() = mergeCoordinator.favoritesMergeDone

    val recentsMergeDone: Boolean
        get() = mergeCoordinator.recentsMergeDone

    val prefsMergeDone: Boolean
        get() = mergeCoordinator.prefsMergeDone

    private val recentsFlushTrigger = MutableSharedFlow<Unit>(extraBufferCapacity = 1)

    @Volatile
    private var lastUploadedRecents: List<RecentItem>? = null

    @Volatile
    private var lastUploadedFavorites: List<com.saydlawy.sahab.data.FavItem>? = null

    @Volatile
    private var lastUploadedPreferences: CloudPreferences? = null

    private suspend fun uploadRecentsIfNeeded(recents: List<RecentItem>) {
        if (!recentsMergeDone || authManager.currentUser == null) return
        if (recents == lastUploadedRecents) return
        android.util.Log.d("SahabSync", "saveRecents: count=${recents.size}")
        userSyncService.saveRecents(recents)
        lastUploadedRecents = recents
    }

    /** يُستدعى عند خروج المشغل أو الإيقاف المؤقت أو الانتقال للخلفية لرفع أحدث موضع فوراً. */
    fun flushRecents() {
        recentsFlushTrigger.tryEmit(Unit)
    }

    @OptIn(FlowPreview::class)
    fun startAutoSync() {
        appScope.launch {
            // مزامنة المفضلة بعد توقف المستخدم عن التفاعل لمدة ثانيتين (فقط بعد نجاح الدمج الأولي)
            prefs.favorites.distinctUntilChanged().drop(1).debounce(2000L).collect { favs ->
                if (favoritesMergeDone && authManager.currentUser != null && favs != lastUploadedFavorites) {
                    userSyncService.saveFavorites(favs)
                    lastUploadedFavorites = favs
                }
            }
        }
        appScope.launch {
            // خنق رفع سجل المشاهدة أثناء التشغيل المستمر إلى مرة واحدة كل 3 دقائق (180 ثانية)
            prefs.recents.distinctUntilChanged().drop(1).sample(180_000L).collect { recents ->
                uploadRecentsIfNeeded(recents)
            }
        }
        appScope.launch {
            // خنق طلبات الرفع عند الخروج المتكرر إلى مرة كل 15 ثانية (SAH-M04)
            recentsFlushTrigger.debounce(15_000L).collect {
                uploadRecentsIfNeeded(prefs.recents.first())
            }
        }
        appScope.launch {
            // مزامنة تفضيلات الواجهة بعد ثانيتين من التغيير (فقط بعد نجاح الدمج الأولي)
            combine(
                combine(
                    prefs.lightEffects,
                    prefs.homeChannelsLayout,
                    prefs.homeChannelsSource,
                ) { light, layout, source -> Triple(light, layout, source) },
                combine(
                    prefs.homeChannelsCategoryId,
                    prefs.moviesLayoutStyle,
                    prefs.seriesLayoutStyle,
                ) { categoryId, moviesStyle, seriesStyle -> Triple(categoryId, moviesStyle, seriesStyle) },
            ) { (light, layout, source), (categoryId, moviesStyle, seriesStyle) ->
                CloudPreferences(
                    lightEffects = light,
                    homeChannelsLayout = layout.name,
                    homeChannelsSource = source.name,
                    homeChannelsCategoryId = categoryId,
                    moviesLayoutStyle = moviesStyle.name,
                    seriesLayoutStyle = seriesStyle.name,
                )
            }.distinctUntilChanged().drop(1).debounce(2000L).collect { cloudPrefs ->
                if (prefsMergeDone && authManager.currentUser != null && cloudPrefs != lastUploadedPreferences) {
                    userSyncService.savePreferences(cloudPrefs)
                    lastUploadedPreferences = cloudPrefs
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private val _switchingAccount = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val switchingAccount: StateFlow<Boolean> = _switchingAccount

    /**
     * توحيد تنظيف البيانات المحلية (الكتالوج، القنوات، البرامج، الكاش، ومواقيت المزامنة).
     * عند [clearPrefsAccount]=true يمسح أيضاً بيانات الحساب المخزنة في Prefs ويعيد ضبط بوابات الدمج.
     */
    suspend fun clearAllLocalData(clearPrefsAccount: Boolean = false) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        repo.clearCache(clearDisk = true)
        prefs.clearSyncTimestamps()
        runCatching { channelDb.channelDao().clearAll() }
            .onFailure { android.util.Log.e("SahabClear", "Failed to clear channels: ${it.message}") }
        runCatching { channelDb.channelDao().clearAllPrograms() }
            .onFailure { android.util.Log.e("SahabClear", "Failed to clear EPG programs: ${it.message}") }
        runCatching { catalogDb.movieDao().wipe() }
            .onFailure { android.util.Log.e("SahabClear", "Failed to wipe catalog movies: ${it.message}") }
        if (clearPrefsAccount) {
            mergeCoordinator.reset()
            repo.setAccount(null)
            prefs.clearAccount()
        }
    }

    fun switchAccount(acc: Account) {
        _switchingAccount.value = true
        repo.setAccount(acc)
        appScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                // 0. إيقاف أي مزامنة جارية للحساب السابق قبل تنظيف قواعد البيانات
                syncCoordinator.stopActiveSync()

                // 1. تثبيت الحساب النشط وتنظيف كل بيانات الحساب السابق قبل المزامنة
                prefs.setActiveAccount(acc.id)
                clearAllLocalData(clearPrefsAccount = false)

                // 2. تشغيل سلسلة المزامنة الكاملة للحساب الجديد (كتالوج + أفلام + قنوات + EPG)
                syncCoordinator.runFullSync(
                    context = appContext,
                    forceCatalog = true,
                    reason = "switchAccount",
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                android.util.Log.e("SahabSwitch", "Failed to switch account: ${e.message}")
            } finally {
                _switchingAccount.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun saveProgress(item: PlayItem, positionMs: Long, durationMs: Long) {
        val live = item.kind == Kind.LIVE
        val accId = repo.account?.id ?: prefs.currentActiveAccountId()
        val recent = RecentItem(
            kind = item.kind,
            id = item.id,
            title = item.title,
            subtitle = item.subtitle,
            icon = item.icon,
            ext = item.ext,
            groupId = item.groupId,
            url = item.url,
            positionMs = if (live) 0 else positionMs.coerceAtLeast(0),
            durationMs = if (live) 0 else durationMs.coerceAtLeast(0),
            updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            accountId = accId,
        )
        appScope.launch { prefs.recordPlayback(recent) }
    }

    private class CleartextGuardInterceptor : Interceptor {
        override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
            val req = chain.request()
            if (req.url.scheme.equals("http", ignoreCase = true)) {
                val host = req.url.host.lowercase(Locale.US)
                if (STRICT_HTTPS_DOMAINS.any { host == it || host.endsWith(".$it") }) {
                    throw IOException("HTTPS required for $host")
                }
            }
            return chain.proceed(req)
        }
    }

    private class RetryInterceptor : Interceptor {
        override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
            val req = chain.request()
            val path = req.url.encodedPath
            // Never retry long-lived media streams (live/movie/series) in OkHttp; ExoPlayer handles its own recovery.
            if (path.contains("/live/") || path.contains("/movie/") || path.contains("/series/")) {
                return chain.proceed(req)
            }
            var attempt = 0
            while (true) {
                var response: Response? = null
                try {
                    response = chain.proceed(req)
                    if (response.code !in 500..599 || attempt >= RETRY_BACKOFFS_MS.size) {
                        return response
                    }
                    response.close()
                } catch (ioe: IOException) {
                    response?.close()
                    if (attempt >= RETRY_BACKOFFS_MS.size) throw ioe
                }
                val delayMs = RETRY_BACKOFFS_MS[attempt]
                attempt++
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(delayMs)
                } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
                    throw IOException("Retry interrupted")
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val USER_AGENT = "Sahab/1.0 (Android)"
        val RETRY_BACKOFFS_MS = longArrayOf(500L, 1500L)
        val STRICT_HTTPS_DOMAINS = listOf(
            "themoviedb.org",
            "tmdb.org",
            "github.com",
            "githubusercontent.com",
            "open-meteo.com",
            "ipwho.is",
            "generativelanguage.googleapis.com",
        )
    }
}

class SahabApp : Application(), SingletonImageLoader.Factory {

    lateinit var container: AppContainer
        private set

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        FirebaseApp.initializeApp(this)
        AppCheckInstaller.install()
        container = AppContainer(this)
        container.startAutoSync()
        container.appScope.launch {
            // L-05: warm EncryptedSharedPreferences / MasterKey off the main thread.
            container.aiKeys
            SahabPlayer.warmUpMediaCache(this@SahabApp)
            container.weather.refreshIfNeeded()
        }
    }

    override fun newImageLoader(context: PlatformContext): ImageLoader =
        ImageLoader.Builder(context)
            .components {
                add(OkHttpNetworkFetcherFactory(callFactory = { coilClient }))
            }
            .memoryCache {
                MemoryCache.Builder()
                    .maxSizePercent(context, 0.25)
                    .strongReferencesEnabled(true)
                    .build()
            }
            .diskCache {
                CoilDiskCache.Builder()
                    .directory(File(cacheDir, "image_cache").toOkioPath())
                    .maxSizeBytes(500L * 1024L * 1024L)
                    .build()
            }
            .crossfade(false)
            .build()

    private val coilClient: OkHttpClient by lazy {
        container.client.newBuilder()
            .cache(null)
            .connectTimeout(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .readTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .callTimeout(18, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .build()
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/DiskCache.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.ExperimentalSerializationApi
import kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.decodeFromStream
import kotlinx.serialization.json.encodeToStream
import java.io.BufferedInputStream
import java.io.BufferedOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * Persistent disk cache for API responses (Xtream catalogs, movie/series details, EPG, and TMDB).
 * Each entry is stored in its own file whose `lastModified` timestamp tracks freshness (TTL).
 * TMDB entries live in a dedicated sub-folder so refreshing the IPTV playlist never wastes TMDB quota.
 */
class DiskCache(
    private val rootDir: File,
    private val maxCatalogBytes: Long = MAX_CATALOG_BYTES,
) {

    constructor(context: Context) : this(
        rootDir = File(context.applicationContext.cacheDir, "sahab_api_cache"),
    )

    private val catalogDir = File(rootDir.apply { mkdirs() }, "catalog").apply { mkdirs() }
    private val tmdbDir = File(rootDir, "tmdb").apply { mkdirs() }

    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
    }

    // Fixed striped lock pool prevents unbounded ConcurrentHashMap growth and lock/eviction races.
    private val lockStripes = Array(LOCK_STRIPES) { Mutex() }

    private val catalogEvictionLock = Any()

    @Volatile
    private var estimatedCatalogBytes: Long = -1L

    private fun lockFor(key: String): Mutex =
        lockStripes[(key.hashCode() and Int.MAX_VALUE) % LOCK_STRIPES]

    @OptIn(ExperimentalSerializationApi::class)
    suspend fun <T> get(
        key: String,
        serializer: KSerializer<T>,
        ttlMs: Long,
        permanentNamespace: Boolean = false,
    ): T? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        lockFor(key).withLock {
            val file = fileFor(key, permanentNamespace)
            if (!file.exists() || file.length() == 0L) return@withLock null
            val age = System.currentTimeMillis() - file.lastModified()
            if (age > ttlMs) return@withLock null
            runCatching {
                BufferedInputStream(file.inputStream(), 64 * 1024).use { input ->
                    json.decodeFromStream(serializer, input)
                }
            }.getOrNull()
        }
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalSerializationApi::class)
    suspend fun <T> put(
        key: String,
        serializer: KSerializer<T>,
        value: T,
        permanentNamespace: Boolean = false,
    ): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        lockFor(key).withLock {
            runCatching {
                val dir = if (permanentNamespace) tmdbDir else catalogDir
                if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs()
                val file = fileFor(key, permanentNamespace)
                val previousBytes = if (!permanentNamespace && file.exists()) file.length() else 0L
                val tmp = File(dir, "${file.name}.tmp")
                BufferedOutputStream(tmp.outputStream(), 64 * 1024).use { output ->
                    json.encodeToStream(serializer, value, output)
                }
                var renamed = tmp.renameTo(file)
                if (!renamed) {
                    if (file.exists()) file.delete()
                    renamed = tmp.renameTo(file)
                }
                if (!renamed) {
                    tmp.delete()
                    return@runCatching false
                }
                file.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis())
                if (!permanentNamespace) {
                    onCatalogPut(file.length() - previousBytes)
                }
                true
            }.getOrDefault(false)
        }
    }

    private fun onCatalogPut(deltaBytes: Long) {
        synchronized(catalogEvictionLock) {
            if (estimatedCatalogBytes < 0L) {
                val files = catalogDir.listFiles()?.filter { it.isFile && !it.name.endsWith(".tmp") }.orEmpty()
                estimatedCatalogBytes = files.sumOf { it.length() }
            } else {
                estimatedCatalogBytes = (estimatedCatalogBytes + deltaBytes).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            }
            if (estimatedCatalogBytes > maxCatalogBytes) {
                enforceCatalogLruLimitLocked()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun enforceCatalogLruLimitLocked() {
        val files = catalogDir.listFiles()?.filter { it.isFile && !it.name.endsWith(".tmp") } ?: return
        var totalBytes = files.sumOf { it.length() }
        if (totalBytes <= maxCatalogBytes) {
            estimatedCatalogBytes = totalBytes
            return
        }
        val oldestFirst = files.sortedBy { it.lastModified() }
        for (candidate in oldestFirst) {
            if (totalBytes <= maxCatalogBytes) break
            val size = candidate.length()
            if (candidate.delete()) {
                totalBytes -= size
            }
        }
        estimatedCatalogBytes = totalBytes.coerceAtLeast(0L)
    }

    /** Clears IPTV catalog/EPG cache while keeping the TMDB quota cache intact. */
    fun clearCatalog() {
        runCatching {
            synchronized(catalogEvictionLock) {
                catalogDir.listFiles()?.forEach { it.delete() }
                estimatedCatalogBytes = 0L
            }
        }
    }

    private fun fileFor(key: String, permanentNamespace: Boolean): File {
        val dir = if (permanentNamespace) tmdbDir else catalogDir
        return File(dir, "${sha256(key)}.json")
    }

    private fun sha256(input: String): String {
        val digest = SHA256_LOCAL.get()!!
        digest.reset()
        val bytes = digest.digest(input.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val sb = StringBuilder(bytes.size * 2)
        for (b in bytes) {
            val v = b.toInt() and 0xFF
            if (v < 16) sb.append('0')
            sb.append(v.toString(16))
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val LOCK_STRIPES = 64
        private val SHA256_LOCAL: ThreadLocal<MessageDigest> =
            ThreadLocal.withInitial { MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256") }
        const val MAX_CATALOG_BYTES = 200L * 1024L * 1024L // 200 MB LRU cap
        const val TTL_CATALOG_MS = 12 * 3600_000L       // 12 hours for categories & channel/VOD lists
        const val TTL_DETAILS_MS = 7 * 24 * 3600_000L   // 7 days for movie & series details
        const val TTL_TMDB_MS = 30L * 24 * 3600_000L    // 30 days for TMDB enriched data
        const val TTL_TMDB_MISS_MS = 7L * 24 * 3600_000L // 7 days negative cache when TMDB has no match
        const val TTL_EPG_MS = 30 * 60_000L             // 30 minutes for EPG program guide
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/GithubReleaseUpdater.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import com.saydlawy.sahab.BuildConfig
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import okhttp3.HttpUrl.Companion.toHttpUrlOrNull
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request

data class GithubReleaseUpdate(
    val versionCode: Int,
    val title: String,
    val apkUrl: String,
    val htmlUrl: String,
    val sha256: String? = null,
)

/**
 * O-05: Lightweight GitHub Releases updater that compares the latest published build number
 * against [BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE] without requiring Firebase App Distribution in release builds.
 */
object GithubReleaseUpdater {

    private const val LATEST_TAG_URL = "https://api.github.com/repos/saydlawy/-Sahab/releases/tags/latest"
    private val BUILD_NUMBER_REGEX = Regex("""build\s+(\d+)""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val SHA256_REGEX = Regex("""\bsha-?256\s*[:=]\s*([0-9a-fA-F]{64})\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val TRUSTED_HOSTS = setOf(
        "github.com",
        "objects.githubusercontent.com",
        "release-assets.githubusercontent.com",
    )
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }

    fun isTrustedReleaseUrl(rawUrl: String): Boolean {
        val parsed = rawUrl.trim().toHttpUrlOrNull() ?: return false
        if (!parsed.isHttps) return false
        val host = parsed.host.lowercase()
        return TRUSTED_HOSTS.any { trusted -> host == trusted || host.endsWith(".$trusted") }
    }

    suspend fun checkForUpdate(
        client: OkHttpClient,
        endpointUrl: String = LATEST_TAG_URL,
        currentVersionCode: Int = BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE,
    ): GithubReleaseUpdate? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        runCatching {
            val req = Request.Builder()
                .url(endpointUrl)
                .header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
                .build()
            client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                if (!resp.isSuccessful) return@runCatching null
                val body = resp.body?.string().orEmpty()
                if (body.isBlank()) return@runCatching null
                val root = json.parseToJsonElement(body).jsonObject
                val name = root["name"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
                val releaseNotes = root["body"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
                val rawHtmlUrl = root["html_url"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
                val htmlUrl = rawHtmlUrl.takeIf { isTrustedReleaseUrl(it) }.orEmpty()
                val remoteCode = BUILD_NUMBER_REGEX.find(name)?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                    ?: return@runCatching null
                if (remoteCode <= currentVersionCode) return@runCatching null
                val assets = root["assets"]?.jsonArray.orEmpty()
                val apkAsset = assets.firstOrNull { el ->
                    val assetName = el.jsonObject["name"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
                    assetName.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)
                }?.jsonObject
                val rawApkUrl = apkAsset?.get("browser_download_url")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
                val apkUrl = rawApkUrl.takeIf { isTrustedReleaseUrl(it) }.orEmpty().ifBlank { htmlUrl }
                if (apkUrl.isBlank() || !isTrustedReleaseUrl(apkUrl)) return@runCatching null

                val assetDigest = apkAsset?.get("digest")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                    ?.removePrefix("sha256:")
                    ?.trim()
                    ?.takeIf { it.length == 64 && it.all { c -> c in '0'..'9' || c in 'a'..'f' || c in 'A'..'F' } }
                val noteDigest = SHA256_REGEX.find(releaseNotes)?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)
                GithubReleaseUpdate(
                    versionCode = remoteCode,
                    title = name.ifBlank { "إصدار جديد ($remoteCode)" },
                    apkUrl = apkUrl,
                    htmlUrl = htmlUrl,
                    sha256 = assetDigest ?: noteDigest,
                )
            }
        }.getOrNull()
    }
}

    isLenient = true
}

internal fun JsonElement?.str(): String = when (this) {
    null -> ""
    JsonNull -> ""
    is JsonPrimitive -> content
    else -> ""
}

internal fun JsonElement?.obj(): JsonObject? = this as? JsonObject

internal fun JsonElement?.arr(): JsonArray? = this as? JsonArray

internal fun JsonObject.i(key: String): Int = this[key].str().toDoubleOrNull()?.toInt() ?: 0

internal fun JsonElement?.firstString(): String = when (this) {
    is JsonArray -> this.firstOrNull().str().trim()
    else -> this.str().trim()
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/M3uParser.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import okhttp3.Call
import okhttp3.Callback
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.Response
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.UUID
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

class M3uParser(private val client: OkHttpClient) {

    suspend fun fetch(url: String): List<Channel> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val request = Request.Builder().url(url).build()
        val call = client.newCall(request)
        val response = suspendCancellableCoroutine<Response> { cont ->
            cont.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }
            call.enqueue(object : Callback {
                override fun onFailure(call: Call, e: IOException) {
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resumeWithException(e)
                }

                override fun onResponse(call: Call, response: Response) {
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(response) else response.close()
                }
            })
        }
        response.use { resp ->
            if (!resp.isSuccessful) {
                throw ApiException("فشل تحميل قائمة M3U: ${resp.code}")
            }

            resp.body?.charStream()?.buffered()?.useLines { lines ->
                parseLines(lines)
            } ?: emptyList()
        }
    }

    internal fun parseLines(lines: Sequence<String>): List<Channel> {
        val channels = mutableListOf<Channel>()
        var currentName = ""
        var currentLogo = ""
        var currentGroup = ""
        var currentEpgId = ""
        var hasExtInf = false

        for (rawLine in lines) {
            val line = rawLine.trim()
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue
            if (line.startsWith("#EXTINF:", ignoreCase = true)) {
                currentName = if (',' in line) {
                    line.substringAfterLast(',').trim().ifBlank { "قناة غير معروفة" }
                } else {
                    "قناة غير معروفة"
                }
                currentLogo = LOGO_REGEX.find(line)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: ""
                currentGroup = GROUP_REGEX.find(line)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: ""
                currentEpgId = EPG_REGEX.find(line)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: ""
                hasExtInf = true
            } else if (!line.startsWith("#")) {
                if (line.startsWith("http://", ignoreCase = true) || line.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)) {
                    val id = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(line.toByteArray()).toString()
                    channels.add(
                        Channel(
                            id = id,
                            name = if (hasExtInf && currentName.isNotBlank()) currentName else "قناة غير معروفة",
                            icon = currentLogo,
                            categoryId = currentGroup,
                            epgId = currentEpgId,
                            url = line,
                        )
                    )
                    if (channels.size >= MAX_CHANNELS) break
                }
                currentName = ""; currentLogo = ""; currentGroup = ""; currentEpgId = ""; hasExtInf = false
            }
        }
        return channels.distinctBy { it.id }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_CHANNELS = 25_000
        val LOGO_REGEX = Regex("tvg-logo=\"([^\"]*)\"")
        val GROUP_REGEX = Regex("group-title=\"([^\"]*)\"")
        val EPG_REGEX = Regex("tvg-id=\"([^\"]*)\"")
    }
}

class Prefs @JvmOverloads constructor(
    context: Context?,
    private val secureStoreOverride: SharedPreferences? = null,
    dataStoreOverride: DataStore<Preferences>? = null,
) {

    private val appContext = context?.applicationContext
    private val store: DataStore<Preferences> = dataStoreOverride
        ?: appContext?.dataStore
        ?: error("Context or dataStoreOverride is required")
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
    private val favSerializer = ListSerializer(FavItem.serializer())
    private val recentSerializer = ListSerializer(RecentItem.serializer())
    private val accountSerializer = ListSerializer(Account.serializer())

    private object Keys {
        val Server = stringPreferencesKey("server")
        val User = stringPreferencesKey("user")
        val Pass = stringPreferencesKey("pass")
        val Favs = stringPreferencesKey("favorites")
        val Recents = stringPreferencesKey("recents")
        val LightEffects = booleanPreferencesKey("light_effects")
        val ThemePreferencesKey = stringPreferencesKey("theme_preferences")
        val ShowRecents = booleanPreferencesKey("show_recents")
        val ShowLiveChannelsOnHome = booleanPreferencesKey("show_live_channels_on_home")
        val ShowRecommendedOnHome = booleanPreferencesKey("show_recommended_on_home")
        val ShowQuickCategoriesOnHome = booleanPreferencesKey("show_quick_categories_on_home")
        val HomeChannelsLayoutKey = stringPreferencesKey("home_channels_layout")
        val HomeChannelsSourceKey = stringPreferencesKey("home_channels_source")
        val HomeChannelsCategoryIdKey = stringPreferencesKey("home_channels_category_id")
        val HomeCustomChannelIdsKey = stringPreferencesKey("home_custom_channel_ids")
        val MoviesLayoutStyleKey = stringPreferencesKey("movies_layout_style")
        val SeriesLayoutStyleKey = stringPreferencesKey("series_layout_style")
        val LastSyncTime = longPreferencesKey("last_sync_time")
        val LastCatalogSyncTime = longPreferencesKey("last_catalog_sync_time")
        val LastChannelSyncTime = longPreferencesKey("last_channel_sync_time")
        val EpgLastSyncTime = longPreferencesKey("epg_last_sync_time")
    }

    private val accountMutex = Mutex()
    private val _accountState = MutableStateFlow<Account?>(null)

    @Volatile
    private var accountInitialized = false

    @Volatile
    private var cachedSecurePrefs: SharedPreferences? = secureStoreOverride

    private fun securePrefs(): SharedPreferences {
        cachedSecurePrefs?.let { return it }
        synchronized(this) {
            cachedSecurePrefs?.let { return it }
            val created = runCatching { createEncryptedPrefs() }.getOrElse {
                // Recover from corrupted EncryptedSharedPreferences or Android Keystore entry after backup restore
                runCatching { appContext?.deleteSharedPreferences(SECURE_PREFS_NAME) }
                runCatching { createEncryptedPrefs() }.getOrElse {
                    runCatching {
                        val ks = java.security.KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore")
                        ks.load(null)
                        ks.deleteEntry(MasterKey.DEFAULT_MASTER_KEY_ALIAS)
                    }
                    runCatching { appContext?.deleteSharedPreferences(SECURE_PREFS_NAME) }
                    createEncryptedPrefs()
                }
            }
            cachedSecurePrefs = created
            return created
        }
    }

    private fun createEncryptedPrefs(): SharedPreferences {
        val ctx = appContext ?: error("Context is required for EncryptedSharedPreferences")
        val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(ctx)
            .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
            .build()
        return EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
            ctx,
            SECURE_PREFS_NAME,
            masterKey,
            EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
            EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM,
        )
    }

    private suspend fun ensureAccountLoaded() {
        if (accountInitialized) return
        accountMutex.withLock {
            if (accountInitialized) return
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val sec = securePrefs()
                var accountsJson = sec.getString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, null)
                
                if (accountsJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    // 1. Try secure prefs
                    val oldServer = sec.getString(SEC_SERVER, null)
                    val oldUser = sec.getString(SEC_USER, null)
                    val oldPass = sec.getString(SEC_PASS, null)
                    
                    // 2. If not found, try legacy DataStore
                    var server = oldServer
                    var user = oldUser
                    var pass = oldPass
                    if (server.isNullOrBlank() || user.isNullOrBlank() || pass == null) {
                        val legacy = store.data.first()
                        server = legacy[Keys.Server]
                        user = legacy[Keys.User]
                        pass = legacy[Keys.Pass]
                    }

                    if (!server.isNullOrBlank() && !user.isNullOrBlank() && pass != null) {
                        val legacyAccount = Account(name = "حسابي القديم", type = "XTREAM", server = server, user = user, pass = pass)
                        val list = listOf(legacyAccount)
                        accountsJson = json.encodeToString(accountSerializer, list)
                        sec.edit().putString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, accountsJson).putString(SEC_ACTIVE_ID, legacyAccount.id).remove(SEC_SERVER).remove(SEC_USER).remove(SEC_PASS).commit()
                        
                        // Clean up DataStore to prevent future false positives
                        store.edit {
                            it.remove(Keys.Server)
                            it.remove(Keys.User)
                            it.remove(Keys.Pass)
                        }
                    }
                }

                var accounts = emptyList<Account>()
                if (!accountsJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    accounts = runCatching { json.decodeFromString(accountSerializer, accountsJson) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                }

                val activeId = sec.getString(SEC_ACTIVE_ID, null)
                val resolved = accounts.firstOrNull { it.id == activeId } ?: accounts.firstOrNull()
                _accountState.value = resolved
                accountInitialized = true
                if (resolved != null && resolved.id.isNotBlank()) {
                    migrateHistoryAccountIdIfNeeded(resolved.id)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun currentActiveAccountId(): String = _accountState.value?.id.orEmpty()

    val account: Flow<Account?> = flow {
        ensureAccountLoaded()
        emitAll(_accountState)
    }

    val activeAccountId: Flow<String> = account.map { it?.id.orEmpty() }.distinctUntilChanged()

    /**
     * ينسب العناصر القديمة ذات `accountId` الفارغ إلى الحساب النشط [activeId] عند أول إقلاع بعد التحديث.
     */
    suspend fun migrateHistoryAccountIdIfNeeded(activeId: String) {
        if (activeId.isBlank()) return
        store.edit { p ->
            val rawFavs = p[Keys.Favs]
            if (!rawFavs.isNullOrBlank()) {
                val favs = decodeFavs(rawFavs)
                if (favs.any { it.accountId.isBlank() }) {
                    val migrated = favs.map { if (it.accountId.isBlank()) it.copy(accountId = activeId) else it }
                        .distinctBy { Triple(it.accountId, it.kind, it.id) }
                    p[Keys.Favs] = json.encodeToString(favSerializer, migrated)
                }
            }
            val rawRecents = p[Keys.Recents]
            if (!rawRecents.isNullOrBlank()) {
                val recents = decodeRecents(rawRecents)
                if (recents.any { it.accountId.isBlank() }) {
                    val migrated = recents.map { if (it.accountId.isBlank()) it.copy(accountId = activeId) else it }
                        .sortedByDescending { it.updatedAt }
                        .distinctBy { Triple(it.accountId, it.kind, it.id) }
                        .trimPerAccount(MAX_RECENTS)
                    p[Keys.Recents] = json.encodeToString(recentSerializer, migrated)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    val favorites: Flow<List<FavItem>> = store.data

    val homeChannelsCategoryId: Flow<String> = store.data

    suspend fun setShowRecents(show: Boolean) {

    suspend fun toggleHomeCustomChannel(channelId: String) {

            val current = p[Keys.HomeCustomChannelIdsKey]
                ?.split(",")
                ?.map { it.trim() }

                ?.toMutableSet()
                ?: mutableSetOf()
            if (!current.remove(channelId)) {
                current.add(channelId)
            }
            p[Keys.HomeCustomChannelIdsKey] = current.joinToString(",")
        }
    }

    suspend fun setHomeCustomChannelIds(ids: Set<String>) {

    val lastCatalogSyncTime: Flow<Long> = store.data.map {

    /** ترحيل لمرة واحدة من last_sync_time القديم إلى last_catalog_sync_time مع ترك القنوات وEPG عند 0. */
    suspend fun migrateSyncKeysIfNeeded() {
        store.edit { p ->
            val legacy = p[Keys.LastSyncTime]
            if (legacy != null) {
                if (p[Keys.LastCatalogSyncTime] == null) {
                    p[Keys.LastCatalogSyncTime] = legacy
                }
                p.remove(Keys.LastSyncTime)
                p.remove(Keys.LastChannelSyncTime)
                p.remove(Keys.EpgLastSyncTime)
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearSyncTimestamps() {
        store.edit { p ->
            p.remove(Keys.LastSyncTime)
            p.remove(Keys.LastCatalogSyncTime)
            p.remove(Keys.LastChannelSyncTime)
            p.remove(Keys.EpgLastSyncTime)
        }
    }

    suspend fun saveAccount(account: Account) {
        accountMutex.withLock {
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val sec = securePrefs()
                val accountsJson = sec.getString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, null)
                val accounts = if (accountsJson.isNullOrBlank()) mutableListOf() else 
                    runCatching { json.decodeFromString(accountSerializer, accountsJson).toMutableList() }.getOrElse { mutableListOf() }
                
                val index = accounts.indexOfFirst { it.id == account.id }
                if (index >= 0) accounts[index] = account else accounts.add(account)
                
                sec.edit()
                    .putString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, json.encodeToString(accountSerializer, accounts))
                    .putString(SEC_ACTIVE_ID, account.id)
                    .commit()
                
                _accountState.value = account
                accountInitialized = true
            }
        }
    }
    
    suspend fun getAccounts(): List<Account> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        ensureAccountLoaded()
        val accountsJson = securePrefs().getString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, null)
        if (accountsJson.isNullOrBlank()) emptyList() else 
            runCatching { json.decodeFromString(accountSerializer, accountsJson) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    }

    suspend fun setActiveAccount(id: String) {
        accountMutex.withLock {
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val sec = securePrefs()
                sec.edit().putString(SEC_ACTIVE_ID, id).commit()
                val accountsJson = sec.getString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, null)
                if (!accountsJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    val accounts = runCatching { json.decodeFromString(accountSerializer, accountsJson) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                    _accountState.value = accounts.firstOrNull { it.id == id }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun deleteAccount(id: String) {
        accountMutex.withLock {
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val sec = securePrefs()
                val accountsJson = sec.getString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, null)
                if (!accountsJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    val accounts = runCatching { json.decodeFromString(accountSerializer, accountsJson).toMutableList() }.getOrElse { mutableListOf() }
                    accounts.removeAll { it.id == id }
                    sec.edit().putString(SEC_ACCOUNTS, json.encodeToString(accountSerializer, accounts)).commit()
                    
                    if (sec.getString(SEC_ACTIVE_ID, null) == id) {
                        val newActive = accounts.firstOrNull()
                        sec.edit().putString(SEC_ACTIVE_ID, newActive?.id ?: "").commit()
                        _accountState.value = newActive
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun getCloudSyncPin(): String? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        securePrefs().getString(SEC_SYNC_PIN, null)?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
    }

    suspend fun setCloudSyncPin(pin: String?) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val clean = pin?.trim().orEmpty()
        securePrefs().edit().apply {
            if (clean.isEmpty()) remove(SEC_SYNC_PIN) else putString(SEC_SYNC_PIN, clean)
        }.commit()
    }

    suspend fun clearAccount() {
        accountMutex.withLock {
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                securePrefs().edit()
                    .remove(SEC_SERVER)
                    .remove(SEC_USER)
                    .remove(SEC_PASS)
                    .remove(SEC_ACCOUNTS)
                    .remove(SEC_ACTIVE_ID)
                    .remove(SEC_SYNC_PIN)
                    .commit()
                store.edit {
                    it.remove(Keys.Server)
                    it.remove(Keys.User)
                    it.remove(Keys.Pass)
                    it.remove(Keys.Favs)
                    it.remove(Keys.Recents)
                }
                _accountState.value = null
                accountInitialized = true
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun setLightEffects(enabled: Boolean) {
        store.edit { it[Keys.LightEffects] = enabled }
    }

    suspend fun saveThemePreferences(value: ThemePreferences) {
        store.edit { it[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey] = json.encodeToString(ThemePreferences.serializer(), value) }
    }

    suspend fun setSelectedTheme(themeId: String) {
        store.edit { preferences ->
            val current = preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey]
                ?.let { raw -> runCatching { json.decodeFromString(ThemePreferences.serializer(), raw) }.getOrNull() }
                ?: ThemePreferences()
            preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey] = json.encodeToString(
                ThemePreferences.serializer(),
                current.copy(selectedThemeId = themeId),
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun setOledAccentPreset(presetId: String) {
        store.edit { preferences ->
            val current = preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey]
                ?.let { raw -> runCatching { json.decodeFromString(ThemePreferences.serializer(), raw) }.getOrNull() }
                ?: ThemePreferences()
            preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey] = json.encodeToString(
                ThemePreferences.serializer(),
                current.copy(oledAccentPreset = presetId),
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun setThemeCustomization(themeId: String, customization: ThemeCustomization) {
        updateThemeCustomization(themeId) { customization }
    }

    /** تحديث ذري لتخصيص الثيم داخل DataStore.edit لتجنب ضياع التغييرات المتزامنة. */
    suspend fun updateThemeCustomization(
        themeId: String,
        transform: (ThemeCustomization) -> ThemeCustomization,
    ) {
        store.edit { preferences ->
            val current = preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey]
                ?.let { raw -> runCatching { json.decodeFromString(ThemePreferences.serializer(), raw) }.getOrNull() }
                ?: ThemePreferences()
            val updated = transform(current.customization(themeId))
            preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey] = json.encodeToString(
                ThemePreferences.serializer(),
                current.copy(customizations = current.customizations + (themeId to updated)),
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun resetThemeCustomization(themeId: String) {
        store.edit { preferences ->
            val current = preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey]
                ?.let { raw -> runCatching { json.decodeFromString(ThemePreferences.serializer(), raw) }.getOrNull() }
                ?: ThemePreferences()
            preferences[Keys.ThemePreferencesKey] = json.encodeToString(
                ThemePreferences.serializer(),
                current.copy(customizations = current.customizations - themeId),
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun toggleFavorite(item: FavItem) {
        ensureAccountLoaded()
        val accId = item.accountId.ifBlank { currentActiveAccountId() }
        val scopedItem = if (item.accountId == accId) item else item.copy(accountId = accId)
        store.edit { p ->
            val list = decodeFavs(p[Keys.Favs]).toMutableList()
            val index = list.indexOfFirst {
                it.accountId == accId && it.kind == scopedItem.kind && it.id == scopedItem.id
            }
            if (index >= 0) list.removeAt(index) else list.add(0, scopedItem)
            p[Keys.Favs] = json.encodeToString(favSerializer, list)
        }
    }

    suspend fun positionOf(kind: String, id: String): Long {
        ensureAccountLoaded()
        val accId = currentActiveAccountId()
        return recents.first().firstOrNull {
            it.accountId == accId && it.kind == kind && it.id == id
        }?.positionMs ?: 0L
    }

    /** Live channels are remembered without a position; finished movies and episodes are dropped. */
    suspend fun recordPlayback(item: RecentItem) {
        ensureAccountLoaded()
        val accId = item.accountId.ifBlank { currentActiveAccountId() }
        val scopedItem = if (item.accountId == accId) item else item.copy(accountId = accId)
        store.edit { p ->
            val list = decodeRecents(p[Keys.Recents]).toMutableList()
            list.removeAll { it.accountId == accId && it.kind == scopedItem.kind && it.id == scopedItem.id }
            val finished = scopedItem.kind != Kind.LIVE &&
                scopedItem.durationMs > 0 &&
                scopedItem.positionMs >= scopedItem.durationMs * 95 / 100
            if (!finished) list.add(0, scopedItem)
            p[Keys.Recents] = json.encodeToString(recentSerializer, list.trimPerAccount(MAX_RECENTS))
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearRecentsForAccount(accountId: String) {
        store.edit { p ->
            val kept = decodeRecents(p[Keys.Recents]).filterNot { it.accountId == accountId }
            p[Keys.Recents] = json.encodeToString(recentSerializer, kept)
        }
    }


    suspend fun restoreFavorites(favs: List<FavItem>) {
        store.edit { p -> p[Keys.Favs] = json.encodeToString(favSerializer, favs) }
    }

    suspend fun restoreRecents(recents: List<RecentItem>) {
        store.edit { p -> p[Keys.Recents] = json.encodeToString(recentSerializer, recents) }
    }

    private fun decodeFavs(raw: String?): List<FavItem> =
        if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) emptyList()
        else runCatching { json.decodeFromString(favSerializer, raw) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    private fun decodeRecents(raw: String?): List<RecentItem> =
        if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) emptyList()
        else runCatching { json.decodeFromString(recentSerializer, raw) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_RECENTS = 30
        const val SECURE_PREFS_NAME = "sahab_secure_account"
        const val SEC_SERVER = "enc_server"
        const val SEC_USER = "enc_user"
        const val SEC_PASS = "enc_pass"
        const val SEC_ACCOUNTS = "enc_accounts_list"
        const val SEC_ACTIVE_ID = "enc_active_id"
        const val SEC_SYNC_PIN = "enc_cloud_sync_pin"
    }
}
