class Repository(
    private val api: XtreamApi,
    private val tmdb: TmdbApi,
    private val disk: DiskCache? = null,
    private val prefs: Prefs? = null,
    private val channelDao: ChannelDao? = null,
    okHttpClient: okhttp3.OkHttpClient? = null,
) {

    private val m3uParser = M3uParser(okHttpClient ?: okhttp3.OkHttpClient())

    @Volatile
    var account: Account? = null
        private set

    @Volatile
    var userInfo: UserInfo? = null
        private set

    private val _syncing = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(false)
    val syncing: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<Boolean> = _syncing

    private data class CacheEntry(
        val typeTag: String,
        val value: Any,
    )

    private val cache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, CacheEntry>()
    private val inFlight = ConcurrentHashMap<String, CompletableDeferred<CacheEntry>>()

    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private fun <T : Any> getTypedCache(key: String, serializer: KSerializer<T>): T? {
        val entry = cache[key] ?: return null
        return if (entry.typeTag == serializer.descriptor.serialName) entry.value as? T else null
    }

    private fun <T : Any> putTypedCache(key: String, serializer: KSerializer<T>, value: T) {
        cache[key] = CacheEntry(serializer.descriptor.serialName, value)
    }
    private val epgCacheLock = Any()
    private val epgCache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, Pair<Long, List<Program>>>(64, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, Pair<Long, List<Program>>>?): Boolean =
            size > MAX_EPG_MEMORY_ENTRIES
    }
    private val epgGate = Semaphore(4)

    private fun getEpgMem(key: String): Pair<Long, List<Program>>? = synchronized(epgCacheLock) {
        epgCache[key]
    }

    private fun putEpgMem(key: String, value: Pair<Long, List<Program>>) {
        synchronized(epgCacheLock) {
            epgCache[key] = value
        }
    }

    fun setAccount(value: Account?) {
        val changed = account != value
        account = value
        if (changed) {
            userInfo = null
            clearCache(clearDisk = false)
        }
    }

    fun clearCache(clearDisk: Boolean = false) {
        cache.clear()
        inFlight.clear()
        synchronized(epgCacheLock) {
            epgCache.clear()
        }
        if (clearDisk) {
            disk?.clearCatalog()
        }
    }

    fun invalidateLiveChannelCache() {
        cache.keys.removeIf { it.startsWith("live:") }
        inFlight.keys.removeIf { it.contains("::live:") }
    }

    private fun requireAccount(): Account = account ?: throw ApiException(Ar.errNoAccount)

    private fun accountTag(): String {
        val a = account ?: return "anon"
        if (a.type == "M3U") {
            val urlHash = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                .digest(a.m3uUrl.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                .take(6)
                .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
            return "m3u|${a.id}|$urlHash"
        }
        return "${a.id}|${a.server}|${a.user}"
    }

    private fun diskKey(key: String): String = "${accountTag()}::$key"

    suspend fun login(candidate: Account): UserInfo? {
        if (candidate.type == "M3U") {
            if (candidate.m3uUrl.isBlank()) throw ApiException(Ar.errBadUrl)
            val channels = m3uParser.fetch(candidate.m3uUrl)
            if (channels.isEmpty()) {
                throw ApiException("قائمة M3U فارغة أو لا تحتوي على قنوات صالحة")
            }
            account = candidate
            userInfo = null
            clearCache(clearDisk = false)
            putTypedCache("live_m3u", ListSerializer(Channel.serializer()), channels)
            return null
        }
        val info = parseUserInfo(api.request(candidate, null))
        account = candidate
        userInfo = info
        clearCache(clearDisk = false)
        disk?.put(diskKey("user_info"), UserInfo.serializer(), info)
        return info
    }

    suspend fun refreshUserInfo(): UserInfo {
        val a = requireAccount()
        disk?.get(diskKey("user_info"), UserInfo.serializer(), USER_INFO_TTL_MS)?.let { cachedInfo ->
            if (userInfo == null) userInfo = cachedInfo
        }
        val info = parseUserInfo(api.request(a, null))
        userInfo = info
        disk?.put(diskKey("user_info"), UserInfo.serializer(), info)
        return info
    }

    /** Pre-warms categories and full catalogs concurrently in background so any screen opens fast. */
    suspend fun prewarmCatalog() = supervisorScope {
        if (account == null) return@supervisorScope
        if (userInfo == null) {
            disk?.get(diskKey("user_info"), UserInfo.serializer(), USER_INFO_TTL_MS)?.let {
                userInfo = it
            }
        }
        val gate = Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_CATALOG_TASKS)
        awaitAll(
            async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { runCatching { liveCategories() } } },
            async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { runCatching { movieCategories() } } },
            async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { runCatching { seriesCategories() } } },
            async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { runCatching { liveChannels(null) } } },
            async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { runCatching { movies(null) } } },
            async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { runCatching { seriesList(null) } } },
        )
    }

    sealed class SyncResult {
        object Skipped : SyncResult()
        object AlreadyRunning : SyncResult()
        object Success : SyncResult()
        data class Failure(val reason: String) : SyncResult()
    }

    private suspend inline fun <T> suspendRunCatching(block: () -> T): Result<T> = try {
        Result.success(block())
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
        throw e
    } catch (t: Throwable) {
        Result.failure(t)
    }

    /**
     * Syncs catalog if [force]=true OR 24h passed since last sync.
     * Bypasses cached data during fetch via forceRefresh (no cache wipe = no data loss on failure).
     */
    suspend fun syncCatalog(force: Boolean = false): SyncResult {
        if (!_syncing.compareAndSet(expect = false, update = true)) return SyncResult.AlreadyRunning
        prefs?.migrateSyncKeysIfNeeded()
        val lastSync = if (prefs == null) 0L else prefs.lastCatalogSyncTime.first()
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (!force && lastSync > 0L && (now - lastSync) < SYNC_TTL_MS) {
            _syncing.value = false
            return SyncResult.Skipped
        }
        return try {
            requireAccount()
            suspendRunCatching { refreshUserInfo() }
            val gate = Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_CATALOG_TASKS)
            val results: List<Result<*>> = supervisorScope {
                awaitAll(
                    async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { suspendRunCatching { liveCategories(forceNetwork = true) } } },
                    async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { suspendRunCatching { movieCategories(forceNetwork = true) } } },
                    async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { suspendRunCatching { seriesCategories(forceNetwork = true) } } },
                    async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { suspendRunCatching { liveChannels(null, forceNetwork = true) } } },
                    async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { suspendRunCatching { movies(null, forceNetwork = true) } } },
                    async(Dispatchers.IO) { gate.withPermit { suspendRunCatching { seriesList(null, forceNetwork = true) } } },
                )
            }
            val firstFailure = results.firstNotNullOfOrNull { it.exceptionOrNull() }
            if (firstFailure != null) {
                runCatching { Log.w("SahabSync", "syncCatalog aborted without stamping time: ${firstFailure.message}") }
                SyncResult.Failure(firstFailure.message ?: "sync failed")
            } else {
                prefs?.setLastCatalogSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis())
                SyncResult.Success
            }
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            SyncResult.Failure(e.message ?: "unknown")
        } finally {
            _syncing.value = false
        }
    }

    /** Legacy alias — always forces. Returns SyncResult for caller feedback. */
    suspend fun refreshSubscription(): SyncResult = syncCatalog(force = true)

    fun liveExtensions(): List<String> {
        val allowed = userInfo?.formats.orEmpty()
        val preferred = listOf("m3u8", "ts").filter { it in allowed }
        return preferred.ifEmpty { listOf("m3u8", "ts") }
    }

    fun streamUrl(item: PlayItem, formatAttempt: Int = 0): String {
        if (item.url.isNotBlank() && item.url.startsWith("http")) {
            return item.url
        }
        if (item.url.isBlank() && item.kind == Kind.LIVE) {
            val channelListSerializer = ListSerializer(Channel.serializer())
            val cachedUrl = getTypedCache("live:", channelListSerializer)?.firstOrNull { it.id == item.id }?.url
                ?: getTypedCache("live_m3u", channelListSerializer)?.firstOrNull { it.id == item.id }?.url
            if (!cachedUrl.isNullOrBlank() && cachedUrl.startsWith("http")) {
                return cachedUrl
            }
        }
        val a = requireAccount()
        val user = encodeSegment(a.user)
        val pass = encodeSegment(a.pass)
        return when (item.kind) {
            Kind.LIVE -> {
                val exts = liveExtensions()
                val ext = exts[formatAttempt.coerceIn(0, exts.lastIndex)]
                "${a.server}/live/$user/$pass/${item.id}.$ext"
            }
            Kind.MOVIE -> "${a.server}/movie/$user/$pass/${item.id}.${item.ext.ifBlank { DEFAULT_VOD_EXT }}"
            else -> "${a.server}/series/$user/$pass/${item.id}.${item.ext.ifBlank { DEFAULT_VOD_EXT }}"
        }
    }

    private fun encodeSegment(value: String): String =
        URLEncoder.encode(value, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")

    private suspend fun <T : Any> cachedPersistent(
        key: String,
        serializer: KSerializer<T>,
        ttlMs: Long,
        forceNetwork: Boolean = false,
        load: suspend () -> T,
    ): T {
        val typeTag = serializer.descriptor.serialName
        val dKey = diskKey(key)
        if (!forceNetwork) {
            getTypedCache(key, serializer)?.let { return it }
            val existing = inFlight[dKey]
            if (existing != null) {
                return try {
                    val awaited = existing.await()
                    if (awaited.typeTag == typeTag) {
                        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
                        awaited.value as T
                    } else {
                        load().also { loaded ->
                            putTypedCache(key, serializer, loaded)
                            disk?.put(dKey, serializer, loaded)
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                    cachedPersistent(key, serializer, ttlMs, forceNetwork = false, load = load)
                }
            }
        }
        val mine = CompletableDeferred<CacheEntry>()
        val existing = if (forceNetwork) null else inFlight.putIfAbsent(dKey, mine)
        if (existing != null) {
            return try {
                val awaited = existing.await()
                if (awaited.typeTag == typeTag) {
                    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
                    awaited.value as T
                } else {
                    load().also { loaded ->
                        putTypedCache(key, serializer, loaded)
                        disk?.put(dKey, serializer, loaded)
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                cachedPersistent(key, serializer, ttlMs, forceNetwork = false, load = load)
            }
        }
        return try {
            if (!forceNetwork) {
                getTypedCache(key, serializer)?.let { cached ->
                    mine.complete(CacheEntry(typeTag, cached))
                    return cached
                }
                val fromDisk = disk?.get(dKey, serializer, ttlMs)
                if (fromDisk != null) {
                    putTypedCache(key, serializer, fromDisk)
                    mine.complete(CacheEntry(typeTag, fromDisk))
                    return fromDisk
                }
            }
            val loaded = load()
            putTypedCache(key, serializer, loaded)
            disk?.put(dKey, serializer, loaded)
            mine.complete(CacheEntry(typeTag, loaded))
            loaded
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            inFlight.remove(dKey, mine)
            mine.cancel(e)
            throw e
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            mine.completeExceptionally(t)
            throw t
        } finally {
            inFlight.remove(dKey, mine)
        }
    }

    suspend fun <T : Any> peekCachedList(
        key: String,
        serializer: KSerializer<List<T>>,
        ttlMs: Long = CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS,
    ): List<T>? {
        getTypedCache(key, serializer)?.let { return it }
        val fromDisk = disk?.get(diskKey(key), serializer, ttlMs)
        if (fromDisk != null) {
            putTypedCache(key, serializer, fromDisk)
            return fromDisk
        }
        return null
    }

    private suspend fun request(action: String, params: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()): JsonElement =
        api.request(requireAccount(), action, params)

    private suspend fun <T> streamArray(
        action: String,
        params: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
        parseStream: (InputStream) -> List<T>,
    ): List<T> = api.streamArray(
        account = requireAccount(),
        action = action,
        params = params,
        onEmptyOrNonArray = { emptyList() },
        parseStream = parseStream,
    )

    private fun categoryParams(categoryId: String?): Map<String, String> =
        if (categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) emptyMap() else mapOf("category_id" to categoryId)

    // Live

    suspend fun liveCategories(forceNetwork: Boolean = false): List<Category> {
        val acc = requireAccount()
        if (acc.type == "M3U") {
            val channels = liveChannels(null, forceNetwork = forceNetwork)
            return channels.map { it.categoryId }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct().map { Category(it, it) }
        }
        return cachedPersistent("live_cats", ListSerializer(Category.serializer()), CATEGORIES_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {
            parseCategories(request("get_live_categories"))
        }
    }

    private suspend fun enrichWithLogos(channels: List<Channel>): List<Channel> {
        val dao = channelDao ?: return channels
        val rows = runCatching { dao.getLogosList() }.getOrNull() ?: return channels
        if (rows.isEmpty()) return channels
        val logos = rows.associate { it.streamId to it.logoUrl }
        return channels.map { ch ->
            val logo = logos[ch.id]
            if (!logo.isNullOrBlank() && logo != ch.icon) ch.copy(icon = logo) else ch
        }
    }

    private suspend fun roomChannels(): List<Channel>? {
        val rows = runCatching { channelDao?.visibleOrdered() }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
        if (rows.isEmpty()) return null
        return rows.map {
            Channel(
                id = it.streamId,
                name = it.displayName.ifBlank { it.name },
                icon = it.logoUrl,
                categoryId = it.categoryId,
                epgId = it.epgId,
                url = it.streamUrlTemplate.takeIf { u -> u.startsWith("http") }.orEmpty(),
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun peekAllLiveChannels(): List<Channel>? =
        roomChannels()
            ?: peekCachedList("live:", ListSerializer(Channel.serializer()), CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS)?.let { enrichWithLogos(it) }

    suspend fun liveChannels(categoryId: String?, forceNetwork: Boolean = false): List<Channel> {
        val acc = requireAccount()
        if (acc.type == "M3U") {
            val key = "live_m3u"
            val all = cachedPersistent(key, ListSerializer(Channel.serializer()), CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {
                m3uParser.fetch(acc.m3uUrl)
            }
            return if (categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) all else all.filter { it.categoryId == categoryId }
        }

        val key = "live:${categoryId.orEmpty()}"
        val channelListSerializer = ListSerializer(Channel.serializer())
        if (!forceNetwork) {
            getTypedCache(key, channelListSerializer)?.let { return it }

            roomChannels()?.let { all ->
                val result = if (categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) all
                else withContext(Dispatchers.Default) { all.filter { it.categoryId == categoryId } }
                if (result.isNotEmpty() || categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    putTypedCache(key, channelListSerializer, result)
                    return result
                }
            }

            if (!categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                val all = peekAllLiveChannels()
                if (!all.isNullOrEmpty() && all.any { it.categoryId.isNotBlank() }) {
                    val filtered = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                        all.filter { it.categoryId == categoryId }
                    }
                    putTypedCache(key, channelListSerializer, filtered)
                    return filtered
                }
            }
        }

        return enrichWithLogos(cachedPersistent(key, ListSerializer(Channel.serializer()), CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {
            streamArray("get_live_streams", categoryParams(categoryId)) { stream ->
                parseChannelsStream(stream)
            }
        })
    }

    // Movies

    suspend fun movieCategories(forceNetwork: Boolean = false): List<Category> {
        if (requireAccount().type == "M3U") return emptyList()
        return cachedPersistent("vod_cats", ListSerializer(Category.serializer()), CATEGORIES_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {
            parseCategories(request("get_vod_categories"))
        }
    }

    suspend fun peekAllMovies(): List<Poster>? =
        peekCachedList("vod:", ListSerializer(Poster.serializer()), CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS)

    suspend fun movies(categoryId: String?, forceNetwork: Boolean = false): List<Poster> {
        if (requireAccount().type == "M3U") return emptyList()
        val key = "vod:${categoryId.orEmpty()}"
        val posterListSerializer = ListSerializer(Poster.serializer())
        if (!forceNetwork) {
            getTypedCache(key, posterListSerializer)?.let { return it }

            if (!categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                val all = peekAllMovies()
                if (!all.isNullOrEmpty() && all.any { it.categoryId.isNotBlank() }) {
                    val filtered = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                        all.filter { it.categoryId == categoryId }
                    }
                    putTypedCache(key, posterListSerializer, filtered)
                    return filtered
                }
            }
        }

        return cachedPersistent(key, ListSerializer(Poster.serializer()), CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {
            streamArray("get_vod_streams", categoryParams(categoryId)) { stream ->
                parseMoviesStream(stream)
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun movieDetails(id: String): MovieDetails =
        cachedPersistent("vod_info:$id", MovieDetails.serializer(), DETAILS_TTL_MS) {
            val json = request("get_vod_info", mapOf("vod_id" to id))
            val base = parseMovieDetails(id, json)
            val tmdbData = try { tmdb.enrichMovie(base.name, base.year) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            if (tmdbData == null) base else base.copy(
                image = base.image.ifBlank { tmdbData.posterPath?.let { "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w500$it" }.orEmpty() },
                backdrop = base.backdrop.ifBlank { tmdbData.backdropPath?.let { "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w780$it" }.orEmpty() },
                plot = base.plot.ifBlank { tmdbData.overview },
                year = base.year.ifBlank { tmdbData.releaseDate.take(4) },
                rating = base.rating.ifBlank { if (tmdbData.voteAverage > 0) String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", tmdbData.voteAverage) else "" },
                duration = base.duration.ifBlank { tmdbData.runtime?.let { "${it}m" }.orEmpty() },
                genre = base.genre.ifBlank { tmdbData.genres.joinToString(", ") { it.name } },
                director = base.director.ifBlank { tmdbData.credits?.crew?.firstOrNull { it.job == "Director" }?.name.orEmpty() },
                cast = base.cast.ifBlank { tmdbData.credits?.cast?.take(5)?.joinToString(", ") { it.name }.orEmpty() },
            )
        }

        if (requireAccount().type == "M3U") return emptyList()
        return cachedPersistent("series_cats", ListSerializer(Category.serializer()), CATEGORIES_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {

    suspend fun peekAllSeries(): List<Poster>? =

    suspend fun seriesList(categoryId: String?, forceNetwork: Boolean = false): List<Poster> {
        if (requireAccount().type == "M3U") return emptyList()
        val key = "series:${categoryId.orEmpty()}"
        val posterListSerializer = ListSerializer(Poster.serializer())
        if (!forceNetwork) {
            getTypedCache(key, posterListSerializer)?.let { return it }

            if (!categoryId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                val all = peekAllSeries()

                    val filtered = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                        all.filter { it.categoryId == categoryId }
                    }
                    putTypedCache(key, posterListSerializer, filtered)
                    return filtered
                }
            }
        }

        return cachedPersistent(key, ListSerializer(Poster.serializer()), CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS, forceNetwork = forceNetwork) {

    }

    suspend fun seriesDetails(id: String): SeriesDetails =
        cachedPersistent("series_info:$id", SeriesDetails.serializer(), SERIES_DETAILS_TTL_MS) {
            val json = request("get_series_info", mapOf("series_id" to id))
            withContext(Dispatchers.Default) { parseSeriesDetails(id, json) }
        }

    // Program guide

    fun peekShortEpg(streamId: String, limit: Int = 3): List<Program>? {
        val key = "short:$streamId:$limit"
        val entry = getEpgMem(key) ?: return null
        return if (System.currentTimeMillis() - entry.first < EPG_TTL_MS) entry.second else null
    }

    suspend fun shortEpg(streamId: String, limit: Int = 3): List<Program> {
        val key = "short:$streamId:$limit"
        getEpgMem(key)?.let { (time, list) ->
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() - time < EPG_TTL_MS) return list
        }
        val dao = channelDao
        if (dao != null) {
            val ch = runCatching { dao.findById(streamId) }.getOrNull()
            if (ch != null && ch.epgId.isNotBlank()) {
                val nowSec = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
                val local = runCatching { dao.programsForChannel(ch.epgId, nowSec) }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
                if (local.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val mapped = local.take(limit).map { Program(it.title, it.description, it.start, it.end) }
                    putEpgMem(key, System.currentTimeMillis() to mapped)
                    return mapped
                }
            }
        }
        val dKey = diskKey("epg_$key")
        disk?.get(dKey, ListSerializer(Program.serializer()), EPG_DISK_TTL_MS)?.let { fromDisk ->
            putEpgMem(key, System.currentTimeMillis() to fromDisk)
            return fromDisk
        }
        return epgGate.withPermit {
            getEpgMem(key)?.let { (time, list) ->
                if (System.currentTimeMillis() - time < EPG_TTL_MS) return@withPermit list
            }
            val json = request("get_short_epg", mapOf("stream_id" to streamId, "limit" to limit.toString()))
            val list = parsePrograms(json)
            putEpgMem(key, System.currentTimeMillis() to list)
            disk?.put(dKey, ListSerializer(Program.serializer()), list)
            list
        }
    }

    suspend fun dayEpg(streamId: String): List<Program> {
        val key = "day:$streamId"
        getEpgMem(key)?.let { (time, list) ->
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() - time < EPG_TTL_MS) return list
        }
        val dao = channelDao
        if (dao != null) {
            val ch = runCatching { dao.findById(streamId) }.getOrNull()
            if (ch != null && ch.epgId.isNotBlank()) {
                val nowSec = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000 - 2 * 3600
                val local = runCatching { dao.programsForChannel(ch.epgId, nowSec) }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
                if (local.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val mapped = local.take(80).map { Program(it.title, it.description, it.start, it.end) }
                    putEpgMem(key, System.currentTimeMillis() to mapped)
                    return mapped
                }
            }
        }
        val dKey = diskKey("epg_$key")
        disk?.get(dKey, ListSerializer(Program.serializer()), DAY_EPG_DISK_TTL_MS)?.let { fromDisk ->
            val nowSec = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
            val valid = fromDisk.filter { it.end > nowSec - 2 * 3600 }
            if (valid.isNotEmpty()) {
                putEpgMem(key, System.currentTimeMillis() to valid)
                return valid
            }
        }
        return epgGate.withPermit {
            getEpgMem(key)?.let { (time, list) ->
                if (System.currentTimeMillis() - time < EPG_TTL_MS) return@withPermit list
            }
            val json = request("get_simple_data_table", mapOf("stream_id" to streamId))
            val nowSec = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
            val list = parsePrograms(json).filter { it.end > nowSec - 2 * 3600 }.take(80)
            putEpgMem(key, System.currentTimeMillis() to list)
            disk?.put(dKey, ListSerializer(Program.serializer()), list)
            list
        }
    }

    // Parsing

    private fun parseUserInfo(json: JsonElement): UserInfo {
        val root = json.obj() ?: throw ApiException(Ar.errBadResponse)
        val u = root["user_info"].obj() ?: throw ApiException(Ar.errBadLogin)
        val auth = u.s("auth")
        if (auth != "1" && !auth.equals("true", ignoreCase = true)) throw ApiException(Ar.errBadLogin)
        val status = u.s("status")
        if (status.equals("Disabled", true) || status.equals("Banned", true)) throw ApiException(Ar.errDisabled)
        if (status.equals("Expired", true)) throw ApiException(Ar.errExpired)
        return UserInfo(
            status = status,
            expiry = u.s("exp_date").toLongOrNull(),
            maxConnections = u.s("max_connections"),
            activeConnections = u.s("active_cons"),
            isTrial = u.s("is_trial") == "1",
            formats = root["user_info"].obj()?.get("allowed_output_formats").arr()
                ?.map { it.str().lowercase(Locale.US) }.orEmpty(),
        )
    }

    private fun parseCategories(json: JsonElement): List<Category> =
        json.arr().orEmpty().mapNotNull { e ->
            val o = e.obj() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val id = o.s("category_id")
            if (id.isBlank()) null else Category(id, o.s("category_name").ifBlank { Ar.noName })
        }.distinctBy { it.id }

    @Serializable
    private data class XtreamChannelDto(
        val stream_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val name: JsonElement? = null,
        val stream_icon: JsonElement? = null,
        val category_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val epg_channel_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val added: JsonElement? = null,
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class XtreamMovieDto(
        val stream_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val name: JsonElement? = null,
        val stream_icon: JsonElement? = null,
        val rating: JsonElement? = null,
        val container_extension: JsonElement? = null,
        val category_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val added: JsonElement? = null,
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class XtreamSeriesDto(
        val series_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val name: JsonElement? = null,
        val cover: JsonElement? = null,
        val rating: JsonElement? = null,
        val releaseDate: JsonElement? = null,
        val release_date: JsonElement? = null,
        val category_id: JsonElement? = null,
        val last_modified: JsonElement? = null,
    )

    private fun parseChannelsStream(stream: InputStream): List<Channel> {
        val result = ArrayList<Channel>(256)
        val seen = HashSet<String>(256)
        for (o in api.decodeArraySequence<XtreamChannelDto>(stream)) {
            val id = o.stream_id.str().trim()
            if (id.isNotBlank() && seen.add(id)) {
                result.add(
                    Channel(
                        id = id,
                        name = o.name.str().trim().ifBlank { Ar.noName },
                        icon = o.stream_icon.str().trim(),
                        categoryId = o.category_id.str().trim(),
                        epgId = o.epg_channel_id.str().trim(),
                        added = o.added.str().trim().toLongOrNull() ?: 0L,
                    ),
                )
            }
        }
        return if (result.any { it.added > 0L }) result.sortedByDescending { it.added } else result
    }

    private fun parseMoviesStream(stream: InputStream): List<Poster> {
        val result = ArrayList<Poster>(256)
        val seen = HashSet<String>(256)
        for (o in api.decodeArraySequence<XtreamMovieDto>(stream)) {
            val id = o.stream_id.str().trim()
            if (id.isNotBlank() && seen.add(id)) {
                val name = o.name.str().trim()
                result.add(
                    Poster(
                        id = id,
                        name = name.ifBlank { Ar.noName },
                        image = o.stream_icon.str().trim(),
                        rating = formatRating(o.rating.str().trim()),
                        ext = o.container_extension.str().trim(),
                        year = yearOf(name),
                        categoryId = o.category_id.str().trim(),
                        added = o.added.str().trim().toLongOrNull() ?: 0L,
                    ),
                )
            }
        }
        return if (result.any { it.added > 0L }) result.sortedByDescending { it.added } else result
    }

    private fun parseSeriesStream(stream: InputStream): List<Poster> {
        val result = ArrayList<Poster>(256)
        val seen = HashSet<String>(256)
        for (o in api.decodeArraySequence<XtreamSeriesDto>(stream)) {
            val id = o.series_id.str().trim()
            if (id.isNotBlank() && seen.add(id)) {
                val name = o.name.str().trim()
                val release = o.releaseDate.str().trim().ifBlank { o.release_date.str().trim() }.ifBlank { name }
                result.add(
                    Poster(
                        id = id,
                        name = name.ifBlank { Ar.noName },
                        image = o.cover.str().trim(),
                        rating = formatRating(o.rating.str().trim()),
                        ext = "",
                        year = yearOf(release),
                        categoryId = o.category_id.str().trim(),
                        added = o.last_modified.str().trim().toLongOrNull() ?: 0L,
                    ),
                )
            }
        }
        return if (result.any { it.added > 0L }) result.sortedByDescending { it.added } else result
    }

    private fun parseMovieDetails(id: String, json: JsonElement): MovieDetails {
        val root = json.obj()
        val info = root?.get("info").obj() ?: JsonObject(emptyMap())
        val data = root?.get("movie_data").obj() ?: JsonObject(emptyMap())
        return MovieDetails(
            id = id,
            name = data.s("name").ifBlank { info.s("name") }.ifBlank { Ar.noName },
            image = info.s("movie_image").ifBlank { info.s("cover_big") },
            backdrop = info["backdrop_path"].firstString(),
            plot = info.s("plot").ifBlank { info.s("description") },
            cast = info.s("cast").ifBlank { info.s("actors") },
            director = info.s("director"),
            genre = info.s("genre"),
            year = yearOf(info.s("releasedate").ifBlank { info.s("release_date") }),
            duration = info.s("duration"),
            rating = formatRating(info.s("rating")),
            ext = data.s("container_extension"),
        )
    }

    private fun parseSeriesDetails(id: String, json: JsonElement): SeriesDetails {
        val root = json.obj()
        val info = root?.get("info").obj() ?: JsonObject(emptyMap())
        val episodes = mutableListOf<Episode>()
        when (val raw = root?.get("episodes")) {
            is JsonObject -> raw.forEach { (seasonKey, list) ->
                list.arr()?.forEach { addEpisode(episodes, it, seasonKey.toIntOrNull() ?: 1) }
            }
            is JsonArray -> raw.forEach { entry ->
                // Some panels return a flat list, or a list of seasons.
                val nested = entry.arr()
                if (nested != null) nested.forEach { addEpisode(episodes, it, 1) }
                else addEpisode(episodes, entry, 1)
            }
            else -> Unit
        }
        return SeriesDetails(
            id = id,
            name = info.s("name").ifBlank { Ar.noName },
            cover = info.s("cover"),
            backdrop = info["backdrop_path"].firstString(),
            plot = info.s("plot"),
            cast = info.s("cast"),
            genre = info.s("genre"),
            year = yearOf(info.s("releaseDate").ifBlank { info.s("release_date") }),
            rating = formatRating(info.s("rating")),
            episodes = episodes.distinctBy { it.id }
                .sortedWith(compareBy<Episode> { it.season }.thenBy { it.number }),
        )
    }

    private fun addEpisode(target: MutableList<Episode>, element: JsonElement, fallbackSeason: Int) {
        val o = element.obj() ?: return
        val id = o.s("id")
        if (id.isBlank()) return
        val info = o["info"].obj() ?: JsonObject(emptyMap())
        val number = o.i("episode_num")
        val season = o.i("season").takeIf { it > 0 } ?: fallbackSeason
        target += Episode(
            id = id,
            season = season,
            number = number,
            title = o.s("title").ifBlank { Ar.episodeNumber(number) },
            ext = o.s("container_extension"),
            image = info.s("movie_image"),
            plot = info.s("plot"),
            duration = info.s("duration"),
        )
    }

    private fun parsePrograms(json: JsonElement): List<Program> =
        json.obj()?.get("epg_listings").arr().orEmpty().mapNotNull { e ->
            val o = e.obj() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val start = o.s("start_timestamp").toLongOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val end = o.s("stop_timestamp").toLongOrNull()
                ?: o.s("end_timestamp").toLongOrNull()
                ?: return@mapNotNull null
            Program(decodeText(o.s("title")), decodeText(o.s("description")), start, end)
        }.sortedBy { it.start }

    private fun decodeText(raw: String): String {
        if (raw.isBlank()) return ""
        return try {
            val decoded = raw.decodeBase64()?.utf8()?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (decoded.isBlank() || decoded.contains('�')) raw else decoded
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            raw
        }
    }

    private fun formatRating(raw: String): String {
        val value = raw.toDoubleOrNull() ?: return ""
        return if (value <= 0.0) "" else String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", value)
    }

    private fun yearOf(raw: String): String =
        YEAR_REGEX.find(raw)?.value.orEmpty()

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_CONCURRENT_CATALOG_TASKS = 2
        const val MAX_EPG_MEMORY_ENTRIES = 256
        val YEAR_REGEX = Regex("(19|20)\\d{2}")
        const val SYNC_TTL_MS = 24L * 3600_000L
        const val EPG_TTL_MS = 5 * 60_000L
        const val EPG_DISK_TTL_MS = 15 * 60_000L
        const val DAY_EPG_DISK_TTL_MS = 2 * 3600_000L
        const val USER_INFO_TTL_MS = 24 * 3600_000L
        const val CATEGORIES_TTL_MS = 12 * 3600_000L
        const val CATALOG_LIST_TTL_MS = 6 * 3600_000L
        const val DETAILS_TTL_MS = 7L * 24 * 3600_000L
        const val SERIES_DETAILS_TTL_MS = 24 * 3600_000L
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import android.content.Context
import android.util.Log
import android.widget.Toast
import com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessaging
import com.saydlawy.sahab.AppContainer
import com.saydlawy.sahab.MyFirebaseMessagingService
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.CloudAccountRestoreResult
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * منسق استعادة الحسابات والمزامنة السحابية والمحلية.
 */
class SyncCoordinator(private val container: AppContainer) {

    private val _needsSyncPinPrompt = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val needsSyncPinPrompt: StateFlow<Boolean> = _needsSyncPinPrompt.asStateFlow()

    private val syncMutex = Mutex()

    @Volatile
    private var activeSyncJob: Job? = null

    fun dismissSyncPinPrompt() {
        _needsSyncPinPrompt.value = false
    }

    suspend fun submitRestorePin(context: Context, pin: String): CloudAccountRestoreResult {
        val result = container.userSyncService.restoreAccountsWithPin(pinOverride = pin)
        if (result is CloudAccountRestoreResult.Restored && result.accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
            container.prefs.setCloudSyncPin(pin)
            result.accounts.asReversed().forEach { container.prefs.saveAccount(it) }
            val active = result.accounts.first()
            container.prefs.setActiveAccount(active.id)
            container.repo.setAccount(active)
            _needsSyncPinPrompt.value = false
            triggerFullSync(context, forceCatalog = false, reason = "pin_restore")
        }
        return result
    }

    /**
     * يستعيد اشتراكات المستخدم من السحابة (إن لم يوجد اشتراك محلي) ويدمج المفضلة والسجل
     * والإعدادات بأمان مع ضبط أعلام الدمج الثلاثة فقط عند نجاح الجلب الفعلي.
     */
    suspend fun performCloudRestoreAndMerge(
        waitForMerge: Boolean = true,
        accountTimeoutMs: Long = 4_000L,
        mergeTimeoutMs: Long = 6_000L,
    ): Account? = coroutineScope {
        val currentUser = container.authManager.currentUser
        val localAccount = container.prefs.account.first()
        if (currentUser == null) {
            return@coroutineScope localAccount
        }

        suspend fun runMergeAndRetry() = coroutineScope {
            val favsJob = async {
                container.mergeCoordinator.mergeFavorites(
                    localFavs = { container.prefs.favorites.first() },
                    fetchCloudFavs = { container.userSyncService.fetchFavorites() },
                    saveMergedFavs = { container.prefs.restoreFavorites(it) },
                    timeoutMs = mergeTimeoutMs,
                )
            }
            val recentsJob = async {
                container.mergeCoordinator.mergeRecents(
                    localRecents = { container.prefs.recents.first() },
                    fetchCloudRecents = { container.userSyncService.fetchRecents() },
                    saveMergedRecents = { container.prefs.restoreRecents(it) },
                    timeoutMs = mergeTimeoutMs,
                )
            }
            val prefsJob = async {
                container.mergeCoordinator.mergePreferences(
                    fetchCloudPrefs = { container.userSyncService.fetchPreferences() },
                    applyPrefs = { cp ->
                        container.prefs.setLightEffects(cp.lightEffects)
                        container.prefs.setHomeChannelsLayout(
                            runCatching { HomeChannelsLayout.valueOf(cp.homeChannelsLayout) }
                                .getOrDefault(HomeChannelsLayout.CAROUSEL)
                        )
                        container.prefs.setHomeChannelsSource(
                            runCatching { HomeChannelsSource.valueOf(cp.homeChannelsSource) }
                                .getOrDefault(HomeChannelsSource.AUTO)
                        )
                        container.prefs.setHomeChannelsCategoryId(cp.homeChannelsCategoryId)
                        container.prefs.setMoviesLayoutStyle(
                            runCatching { VodLayoutStyle.valueOf(cp.moviesLayoutStyle) }
                                .getOrDefault(VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC)
                        )
                        container.prefs.setSeriesLayoutStyle(
                            runCatching { VodLayoutStyle.valueOf(cp.seriesLayoutStyle) }
                                .getOrDefault(VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC)
                        )
                    },
                    timeoutMs = mergeTimeoutMs,
                )
            }
            val allMerged = favsJob.await() && recentsJob.await() && prefsJob.await()
            if (!allMerged) {
                container.appScope.launch {
                    container.mergeCoordinator.mergeAllWithRetry(
                        isSignedIn = { container.authManager.currentUser != null },
                        localFavs = { container.prefs.favorites.first() },
                        fetchCloudFavs = { container.userSyncService.fetchFavorites() },
                        saveMergedFavs = { container.prefs.restoreFavorites(it) },
                        localRecents = { container.prefs.recents.first() },
                        fetchCloudRecents = { container.userSyncService.fetchRecents() },
                        saveMergedRecents = { container.prefs.restoreRecents(it) },
                        fetchCloudPrefs = { container.userSyncService.fetchPreferences() },
                        applyPrefs = { cp ->
                            container.prefs.setLightEffects(cp.lightEffects)
                            container.prefs.setHomeChannelsLayout(
                                runCatching { HomeChannelsLayout.valueOf(cp.homeChannelsLayout) }
                                    .getOrDefault(HomeChannelsLayout.CAROUSEL)
                            )
                            container.prefs.setHomeChannelsSource(
                                runCatching { HomeChannelsSource.valueOf(cp.homeChannelsSource) }
                                    .getOrDefault(HomeChannelsSource.AUTO)
                            )
                            container.prefs.setHomeChannelsCategoryId(cp.homeChannelsCategoryId)
                            container.prefs.setMoviesLayoutStyle(
                                runCatching { VodLayoutStyle.valueOf(cp.moviesLayoutStyle) }
                                    .getOrDefault(VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC)
                            )
                            container.prefs.setSeriesLayoutStyle(
                                runCatching { VodLayoutStyle.valueOf(cp.seriesLayoutStyle) }
                                    .getOrDefault(VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC)
                            )
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        if (!waitForMerge) {
            container.appScope.launch { runMergeAndRetry() }
        }

        var activeAccount = localAccount
        if (activeAccount == null) {
            val restoreRes = withTimeoutOrNull(accountTimeoutMs) {
                container.userSyncService.restoreAccountsWithPin()
            } ?: CloudAccountRestoreResult.Empty
            when (restoreRes) {
                is CloudAccountRestoreResult.Restored -> {
                    val cloudAccounts = restoreRes.accounts
                    if (cloudAccounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                        cloudAccounts.asReversed().forEach { container.prefs.saveAccount(it) }
                        activeAccount = cloudAccounts.first()
                        container.prefs.setActiveAccount(activeAccount.id)
                    }
                    _needsSyncPinPrompt.value = false
                }
                is CloudAccountRestoreResult.NeedsPin,
                is CloudAccountRestoreResult.WrongPin -> {
                    _needsSyncPinPrompt.value = true
                }
                is CloudAccountRestoreResult.Empty -> {
                    _needsSyncPinPrompt.value = false
                }
            }
        }

        val activeId = activeAccount?.id
        if (!activeId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            container.prefs.migrateHistoryAccountIdIfNeeded(activeId)
        }

        if (waitForMerge) {
            runMergeAndRetry()
        }

        activeAccount
    }

    fun syncFcmToken(context: [REDACTED]
        if (container.authManager.currentUser == null) return
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        container.appScope.launch {
            val cached = [REDACTED]
            val token = [REDACTED]
                FirebaseMessaging.getInstance().token
                    .addOnSuccessListener { cont.resume(it) }
                    .addOnFailureListener { cont.resume(null) }
            }
            if (!token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                MyFirebaseMessagingService.savePendingToken(appContext, token)
                container.userSyncService.saveFcmToken(token)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * يوقف أي مزامنة خلفية نشطة وينتظر تحرير القفل قبل مسح البيانات أو تبديل الحساب.
     */
    suspend fun stopActiveSync() {
        val job = activeSyncJob
        activeSyncJob = null
        job?.cancelAndJoin()
    }

    /**
     * يشغّل سلسلة المزامنة الخلفية بالكامل للحساب النشط في [container.appScope] دون حجب الواجهة.
     */
    fun triggerFullSync(context: Context, forceCatalog: Boolean = false, reason: String = "startup") {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        val previous = activeSyncJob
        if (!forceCatalog && previous?.isActive == true) {
            return
        }
        activeSyncJob = container.appScope.launch {
            previous?.cancelAndJoin()
            runFullSync(appContext, forceCatalog = forceCatalog, reason = reason)
        }
    }

    /**
     * يشغّل المزامنة اليدوية من الإعدادات داخل [container.appScope] بحيث تستمر حتى لو أغلق المستخدم شاشة الإعدادات.
     */
    fun triggerManualSync(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        val previous = activeSyncJob
        activeSyncJob = container.appScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            previous?.cancelAndJoin()
            syncMutex.withLock {
                val msg = runCatching {
                    container.repo.syncCatalog(force = true)
                    container.catalogSync.syncMovies(container.repo)
                    val chStats = container.channelSync.sync(container.repo, forceFullRefresh = true)
                    if (chStats.isSuccess) container.prefs.setLastChannelSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis())

                    val epgStats = if (chStats.isSuccess || chStats.total > 0) {
                        container.epgSync.sync().also { st ->
                            if (st.isSuccess) container.prefs.setLastEpgSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis())
                        }
                    } else {
                        com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel.EpgSync.Stats(errors = listOf("skipped"))
                    }

                    buildString {
                        append("القنوات: ")
                        when {
                            chStats.isSuccess && chStats.total > 0 ->
                                append("${chStats.total} قناة (${chStats.enriched} بـ EPG)")
                            chStats.hasPartialFailure -> append("جزئي (${chStats.errors.size} خطأ)")
                            else -> append("فشل")
                        }
                        append("\nالبرامج: ")
                        when {
                            epgStats.isSuccess && epgStats.programsUpserted > 0 ->
                                append("${epgStats.programsUpserted} برنامج")
                            epgStats.hasPartialFailure -> append("جزئي (${epgStats.errors.size} خطأ)")
                            else -> append("فشل")
                        }
                    }
                }.getOrElse { err ->
                    "تعذر إتمام المزامنة: ${err.message ?: "خطأ غير متوقع"}"
                }
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    Toast.makeText(appContext, msg, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * ينفذ سلسلة المزامنة الكاملة بالترتيب:
     * 1) prewarmCatalog (+ البذرة) -> 2) syncCatalog -> 3) catalogSync.syncMovies ->
     * 4) channelSync.sync -> 5) epgSync.sync (يعمل فقط بعد channelSync ناجح).
     * كل خطوة تُسجّل وتفشل بمعزل دون إيقاف السلسلة.
     */
    suspend fun runFullSync(context: Context, forceCatalog: Boolean = false, reason: String = "startup") = syncMutex.withLock {
        container.prefs.migrateSyncKeysIfNeeded()

        runCatching {
            val stats = container.catalogSync.populateFromSeed(context)
            Log.d("SahabSeed", "[$reason] seed: total=${stats.total} loaded=${stats.loaded} skipped=${stats.wasSkipped} dur=${stats.durationMs}ms")
        }.onFailure { Log.w("SahabSeed", "[$reason] seed failed: ${it.message}") }

        if (!forceCatalog) {
            Log.d("SahabSync", "[$reason] step 1/5: prewarmCatalog")
            runCatching { container.repo.prewarmCatalog() }
                .onFailure { Log.w("SahabSync", "[$reason] prewarm failed: ${it.message}") }
        }

        Log.d("SahabSync", "[$reason] step 2/5: syncCatalog (force=$forceCatalog)")
        val sync = runCatching { container.repo.syncCatalog(force = forceCatalog) }
            .getOrElse { Repository.SyncResult.Failure(it.message ?: "unknown") }
        Log.d("SahabSync", "[$reason] step 2/5 result: $sync")

        val hasLocalCatalog = runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().count() > 0 }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (sync is Repository.SyncResult.Success || (sync is Repository.SyncResult.Skipped && hasLocalCatalog)) {
            Log.d("SahabSync", "[$reason] step 3/5: catalogSync.syncMovies")
            runCatching { container.catalogSync.syncMovies(container.repo) }
                .onSuccess { st -> Log.d("SahabSync", "[$reason] step 3/5 done: total=${st.total} ins=${st.inserted} upd=${st.updated}") }
                .onFailure { Log.w("SahabSync", "[$reason] step 3/5 failed: ${it.message}") }
        }

        val lastChSync = container.prefs.lastChannelSyncTime.first()
        val needChSync = forceCatalog || lastChSync == 0L || (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastChSync > 24L * 3600_000L)
        val chStats = if (needChSync) {
            Log.d("SahabChannelSync", "[$reason] step 4/5: channelSync.sync")
            runCatching { container.channelSync.sync(container.repo, forceFullRefresh = forceCatalog) }
                .onSuccess { st ->
                    Log.d("SahabChannelSync", "[$reason] total=${st.total} enriched=${st.enriched} errors=${st.errors.size}")
                    if (st.isSuccess) container.prefs.setLastChannelSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis())
                }
                .onFailure { Log.w("SahabChannelSync", "[$reason] step 4/5 failed: ${it.message}") }
                .getOrNull()
        } else null

        val lastEpgSync = container.prefs.lastEpgSyncTime.first()
        val updatedChSync = container.prefs.lastChannelSyncTime.first()
        val canRunEpg = (chStats?.isSuccess == true) || updatedChSync > 0L
        val needEpgSync = forceCatalog || lastEpgSync == 0L || (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastEpgSync > 24L * 3600_000L)
        if (canRunEpg && needEpgSync) {
            Log.d("SahabEpgSync", "[$reason] step 5/5: epgSync.sync")
            runCatching { container.epgSync.sync() }
                .onSuccess { epgStats ->
                    Log.d("SahabEpgSync", "[$reason] epgIds=${epgStats.epgIdsProcessed} upserted=${epgStats.programsUpserted} errors=${epgStats.errors.size}")
                    if (epgStats.isSuccess) container.prefs.setLastEpgSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis())
                }
                .onFailure { Log.w("SahabEpgSync", "[$reason] step 5/5 failed: ${it.message}") }
        }
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** A theme keeps its own visual edits so switching presets never overwrites another theme. */
@Serializable
data class ThemeCustomization(
    val colorOverrides: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    val fontFamily: String = "cairo",
    val fontScale: Float = 1f,
    val iconStyle: String = "plain",
    val iconScale: Float = 1f,
    val iconContainerShape: String = "rounded",
    val cornerRadius: Float = 20f,
    val glassOpacity: Float = 1f,
    val componentVisibility: Map<String, Boolean> = emptyMap(),
    val componentPlacement: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
)

@Serializable
data class ThemePreferences(
    val selectedThemeId: String = "cosmic_glass",
    val oledAccentPreset: String = "oled_cyan",
    val customizations: Map<String, ThemeCustomization> = emptyMap(),
) {
    fun customization(themeId: String = selectedThemeId): ThemeCustomization =
        customizations[themeId] ?: defaultThemeCustomization(themeId)
}

fun defaultThemeCustomization(themeId: String): ThemeCustomization = when (themeId) {
    "cosmic_glass_pro" -> ThemeCustomization(iconStyle = "outlined", iconContainerShape = "rounded", cornerRadius = 22f, glassOpacity = 0.92f)
    "oled_cinema" -> ThemeCustomization(iconStyle = "plain", iconContainerShape = "square", cornerRadius = 12f, glassOpacity = 1f)
    "dynamic_bento" -> ThemeCustomization(iconStyle = "filled", iconContainerShape = "rounded", cornerRadius = 28f, glassOpacity = 0.78f)
    else -> ThemeCustomization()
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.SerialName
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import okhttp3.Call
import okhttp3.Callback
import okhttp3.HttpUrl.Companion.toHttpUrl
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.Response
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.coroutines.resume

class TmdbApi(
    private val client: OkHttpClient,
    private val apiKey: [REDACTED]
    private val diskCache: DiskCache? = null,
) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
    private val memoryCacheLock = Any()
    private val memoryCache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, TmdbCacheEnvelope>(64, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, TmdbCacheEnvelope>?): Boolean =
            size > MAX_MEMORY_ENTRIES
    }

    private fun getCachedMemory(key: String): TmdbCacheEnvelope? = synchronized(memoryCacheLock) {
        memoryCache[key]
    }

    private fun putCachedMemory(key: String, value: TmdbCacheEnvelope) {
        synchronized(memoryCacheLock) {
            memoryCache[key] = value
        }
    }

    suspend fun enrichMovie(name: String, year: String): TmdbMovie? {
        if (apiKey.isBlank() || name.isBlank()) return null
        val cleanedName = cleanQueryTitle(name)
        if (cleanedName.isBlank()) return null
        val cleanYear = year.filter { it.isDigit() }.takeIf { it.length == 4 }.orEmpty()
        val cacheKey = "tmdb_v1:${cleanedName.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)}:$cleanYear"

        // 1. Memory cache check (0ms)
        getCachedMemory(cacheKey)?.let { return it.movie }

        // 2. Persistent disk cache check (saves free TMDB API quota across app restarts)
        if (diskCache != null) {
            val cached = diskCache.get(
                key = cacheKey,
                serializer = TmdbCacheEnvelope.serializer(),
                ttlMs = DiskCache.TTL_TMDB_MS,
                permanentNamespace = true,
            )
            if (cached != null) {
                // If it was a negative cache entry (not found), check shorter TTL (7 days).
                val ageOk = cached.found || (System.currentTimeMillis() - cached.savedAt) < DiskCache.TTL_TMDB_MISS_MS
                if (ageOk) {
                    putCachedMemory(cacheKey, cached)
                    return cached.movie
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Network call (only when never queried before)
        val searchOut = searchMovieOutcome(cleanedName, cleanYear.toIntOrNull(), "ar")
        if (searchOut is SearchOutcome.NetworkError || searchOut is SearchOutcome.MissingKey) {
            return null
        }
        val id = (searchOut as SearchOutcome.Ok).results.firstOrNull()?.id
        val details = if (id != null) getMovieDetails(id) else null
        if (id != null && details == null) {
            return null
        }
        val envelope = TmdbCacheEnvelope(
            found = details != null,
            savedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            movie = details,
        )
        putCachedMemory(cacheKey, envelope)
        diskCache?.put(
            key = cacheKey,
            serializer = TmdbCacheEnvelope.serializer(),
            value = envelope,
            permanentNamespace = true,
        )
        return details
    }

    /** Strips common IPTV tags ("AR:", "[4K]", "(2024)", "1080p", etc.) for cleaner TMDB matching. */
    private fun cleanQueryTitle(raw: String): String =
        raw.replace(PREFIX_TAG_REGEX, "")
            .replace(BRACKET_TAG_REGEX, " ")
            .replace(YEAR_PAREN_REGEX, " ")
            .replace(QUALITY_TAG_REGEX, " ")
            .replace(WHITESPACE_REGEX, " ")
            .trim()

    private val trimmedKey = [REDACTED]
    private val isBearerV4Token = [REDACTED]

    private suspend fun getMovieDetails(id: Int): TmdbMovie? {
        val urlBuilder = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/$id".toHttpUrl().newBuilder()
            .addQueryParameter("language", "ar")
            .addQueryParameter("append_to_response", "credits,images,videos")
            .addQueryParameter("include_image_language", "ar,en,null")
        if (!isBearerV4Token) {
            urlBuilder.addQueryParameter("api_key", trimmedKey)
        }
        val text = execute(urlBuilder.build().toString()) ?: return null
        return withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                val raw = json.decodeFromString<TmdbMovie>(text)
                val posters = buildPosterUrls(raw.posterPath, raw.images)
                val trailer = extractTrailerUrl(raw.videos)
                raw.copy(posterUrls = posters, trailerUrl = trailer)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun getTvDetailsById(id: Int): TmdbMovie? {
        val urlBuilder = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/tv/$id".toHttpUrl().newBuilder()
            .addQueryParameter("language", "ar")
            .addQueryParameter("append_to_response", "credits,images,videos")
            .addQueryParameter("include_image_language", "ar,en,null")
        if (!isBearerV4Token) {
            urlBuilder.addQueryParameter("api_key", trimmedKey)
        }
        val text = execute(urlBuilder.build().toString()) ?: return null
        return withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                val tv = json.decodeFromString<TmdbTvRaw>(text)
                val posters = buildPosterUrls(tv.posterPath, tv.images)
                val trailer = extractTrailerUrl(tv.videos)
                TmdbMovie(
                    id = tv.id,
                    title = tv.name,
                    overview = tv.overview,
                    releaseDate = tv.firstAirDate,
                    voteAverage = tv.voteAverage,
                    voteCount = tv.voteCount,
                    popularity = tv.popularity,
                    adult = false,
                    runtime = tv.episodeRunTime.firstOrNull(),
                    genres = tv.genres,
                    credits = tv.credits,
                    posterPath = tv.posterPath,
                    backdropPath = tv.backdropPath,
                    posterUrls = posters,
                    trailerUrl = trailer,
                )
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun buildPosterUrls(primaryPath: String?, images: TmdbImagesResponse?): List<String> {
        val paths = buildList {
            primaryPath?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { add(it) }
            images?.posters.orEmpty().mapNotNull { it.filePath?.takeIf { p -> p.isNotBlank() } }.forEach { add(it) }
        }.distinct()
        return paths.map { "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w500$it" }
    }

    private fun extractTrailerUrl(videos: TmdbVideosResponse?): String {
        val list = videos?.results.orEmpty()
        val ytTrailer = list.firstOrNull {
            it.site.equals("YouTube", ignoreCase = true) && it.type.equals("Trailer", ignoreCase = true) && it.key.isNotBlank()
        } ?: list.firstOrNull {
            it.site.equals("YouTube", ignoreCase = true) && it.key.isNotBlank()
        }
        return ytTrailer?.let { "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${it.key}" } ?: ""
    }

    private suspend fun execute(url: String): String? = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
        val reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(url)
        if (isBearerV4Token) {
            reqBuilder.addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $trimmedKey")
        }
        val call = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build())
        cont.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }
        call.enqueue(object : Callback {
            override fun onFailure(call: Call, e: IOException) {
                if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(null)
            }

            override fun onResponse(call: Call, response: Response) {
                response.use {
                    if (it.isSuccessful) {
                        if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(it.body?.string())
                    } else {
                        if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(null)
                    }
                }
            }
        })
    }

    /**
     * Raw search — returns full result objects (not just IDs).
     * Used by TmdbMatcher to score candidates.
     */
    sealed class SearchOutcome {
        data class Ok(val results: List<TmdbSearchResult>) : SearchOutcome()
        object NetworkError : SearchOutcome()
        object MissingKey : SearchOutcome()
    }

    fun hasApiKey(): Boolean = [REDACTED]

    suspend fun searchMovieOutcome(
        query: String,
        year: Int?,
        lang: String = "en-US",
    ): SearchOutcome {
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) return SearchOutcome.MissingKey
        if (query.isBlank()) return SearchOutcome.Ok(emptyList())
        val urlBuilder = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/movie".toHttpUrl().newBuilder()
            .addQueryParameter("query", query)
            .addQueryParameter("language", lang)
            .addQueryParameter("include_adult", "false")
        if (!isBearerV4Token) urlBuilder.addQueryParameter("api_key", trimmedKey)
        if (year != null) urlBuilder.addQueryParameter("primary_release_year", year.toString())
        val text = execute(urlBuilder.build().toString()) ?: return SearchOutcome.NetworkError
        val list = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                json.decodeFromString<RawSearchResponse>(text).results
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                null
            }
        } ?: return SearchOutcome.NetworkError
        return SearchOutcome.Ok(list)
    }

    suspend fun searchMovieRaw(
        query: String,
        year: Int?,
        lang: String = "en-US",
    ): List<TmdbSearchResult> = when (val out = searchMovieOutcome(query, year, lang)) {
        is SearchOutcome.Ok -> out.results
        else -> emptyList()
    }

    suspend fun searchTvOutcome(
        query: String,
        year: Int?,
        lang: String = "en-US",
    ): SearchOutcome {
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) return SearchOutcome.MissingKey
        if (query.isBlank()) return SearchOutcome.Ok(emptyList())
        val urlBuilder = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/tv".toHttpUrl().newBuilder()
            .addQueryParameter("query", query)
            .addQueryParameter("language", lang)
            .addQueryParameter("include_adult", "false")
        if (!isBearerV4Token) urlBuilder.addQueryParameter("api_key", trimmedKey)
        if (year != null) urlBuilder.addQueryParameter("first_air_date_year", year.toString())
        val text = execute(urlBuilder.build().toString()) ?: return SearchOutcome.NetworkError
        val list = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                json.decodeFromString<TvSearchResponse>(text).results.map { item ->
                    TmdbSearchResult(
                        id = item.id,
                        title = item.name,
                        originalTitle = item.originalName,
                        releaseDate = item.firstAirDate,
                        voteCount = item.voteCount,
                        popularity = item.popularity,
                        adult = false,
                    )
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                null
            }
        } ?: return SearchOutcome.NetworkError
        return SearchOutcome.Ok(list)
    }

    /** Public alias for getMovieDetails — used by TmdbMatcher. */
    suspend fun getMovieDetailsById(id: Int): TmdbMovie? = getMovieDetails(id)

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_MEMORY_ENTRIES = 200
        val PREFIX_TAG_REGEX = Regex("^[A-Za-z]{2,4}\\s*[:|\\-]\\s*")
        val BRACKET_TAG_REGEX = Regex("\\[[^]]*]")
        val YEAR_PAREN_REGEX = Regex("\\((19|20)\\d{2}\\)")
        val QUALITY_TAG_REGEX = Regex("\\b(4K|UHD|FHD|HD|1080p|720p|BluRay|WEB-DL|WEBRip|x264|x265|HEVC)\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
        val WHITESPACE_REGEX = Regex("\\s+")
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import com.saydlawy.sahab.util.Ar
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.ExperimentalSerializationApi
import kotlinx.serialization.json.DecodeSequenceMode
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.decodeToSequence
import okhttp3.Call
import okhttp3.Callback
import okhttp3.HttpUrl.Companion.toHttpUrl
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.Response
import java.io.BufferedInputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.PushbackInputStream
import java.net.ConnectException
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException
import java.net.UnknownHostException
import javax.net.ssl.SSLException
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

/** An error whose message is already written in Arabic and safe to show to the user. */
class ApiException(message: String) : Exception(message)

class XtreamApi(private val client: OkHttpClient) {

    suspend fun request(
        account: Account,
        action: String?,
        params: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    ): JsonElement {
        val url = buildUrl(account, action, params)
        val text = client.newCall(Request.Builder().url(url).build()).awaitBody()
        return withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                ApiJson.parseToJsonElement(text)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                throw ApiException(Ar.errBadResponse)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Streams huge Xtream array responses (channels / VOD / series) directly from OkHttp's
     * response body without buffering a multi-megabyte String + JsonArray DOM in heap.
     */
    suspend fun <T> streamArray(
        account: Account,
        action: String?,
        params: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
        onEmptyOrNonArray: () -> T,
        parseStream: (InputStream) -> T,
    ): T {
        val url = buildUrl(account, action, params)
        return client.newCall(Request.Builder().url(url).build()).awaitStream { rawStream ->
            val pb = PushbackInputStream(BufferedInputStream(rawStream, 64 * 1024), 4)
            var next = pb.read()
            while (next != -1 && next <= ' '.code) {
                next = pb.read()
            }
            if (next == -1) {
                onEmptyOrNonArray()
            } else if (next != '['.code) {
                // Non-array error/empty object response — drain safely on non-array without throwing DOM errors
                onEmptyOrNonArray()
            } else {
                pb.unread(next)
                try {
                    parseStream(pb)
                } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                    throw e
                } catch (e: IOException) {
                    throw e
                } catch (e: ApiException) {
                    throw e
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    throw ApiException(Ar.errBadResponse)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalSerializationApi::class)
    internal inline fun <reified D> decodeArraySequence(stream: InputStream): Sequence<D> =
        ApiJson.decodeToSequence(stream, DecodeSequenceMode.ARRAY_WRAPPED)

    private fun buildUrl(
        account: Account,
        action: String?,
        params: Map<String, String>,
    ): okhttp3.HttpUrl {
        val base = try {
            "${account.server}/player_api.php".toHttpUrl()
        } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
            throw ApiException(Ar.errBadUrl)
        }
        return base.newBuilder().apply {
            addQueryParameter("username", account.user)
            addQueryParameter("password", account.pass)
            if (action != null) addQueryParameter("action", action)
            params.forEach { (k, v) -> addQueryParameter(k, v) }
        }.build()
    }

    private suspend fun <T> Call.awaitStream(reader: (InputStream) -> T): T =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            cont.invokeOnCancellation { runCatching { cancel() } }
            enqueue(object : Callback {
                override fun onFailure(call: Call, e: IOException) {
                    cont.resumeWithException(mapIo(e))
                }

                override fun onResponse(call: Call, response: Response) {
                    response.use { r ->
                        if (!r.isSuccessful) {
                            cont.resumeWithException(ApiException(Ar.errServer(r.code)))
                            return
                        }
                        try {
                            val stream = r.body?.byteStream()
                            val value = if (stream != null) reader(stream) else reader("".byteInputStream())
                            cont.resume(value)
                        } catch (e: ApiException) {
                            cont.resumeWithException(e)
                        } catch (e: IOException) {
                            cont.resumeWithException(mapIo(e))
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            cont.resumeWithException(ApiException(Ar.errBadResponse))
                        }
                    }
                }
            })
        }

    private suspend fun Call.awaitBody(): String = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
        cont.invokeOnCancellation { runCatching { cancel() } }
        enqueue(object : Callback {
            override fun onFailure(call: Call, e: IOException) {
                cont.resumeWithException(mapIo(e))
            }

            override fun onResponse(call: Call, response: Response) {
                response.use { r ->
                    if (!r.isSuccessful) {
                        cont.resumeWithException(ApiException(Ar.errServer(r.code)))
                        return
                    }
                    try {
                        cont.resume(r.body?.string().orEmpty())
                    } catch (e: IOException) {
                        cont.resumeWithException(mapIo(e))
                    }
                }
            }
        })
    }

    private fun mapIo(e: IOException): ApiException = when (e) {
        is UnknownHostException, is ConnectException -> ApiException(Ar.errUnreachable)
        is SocketTimeoutException -> ApiException(Ar.errTimeout)
        is SSLException -> ApiException(Ar.errSsl)
        else -> ApiException(Ar.errNetwork)
    }
}
