=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/catalog/CatalogMovieEntity.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog

import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.Index
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey
import java.security.MessageDigest
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * Unified movie catalog — Nova (Xtream) metadata + TMDB enrichment merged.
 *
 * sahabId states:
 *   "pending:{novaStreamId}"  → not yet enriched
 *   "tmdb:{tmdbId}"           → successfully matched with TMDB
 *   "local:{hash}"            → TMDB match failed after retries
 *
 * needsEnrichment:
 *   1  = pending (will be tried)
 *   0  = done
 *  -1  = permanently failed (skip)
 */
@Serializable
@Entity(
    tableName = "catalog_movies",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["mediaType", "novaStreamId"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["categoryId", "novaAdded"]),
        Index(value = ["needsEnrichment", "novaAdded"]),
        Index(value = ["tmdbId"]),
        Index(value = ["lastSeen"]),
        Index(value = ["deleted"]),
    ],
)
data class CatalogMovieEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val sahabId: String,
    val novaStreamId: String,
    val categoryId: String = "",
    val titleAr: String = "",
    val titleEn: String = "",
    val year: String = "",
    val plot: String = "",
    val plotSource: String = "",
    val plotConfidence: String = "",
    val identifiedTitle: String = "",
    val mediaType: String = "movie",
    val cast: String = "",
    val director: String = "",
    val genre: String = "",
    val runtime: String = "",
    val rating: String = "",
    val posterUrl: String = "",
    val backdropUrl: String = "",
    val postersJson: String = "",
    val trailerUrl: String = "",
    val imdbId: String = "",
    val novaAdded: Long = 0L,
    val containerExtension: String = "m3u8",
    val isAdult: Int = 0,
    val tmdbId: Int? = null,
    val tmdbVoteCount: Int? = null,
    val needsEnrichment: Int = 1,
    val lastEnriched: Long = 0L,
    val lastSeen: Long = 0L,
    val deleted: Int = 0,
) {
    val displayTitle: String
        get() = titleAr.ifBlank { titleEn }

    companion object {
        fun idPending(streamId: String): String = "pending:$streamId"
        fun idFromTmdb(tmdbId: Int): String = "tmdb:$tmdbId"
        fun idLocal(name: String, year: String): String {
            val raw = "${name.lowercase().trim()}|${year.trim()}"
            val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                .digest(raw.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            return "local:" + digest.take(8).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/catalog/CatalogSync.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog

import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.DEFAULT_VOD_EXT

import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Poster
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Repository
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.Locale
import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream

/**
 * Syncs Nova (Xtream) movies into the local Room catalog.
 *
 * Design:
 *  - Reads posters via Repository.movies(null) (respects existing cache/network logic)
 *  - Reads categories via Repository.movieCategories() (for year extraction)
 *  - Batches upserts (500 rows) to avoid memory spikes
 *  - Preserves existing enrichment (does not overwrite titleEn/plot/cast/etc.)
 *  - Soft-deletes movies that disappeared from Nova
 *  - Tracks its own `syncing` StateFlow (separate from Repository)
 */
class CatalogSync(
    private val dao: CatalogMovieDao,
    private val firebaseCatalog: FirebaseCatalogService,
) {
    data class Stats(
        val total: Int = 0,
        val inserted: Int = 0,
        val updated: Int = 0,
        val deleted: Int = 0,
        val durationMs: Long = 0L,
    )

    private val _syncing = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val syncing: StateFlow<Boolean> = _syncing

    suspend fun syncMovies(repo: Repository): Stats = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!_syncing.compareAndSet(expect = false, update = true)) return@withContext Stats()
        val start = System.currentTimeMillis()
        try {
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()

            // 1. Fetch categories (for year extraction from category name)
            val categories: Map<String, String> = runCatching {
                repo.movieCategories().associate { it.id to it.name }
            }.getOrElse { emptyMap() }

            // 2. Fetch posters (uses Repository cache; goes to Nova only if needed)
            val posters: List<Poster> = runCatching {
                repo.movies(null)
            }.getOrElse { emptyList() }

            if (posters.isEmpty()) {
                return@withContext Stats(durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start)
            }

            // 3. Existing stream IDs — to decide upsert vs touch
            val existing: Set<String> = dao.allStreamIds().toHashSet()

            var inserted = 0
            var updated = 0

            // 4. Process in batches of 500 (SQLite parameter limit ~999)
            posters.chunked(BATCH_SIZE).forEach { batch ->
                val newEntities = mutableListOf<CatalogMovieEntity>()
                val existingInBatch = mutableListOf<String>()

                batch.forEach { p ->
                    if (p.id in existing) {
                        existingInBatch.add(p.id)
                        updated++
                    } else {
                        newEntities.add(buildEntity(p, categories[p.categoryId] ?: "", now))
                        inserted++
                    }
                }

                if (existingInBatch.isNotEmpty()) {
                    dao.touchBulk(existingInBatch, now)
                }
                if (newEntities.isNotEmpty()) {
                    dao.upsertAll(newEntities)
                    newEntities.forEach { entity ->
                        runCatching { firebaseCatalog.saveCatalogItem(entity) }
                    }
                }
            }

            // 5. Soft-delete stale (movies not seen for >24h)
            val deleted = dao.softDeleteBefore(cutoff = now - STALE_CUTOFF_MS)

            Stats(
                total = posters.size,
                inserted = inserted,
                updated = updated,
                deleted = deleted,
                durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
            )
        } finally {
            _syncing.value = false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Enriches a single movie. Fetches from TMDB via TmdbMatcher, applies to Room.
     * Safe to call from ViewModel. Does nothing if already enriched or marked failed.
     */
    data class SeedStats(
        val total: Int = 0,
        val loaded: Int = 0,
        val durationMs: Long = 0L,
        val wasSkipped: Boolean = false,
    )

    /**
     * Reads catalog_seed.json.gz from assets and populates Room.
     * Skips if DB already has enrichment (dbCount > 1000 AND enrichedCount > 100).
     * Uses batched upserts (500) to stay under SQLite limits.
     * Sets _syncing flag so SyncOverlay shows the operation.
     */
    suspend fun populateFromSeed(context: Context): SeedStats = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!_syncing.compareAndSet(expect = false, update = true)) return@withContext SeedStats(wasSkipped = true)
        val start = System.currentTimeMillis()
        try {
            val dbCount = dao.observeCount().first()
            val enrichedCount = dao.countEnriched()
            if (dbCount > 1000 && enrichedCount > 100) {
                return@withContext SeedStats(
                    total = dbCount,
                    wasSkipped = true,
                    durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                )
            }

            val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
            var total = 0
            var loaded = 0

            try {
                // AAPT2/workflow may unpack .gz during build, producing
                // "catalog_seed.json" (uncompressed) inside the APK.
                // Try .json first, fall back to original .gz name.
                val stream: java.io.InputStream = runCatching {
                    context.assets.open("databases/catalog_seed.json")
                }.getOrElse {
                    GZIPInputStream(context.assets.open("databases/catalog_seed.json.gz"))
                }
                stream.bufferedReader().use { reader ->
                    val batch = mutableListOf<CatalogMovieEntity>()
                    var line: String? = reader.readLine()
                    while (line != null) {
                        val trimmed = line.trim()
                        if (trimmed.isNotEmpty()) {
                            total++
                            try {
                                val entity = json.decodeFromString<CatalogMovieEntity>(trimmed)
                                batch.add(entity)
                                if (batch.size >= 500) {
                                    dao.upsertAll(batch)
                                    loaded += batch.size
                                    batch.clear()
                                }
                            } catch (_: Exception) {
                                // Skip malformed line
                            }
                        }
                        line = reader.readLine()
                    }
                    if (batch.isNotEmpty()) {
                        dao.upsertAll(batch)
                        loaded += batch.size
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: java.io.FileNotFoundException) {
                android.util.Log.e("SahabSeed", "catalog_seed.json.gz NOT FOUND in assets — skipping seed load, falling back to lazy enrichment", e)
                return@withContext SeedStats(wasSkipped = true, durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                android.util.Log.e("SahabSeed", "seed load failed — falling back to lazy enrichment", e)
                return@withContext SeedStats(wasSkipped = true, durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start)
            }

            SeedStats(
                total = total,
                loaded = loaded,
                durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
            )
        } finally {
            _syncing.value = false
        }
    }

    suspend fun enrichOne(
        repo: Repository,
        tmdb: com.saydlawy.sahab.data.TmdbApi,
        streamId: String,
        force: Boolean = false,
        mediaType: String = "movie",
    ): com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.EnrichResult? {
        val normalizedType = mediaType.ifBlank { "movie" }
        val existing = dao.findByStreamId(streamId, normalizedType) ?: return null
        if (!force && (existing.needsEnrichment == 0 || existing.needsEnrichment == -1)) return null

        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        // WEAK match retry gate: if we tried in the last 24h, skip (avoid re-hitting TMDB on every reopen)
        if (!force && existing.needsEnrichment == 1 && existing.lastEnriched > 0L &&
            (now - existing.lastEnriched) < 24L * 3600_000L
        ) {
            return null
        }

        // 1. البحث في السحابة (Firebase) أولاً لتفادي استدعاء TMDB إذا كانت البيانات موجودة سحابياً
        val cloudLookupId = existing.tmdbId?.takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { CatalogMovieEntity.idFromTmdb(it) }
            ?: existing.sahabId
        val cloudData = firebaseCatalog.getCatalogItem(cloudLookupId)
        if (cloudData != null && cloudData.plot.isNotBlank()) {
            dao.applyEnrichment(
                streamId = streamId,
                tmdbId = cloudData.tmdbId,
                titleEn = cloudData.titleEn,
                year = cloudData.year,
                plot = cloudData.plot,
                cast = cloudData.cast,
                director = cloudData.director,
                genre = cloudData.genre,
                runtime = cloudData.runtime,
                rating = cloudData.rating,
                backdropUrl = cloudData.backdropUrl,
                voteCount = cloudData.tmdbVoteCount,
                status = 0,
                now = now,
                mediaType = normalizedType,
                postersJson = cloudData.postersJson,
                trailerUrl = cloudData.trailerUrl,
            )
            return null // تم الإثراء من Firebase بنجاح دون استدعاء TMDB
        }
        if (!tmdb.hasApiKey()) return null

        val catName = runCatching {
            val cats = if (normalizedType.equals("series", ignoreCase = true)) {
                repo.seriesCategories()
            } else {
                repo.movieCategories()
            }
            cats.firstOrNull { it.id == existing.categoryId }?.name ?: ""
        }.getOrElse { "" }

        val novaYear = existing.year.toIntOrNull()
        val result = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.enrich(
            tmdb = tmdb,
            rawName = existing.titleAr,
            categoryName = catName,
            novaYear = novaYear,
            mediaType = normalizedType,
        )

        val movie = result.movie
        if (result.level == com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG && movie != null) {
            val newId = CatalogMovieEntity.idFromTmdb(movie.id)
            dao.applyEnrichment(
                streamId = streamId,
                tmdbId = movie.id,
                titleEn = movie.title,
                year = movie.releaseDate.take(4),
                plot = movie.overview,
                cast = movie.credits?.cast?.take(5)?.joinToString(", ") { it.name } ?: "",
                director = movie.credits?.crew?.firstOrNull { it.job == "Director" }?.name ?: "",
                genre = movie.genres.joinToString(", ") { it.name },
                runtime = movie.runtime?.let { "${it}m" } ?: "",
                rating = if (movie.voteAverage > 0) String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", movie.voteAverage) else "",
                backdropUrl = movie.backdropPath?.let { "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w780$it" } ?: "",
                voteCount = movie.voteCount,
                status = 0,
                now = now,
                mediaType = normalizedType,
                postersJson = movie.posterUrls.joinToString("\n"),
                trailerUrl = movie.trailerUrl,
            )
            if (existing.sahabId.startsWith("pending:")) {
                runCatching { firebaseCatalog.linkPendingAliasToTmdb(streamId, newId, existing.titleAr) }
            }
            runCatching {
                dao.findByStreamId(streamId, normalizedType)?.let { enrichedEntity ->
                    firebaseCatalog.saveCatalogItem(enrichedEntity)
                }
            }
        } else if (result.level == com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.Level.WEAK && movie != null) {
            // Weak match — store data in Room & Firebase but keep needsEnrichment=1 for potential retry
            dao.applyEnrichment(
                streamId = streamId,
                tmdbId = movie.id,
                titleEn = movie.title,
                year = movie.releaseDate.take(4),
                plot = movie.overview,
                cast = movie.credits?.cast?.take(5)?.joinToString(", ") { it.name } ?: "",
                director = movie.credits?.crew?.firstOrNull { it.job == "Director" }?.name ?: "",
                genre = movie.genres.joinToString(", ") { it.name },
                runtime = movie.runtime?.let { "${it}m" } ?: "",
                rating = if (movie.voteAverage > 0) String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", movie.voteAverage) else "",
                backdropUrl = movie.backdropPath?.let { "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w780$it" } ?: "",
                voteCount = movie.voteCount,
                status = 1,
                now = now,
                mediaType = normalizedType,
                postersJson = movie.posterUrls.joinToString("\n"),
                trailerUrl = movie.trailerUrl,
            )
            runCatching {
                dao.findByStreamId(streamId, normalizedType)?.let { enrichedEntity ->
                    firebaseCatalog.saveCatalogItem(enrichedEntity)
                }
            }
        } else if (
            result.level == com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.Level.NETWORK_ERROR ||
            (movie == null && (result.level == com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG ||
                result.level == com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.TmdbMatcher.Level.WEAK))
        ) {
            // Transient network/key error or details fetch failed — keep needsEnrichment=1 to retry later.
        } else {
            dao.markFailed(streamId, now, normalizedType)
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun buildEntity(
        p: Poster,
        categoryName: String,
        now: Long,
    ): CatalogMovieEntity {
        val year = extractYear(p.name, categoryName)
        return CatalogMovieEntity(
            sahabId = CatalogMovieEntity.idPending(p.id),
            novaStreamId = p.id,
            categoryId = p.categoryId,
            titleAr = p.name,
            year = year,
            posterUrl = p.image,
            novaAdded = p.added,
            containerExtension = p.ext.ifBlank { DEFAULT_VOD_EXT },
            needsEnrichment = 1,
            lastSeen = now,
            deleted = 0,
        )
    }

    /**
     * Prefer trailing year (avoids extracting 1917 from title "1917").
     * Falls back to category name, then empty.
     */
    private fun extractYear(name: String, categoryName: String): String {
        val matches = YEAR_REGEX.findAll(name).toList()
        if (matches.isNotEmpty()) {
            val endThreshold = maxOf(0, name.length - 25)
            val trailing = matches.filter { it.range.first >= endThreshold }
            if (trailing.isNotEmpty()) return trailing.last().value
        }
        return YEAR_REGEX.find(categoryName)?.value ?: ""
    }

    companion object {
        private const val BATCH_SIZE = 500
        private const val STALE_CUTOFF_MS = 24L * 3600_000L
        private val YEAR_REGEX = Regex("""\b(19[2-9]\d|20[0-3]\d)\b""")
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/catalog/FirebaseCatalogService.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog

import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldValue
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.Query
import com.google.firebase.firestore.SetOptions
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.DEFAULT_VOD_EXT
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Poster
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Repository
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.supervisorScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.coroutines.resume

class FirebaseCatalogService {
    private val db = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance()
    private val collection = db.collection("global_catalog")

    @Volatile
    private var cachedRecommendedMovies: List<CatalogMovieEntity> = emptyList()

    fun peekCachedRecommendedMovies(): List<CatalogMovieEntity> = cachedRecommendedMovies

    suspend fun getCatalogItem(sahabId: String): CatalogMovieEntity? {
        val direct = fetchDocById(sahabId)
        if (direct != null) return direct
        if (sahabId.startsWith("pending:")) {
            return queryByAlias(sahabId)
        }
        return null
    }

    private suspend fun fetchDocById(docId: String, allowRedirect: Boolean = true): CatalogMovieEntity? =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            collection.document(docId).get()
                .addOnSuccessListener { snapshot ->
                    if (!snapshot.exists()) {
                        cont.resume(null)
                        return@addOnSuccessListener
                    }
                    val redirectTarget = snapshot.getString("redirectTo")?.takeIf {
                        it.isNotBlank() && it != docId && it.startsWith("tmdb:")
                    }
                    if (allowRedirect && redirectTarget != null) {
                        collection.document(redirectTarget).get()
                            .addOnSuccessListener { targetSnap ->
                                if (targetSnap.exists()) {
                                    cont.resume(mapToEntity(redirectTarget, targetSnap.data ?: emptyMap()))
                                } else {
                                    cont.resume(mapToEntity(docId, snapshot.data ?: emptyMap()))
                                }
                            }
                            .addOnFailureListener {
                                cont.resume(mapToEntity(docId, snapshot.data ?: emptyMap()))
                            }
                    } else {
                        cont.resume(mapToEntity(docId, snapshot.data ?: emptyMap()))
                    }
                }
                .addOnFailureListener {
                    cont.resume(null)
                }
        }

    private suspend fun queryByAlias(aliasId: String): CatalogMovieEntity? =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            collection.whereArrayContains("aliases", aliasId)
                .limit(1)
                .get()
                .addOnSuccessListener { query ->
                    val doc = query.documents.firstOrNull()
                    if (doc != null && doc.exists()) {
                        cont.resume(mapToEntity(doc.id, doc.data ?: emptyMap()))
                    } else {
                        cont.resume(null)
                    }
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { cont.resume(null) }
        }

    /**
     * Queries Firebase `global_catalog` for recently enriched / newest items.
     */
    suspend fun getTrendingMovies(limit: Long = 18): List<CatalogMovieEntity> = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
        collection
            .orderBy("tmdbVoteCount", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .limit(limit * 2)
            .get()
            .addOnSuccessListener { snapshot ->
                val list = snapshot.documents
                    .mapNotNull { doc ->
                        try {
                            mapToEntity(doc.id, doc.data ?: emptyMap())
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            null
                        }
                    }
                    .filter { m -> m.year >= "2024" }
                    .take(limit.toInt())
                cont.resume(list)
            }
            .addOnFailureListener {
                cont.resume(emptyList())
            }
    }

    /**
     * PHASE 1 (INSTANT < 20ms): Returns the newest added movies immediately from memory/disk/Room
     * without waiting for any network or Firestore round-trip, so HomeScreen renders immediately.
     */
    suspend fun getInstantRecommendedMovies(
        repo: Repository,
        dao: CatalogMovieDao,
        limit: Int = 18,
    ): List<CatalogMovieEntity> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (cachedRecommendedMovies.isNotEmpty()) {
            return@withContext cachedRecommendedMovies.take(limit)
        }

        val memMovies = repo.peekAllMovies()
            ?.filter { it.id.isNotBlank() && it.image.isNotBlank() }
            .orEmpty()

        if (memMovies.isNotEmpty()) {
            val newestPosters = sortNewestXtreamAdditions(memMovies, limit)
            val streamIds = newestPosters.map { it.id }
            val roomByStreamId = runCatching {
                dao.findByStreamIds(streamIds).associateBy { it.novaStreamId }
            }.getOrNull().orEmpty()

            val fastList = newestPosters.map { poster ->
                mergeXtreamAndCatalog(
                    poster = poster,
                    fb = null,
                    room = roomByStreamId[poster.id],
                )
            }
            if (fastList.isNotEmpty()) {
                cachedRecommendedMovies = fastList
                return@withContext fastList
            }
        }

        // Fallback to Room's recently added table (novaAdded DESC) while Xtream cache warms up
        val roomRecent = runCatching {
            dao.getRecentlyAdded(limit * 2)
                .filter { it.novaStreamId.isNotBlank() && it.posterUrl.isNotBlank() }
                .take(limit)
        }.getOrNull().orEmpty()

        if (roomRecent.isNotEmpty()) {
            cachedRecommendedMovies = roomRecent
        }
        roomRecent
    }

    /**
     * PHASE 2: Selects movies strictly based on the NEWEST ADDITIONS (`أحدث الإضافات فقط`)
     * from the active Xtream server (`poster.added DESC` & `stream_id DESC`) and enriches them
     * with real metadata from the local synced Room DB + Firebase `global_catalog`.
     */
    suspend fun getXtreamRecommendedMovies(
        repo: Repository,
        dao: CatalogMovieDao,
        limit: Int = 18,
    ): List<CatalogMovieEntity> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val xtreamMovies: List<Poster> = runCatching {
            repo.peekAllMovies() ?: repo.movies(null)
        }.getOrNull().orEmpty().filter { it.id.isNotBlank() && it.image.isNotBlank() }

        if (xtreamMovies.isEmpty()) {
            val fallback = runCatching { dao.getRecentlyAdded(limit) }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
            if (fallback.isNotEmpty()) cachedRecommendedMovies = fallback
            return@withContext fallback
        }

        // Strictly sort by newest additions on the Xtream server (added timestamp DESC, then numeric stream_id DESC)
        val newestPosters = sortNewestXtreamAdditions(xtreamMovies, limit)
        val candidateIds = newestPosters.map { it.id }

        val roomByStreamId = runCatching {
            dao.findByStreamIds(candidateIds).associateBy { it.novaStreamId }
        }.getOrNull().orEmpty()

        // Emit immediate local merge to cache so UI is already populated
        val initialMerged = newestPosters.map { poster ->
            mergeXtreamAndCatalog(
                poster = poster,
                fb = null,
                room = roomByStreamId[poster.id],
            )
        }
        if (initialMerged.isNotEmpty()) {
            cachedRecommendedMovies = initialMerged
        }

        // Enrich with live Firebase `global_catalog` documents in parallel (bounded to 2000ms)
        val fbByStreamId: Map<String, CatalogMovieEntity?> = withTimeoutOrNull(2000L) {
            supervisorScope {
                newestPosters.map { poster ->
                    async {
                        val roomItem = roomByStreamId[poster.id]
                        // If Room already has rich plot & genre from Firebase seed/sync, avoid redundant network call
                        if (roomItem != null && roomItem.plot.isNotBlank() && roomItem.genre.isNotBlank()) {
                            poster.id to roomItem
                        } else {
                            val lookupSahabId = roomItem?.sahabId ?: CatalogMovieEntity.idPending(poster.id)
                            val fbItem = runCatching { getCatalogItem(lookupSahabId) }.getOrNull()
                            poster.id to fbItem
                        }
                    }
                }.awaitAll().toMap()
            }
        }.orEmpty()

        val finalResults = ArrayList<CatalogMovieEntity>(newestPosters.size)
        val usedStreamIds = HashSet<String>()

        for (poster in newestPosters) {
            if (!usedStreamIds.add(poster.id)) continue
            val roomItem = roomByStreamId[poster.id]
            val fbItem = fbByStreamId[poster.id]
            finalResults.add(
                mergeXtreamAndCatalog(
                    poster = poster,
                    fb = fbItem,
                    room = roomItem,
                ),
            )
        }

        if (finalResults.isNotEmpty()) {
            cachedRecommendedMovies = finalResults
        }
        finalResults
    }

    /**
     * Sorts Xtream VOD streams strictly by newest additions (`added` timestamp DESC,
     * then numeric `id` DESC, deduplicated by normalized title) using bounded top-K selection.
     */
    private fun sortNewestXtreamAdditions(
        movies: List<Poster>,
        limit: Int,
    ): List<Poster> {
        if (limit <= 0 || movies.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val poolCap = (limit * 5).coerceAtLeast(limit)
        data class Ranked(val poster: Poster, val numericId: Long)
        val cmp = Comparator<Ranked> { a, b ->
            val c = a.poster.added.compareTo(b.poster.added)
            if (c != 0) c else a.numericId.compareTo(b.numericId)
        }
        val minHeap = java.util.PriorityQueue<Ranked>(poolCap + 1, cmp)
        for (p in movies) {
            if (minHeap.size >= poolCap) {
                val weakest = minHeap.peek()!!
                if (p.added < weakest.poster.added) continue
                val pNum = p.id.toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
                if (p.added == weakest.poster.added && pNum <= weakest.numericId) continue
                minHeap.poll()
                minHeap.add(Ranked(p, pNum))
            } else {
                minHeap.add(Ranked(p, p.id.toLongOrNull() ?: 0L))
            }
        }
        val topCandidates = minHeap.sortedWith(cmp.reversed())
        val selected = ArrayList<Poster>(limit)
        val seenTitles = HashSet<String>(limit * 2)
        for (entry in topCandidates) {
            if (selected.size >= limit) break
            val poster = entry.poster
            val norm = normalizeTitle(poster.name).ifBlank { poster.id }
            if (seenTitles.add(norm)) {
                selected.add(poster)
            }
        }
        return selected
    }

    private fun mergeXtreamAndCatalog(
        poster: Poster,
        fb: CatalogMovieEntity?,
        room: CatalogMovieEntity?,
    ): CatalogMovieEntity {
        val cleanXtreamName = cleanDisplayTitle(poster.name)
        val bestTitle = fb?.titleEn?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && anyArabic(it) }
            ?: fb?.titleAr?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: room?.titleEn?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && anyArabic(it) }
            ?: cleanXtreamName.ifBlank { poster.name }
        val bestRating = fb?.rating?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "0" && it != "0.0" }
            ?: room?.rating?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "0" && it != "0.0" }
            ?: poster.rating.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "0" && it != "0.0" }
            ?: ""
        val bestYear = fb?.year?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: room?.year?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: poster.year
        val bestGenre = fb?.genre?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: room?.genre?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: "أحدث الإضافات"
        val bestPlot = fb?.plot?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: room?.plot?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: ""
        // Always prefer the active Xtream server's live poster URL
        val bestPoster = poster.image.ifBlank {
            fb?.backdropUrl?.ifBlank { null }
                ?: room?.backdropUrl?.ifBlank { null }
                ?: fb?.posterUrl.orEmpty()
        }

        return CatalogMovieEntity(
            sahabId = fb?.sahabId ?: room?.sahabId ?: CatalogMovieEntity.idPending(poster.id),
            novaStreamId = poster.id,
            categoryId = poster.categoryId,
            titleAr = bestTitle,
            titleEn = fb?.titleEn ?: room?.titleEn.orEmpty(),
            year = bestYear,
            plot = bestPlot,
            genre = bestGenre,
            runtime = fb?.runtime ?: room?.runtime.orEmpty(),
            rating = bestRating,
            posterUrl = bestPoster,
            backdropUrl = fb?.backdropUrl ?: room?.backdropUrl.orEmpty(),
            novaAdded = poster.added,
            containerExtension = poster.ext.ifBlank { DEFAULT_VOD_EXT },
            tmdbVoteCount = fb?.tmdbVoteCount ?: room?.tmdbVoteCount,
            needsEnrichment = 0,
        )
    }

    private fun anyArabic(s: String): Boolean = s.any { it in '\u0600'..'\u06FF' }

    private fun normalizeTitle(raw: String): String {
        if (raw.isBlank()) return ""
        return raw
            .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .replace(BRACKETS_OR_PARENS_REGEX, " ")
            .replace(MEDIA_TOKENS_REGEX, " ")
            .replace(NON_ALNUM_REGEX, " ")
            .trim()
    }

    private fun cleanDisplayTitle(raw: String): String {
        return raw
            .replace(LEADING_BRACKETS_REGEX, "")
            .replace(TRAILING_BRACKETS_REGEX, "")
            .trim()
    }

    suspend fun saveCatalogItem(entity: CatalogMovieEntity) = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
        val aliases = aliasesFor(entity)
        val tmdbDocId = entity.tmdbId?.takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { CatalogMovieEntity.idFromTmdb(it) }
        val normalizedMediaType = entity.mediaType.ifBlank { "movie" }
        val data = buildMap<String, Any?> {
            put("sahabId", entity.sahabId)
            put("novaStreamId", entity.novaStreamId)
            put("categoryId", entity.categoryId)
            put("titleAr", entity.titleAr)
            put("titleEn", entity.titleEn)
            put("year", entity.year)
            put("plot", entity.plot)
            put("plotSource", entity.plotSource)
            put("plotConfidence", entity.plotConfidence)
            put("identifiedTitle", entity.identifiedTitle)
            put("mediaType", normalizedMediaType)
            put("cast", entity.cast)
            put("director", entity.director)
            put("genre", entity.genre)
            put("runtime", entity.runtime)
            put("rating", entity.rating)
            put("posterUrl", entity.posterUrl)
            put("backdropUrl", entity.backdropUrl)
            put("tmdbId", entity.tmdbId)
            put("imdbId", entity.imdbId)
            put("tmdbVoteCount", entity.tmdbVoteCount)
            put("novaAdded", entity.novaAdded)
            put("containerExtension", entity.containerExtension)
            put("isAdult", entity.isAdult)
            put("updatedAt", System.currentTimeMillis())
            if (aliases.isNotEmpty()) put("aliases", aliases)
        }
        val targetDocId = tmdbDocId ?: entity.sahabId.ifBlank { return@suspendCancellableCoroutine }
        val docRef = collection.document(targetDocId)
        docRef.get()
            .addOnSuccessListener { snap ->
                if (!snap.exists()) {
                    val createPayload = data.filterValues { v ->
                        v != null && (v !is String || v.isNotBlank())
                    }
                    docRef.set(createPayload, SetOptions.merge())
                        .addOnCompleteListener { cont.resume(Unit) }
                } else {
                    val delta = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
                    var hasContentChange = false
                    for ((k, v) in data) {
                        if (k == "aliases" || k == "updatedAt") continue
                        if (v == null || (v is String && v.isBlank())) continue
                        val existing = snap.get(k)
                        if (existing == null || (existing is String && existing.isBlank()) || existing != v) {
                            delta[k] = v
                            hasContentChange = true
                        }
                    }
                    if (aliases.isNotEmpty()) {
                        delta["aliases"] = FieldValue.arrayUnion(*aliases.toTypedArray())
                        hasContentChange = true
                    }
                    if (hasContentChange) {
                        delta["updatedAt"] = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    }
                    if (delta.isEmpty()) {
                        cont.resume(Unit)
                    } else {
                        docRef.set(delta, SetOptions.merge())
                            .addOnCompleteListener { cont.resume(Unit) }
                    }
                }
            }
            .addOnFailureListener { cont.resume(Unit) }
    }

    suspend fun linkPendingAliasToTmdb(streamId: String, tmdbDocId: String, titleAr: String = "") {
        if (streamId.isBlank() || tmdbDocId.isBlank() || tmdbDocId == CatalogMovieEntity.idPending(streamId)) return
        if (!tmdbDocId.startsWith("tmdb:")) return
        val pendingId = CatalogMovieEntity.idPending(streamId)
        val uid = com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth.getInstance().currentUser?.uid
        suspendCancellableCoroutine<Unit> { cont ->
            val tmdbRef = collection.document(tmdbDocId)
            val mergePayload = mapOf(
                "aliases" to com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldValue.arrayUnion(pendingId),
            )
            tmdbRef.set(mergePayload, SetOptions.merge())
                .addOnCompleteListener {
                    if (!uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        db.collection("users").document(uid)
                            .collection("custom_catalog")
                            .document(pendingId)
                            .set(
                                mapOf("redirectTo" to tmdbDocId, "novaStreamId" to streamId, "titleAr" to titleAr),
                                SetOptions.merge(),
                            )
                            .addOnCompleteListener { if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(Unit) }
                    } else {
                        if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(Unit)
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    private fun mapToEntity(id: String, data: Map<String, Any>): CatalogMovieEntity {
        return CatalogMovieEntity(
            sahabId = id,
            novaStreamId = data["novaStreamId"] as? String ?: "",
            titleAr = data["titleAr"] as? String ?: "",
            titleEn = data["titleEn"] as? String ?: "",
            year = data["year"] as? String ?: "",
            plot = data["plot"] as? String ?: "",
            plotSource = data["plotSource"] as? String ?: "",
            plotConfidence = data["plotConfidence"] as? String ?: "",
            identifiedTitle = data["identifiedTitle"] as? String ?: "",
            mediaType = data["mediaType"] as? String ?: "movie",
            cast = data["cast"] as? String ?: "",
            director = data["director"] as? String ?: "",
            genre = data["genre"] as? String ?: "",
            runtime = data["runtime"] as? String ?: "",
            rating = data["rating"] as? String ?: "",
            posterUrl = data["posterUrl"] as? String ?: "",
            backdropUrl = data["backdropUrl"] as? String ?: "",
            imdbId = data["imdbId"] as? String ?: "",
            tmdbId = (data["tmdbId"] as? Number)?.toInt(),
            tmdbVoteCount = (data["tmdbVoteCount"] as? Number)?.toInt(),
            needsEnrichment = 0,
            lastEnriched = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        )
    }

    companion object {
        private val BRACKETS_OR_PARENS_REGEX = Regex("""\[.*?]|\(.*?\)""")
        private val MEDIA_TOKENS_REGEX = [REDACTED]
        private val NON_ALNUM_REGEX = Regex("""[^\p{L}\p{N}]+""")
        private val LEADING_BRACKETS_REGEX = Regex("""^\[.*?]\s*""")
        private val TRAILING_BRACKETS_REGEX = Regex("""\s*\[.*?]$""")

        fun aliasesFor(entity: CatalogMovieEntity): List<String> {
            val streamId = entity.novaStreamId.trim()
            if (streamId.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
            val pendingId = CatalogMovieEntity.idPending(streamId)
            return if (entity.sahabId != pendingId) listOf(pendingId) else emptyList()
        }

        fun resolveRedirectId(
            docId: String,
            redirectTo: String?,
        ): String {
            val clean = redirectTo?.trim().orEmpty()
            return if (clean.isNotEmpty() && clean != docId) clean else docId
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/catalog/TmdbMatcher.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog

import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.TmdbApi
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.TmdbMovie
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.TmdbSearchResult
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.min

/**
 * Port of the v5 Python matcher (tested on 200-sample Nova catalog).
 *
 * Pipeline:
 *   1. cleanIptv()          — strip IPTV noise (quality tags, junk, year suffix)
 *   2. normalizeArabic()    — unify alef/hamza/ya/ta-marbuta + Roman numerals
 *   3. extractTitleVariants() — split "AR | EN" mixed titles
 *   4. extractYear()        — trailing-year first (avoids 1917-style traps)
 *   5. generateQueries()    — cascade of 8-20 queries, strongest first
 *   6. scoreMatch()         — Jaro-Winkler + Jaccard + year + votes + popularity
 *   7. acceptLevel()        — strong / weak / reject
 */
object TmdbMatcher {

    data class Score(
        val titleSim: Double,
        val jw: Double,
        val jaccard: Double,
        val yearMatch: Double,
        val final: Double,
        val tmdbYear: Int?,
        val votes: Int,
    )

    data class EnrichResult(
        val tmdbId: Int?,
        val movie: TmdbMovie?,
        val score: Score?,
        val level: Level,
        val queryUsed: String,
        val tried: Int,
    )

    enum class Level { STRONG, WEAK, REJECT, EMPTY, NETWORK_ERROR }

    // ─────────────────────────────── Normalization ───────────────────────────────
    private val ARABIC_DIACRITICS = Regex("[\\u064B-\\u065F\\u0670]")
    private val ARABIC_PUNCT = Regex("[،؛؟!]")
    private val LATIN_PUNCT = Regex("[-:\\.'\\u2019\\u2018,\\\"\\u201C\\u201D\\[\\](){}/\\\\|+_*~`]")
    private val MULTI_SPACE = Regex("\\s+")

    private val ROMAN_MAP = listOf(
        Regex("\\bVIII\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "8",
        Regex("\\bVII\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "7",
        Regex("\\bVI\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "6",
        Regex("\\bIV\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "4",
        Regex("\\bV\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "5",
        Regex("\\bIII\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "3",
        Regex("\\bII\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) to "2",
    )

    fun normalizeArabic(raw: String): String {
        if (raw.isBlank()) return ""
        var s = raw
        s = ARABIC_DIACRITICS.replace(s, "").replace("\u0640", "")
        s = Regex("[أإآٱ]").replace(s, "ا")
        s = s.replace("ؤ", "ء").replace("ئ", "ء").replace("ى", "ي").replace("ة", "ه")
        s = ARABIC_PUNCT.replace(s, " ")
        s = LATIN_PUNCT.replace(s, " ")
        for ((pat, repl) in ROMAN_MAP) s = pat.replace(s, repl)
        return MULTI_SPACE.replace(s, " ").trim()
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────── IPTV cleaning ───────────────────────────────
    private val PREFIX_TAG = Regex("^(?:\\s*[A-Z0-9]{2,8}\\s*[:|\\-]+\\s*)+", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val BRACKET_TAG = Regex("\\[[^\\]]*\\]|\\([^)]*(?:1080|720|480|4K|HD|CAM|WEB|BLU|مترجم|مدبلج)[^)]*\\)", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val BRACE_TAG = Regex("\\{[^}]*\\}")
    private val YEAR_PAREN = Regex("\\((19|20)\\d{2}\\)")
    private val YEAR_TRAIL = Regex("[\\s\\-]*\\b(19[2-9]\\d|20[0-3]\\d)\\b[\\s\\-]*$")

    private val QUALITY_TAG = Regex(
        "\\b(4K|UHD|FHD|QHD|HD|SD|2160p|1080p|720p|480p|360p|BluRay|Blu-?Ray|BDRip|BRRip|" +
            "WEB-?DL|WEB-?Rip|WEBRip|HDTV|DVDRip|DVDScr|HDRip|x264|x265|H\\.?264|H\\.?265|HEVC|AVC|" +
            "AAC|AC3|DTS|DD5\\.?1|Atmos|10bit|8bit|HDR|HDR10|DV|CAM|CamRip|TS|Telesync|TC|HDTS|HDCAM|SCR|" +
            "PROPER|REPACK|RERIP|EXTENDED|UNRATED|DIRECTORS\\.?CUT|REMASTERED|IMAX|3D|HC|KORSUB|" +
            "Dual\\.?Audio|Multi\\.?Audio|Subbed|Subtitled|Dubbed)\\b",
        RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
    )

    private val ARABIC_JUNK = Regex(
        "(?:^\\s*(?:مشاهدة|مشاهده|تحميل|فيلم|فلم|مسلسل|انمي|أنمي|كرتون)\\s+)|" +
            "(?<!\\S)(?:مترجم\\s*للعربية|مترجم\\s*عربي|مترجمة|مترجم|مدبلج\\s*للعربية|مدبلج\\s*عربي|مدبلج|" +
            "كامل\\s*بجودة|كامل|نسخة\\s*اصلية|نسحه\\s*اصليه|بدون\\s*حذف|بدون\\s*فواصل|حصريا|حصري|" +
            "بجودة\\s*عالية|اون\\s*لاين|أونلاين|اونلاين)(?!\\S)|" +
            "(?:\\s+(?:فيلم|فلم|Movie|Film)\\s*$)",
        RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
    )

    private val EDGE_SEPARATORS = Regex("^[\\s\\-:|/\\\\]+|[\\s\\-:|/\\\\]+$")

    fun cleanIptv(raw: String): String {
        if (raw.isBlank()) return ""
        var s = raw
        s = PREFIX_TAG.replace(s, " ")
        s = BRACKET_TAG.replace(s, " ")
        s = BRACE_TAG.replace(s, " ")
        s = YEAR_PAREN.replace(s, " ")
        s = QUALITY_TAG.replace(s, " ")
        s = ARABIC_JUNK.replace(s, " ")
        s = YEAR_TRAIL.replace(s, " ")
        s = EDGE_SEPARATORS.replace(s, "")
        return MULTI_SPACE.replace(s, " ").trim()
    }

    fun extractTitleVariants(cleaned: String): List<String> {
        val normFull = normalizeArabic(cleaned)
        if (normFull.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val variants = mutableListOf(normFull)

        Regex("\\s+[-:|/]\\s+").split(cleaned).forEach { part ->
            val p = normalizeArabic(part)
            if (p.length >= 2 && p !in variants) variants.add(p)
        }

        val arWords = Regex("[\\u0600-\\u06FF0-9]+").findAll(normFull).map { it.value }.toList()
        val enWords = Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9]+").findAll(normFull).map { it.value }.toList()
        val hasAr = arWords.any { !it.all { c -> c.isDigit() } }
        val hasEn = enWords.any { !it.all { c -> c.isDigit() } }

        if (hasAr && hasEn) {
            val arStr = arWords.joinToString(" ").trim()
            val enStr = enWords.joinToString(" ").trim()
            if (arStr.length >= 2 && arStr !in variants) variants.add(arStr)
            if (enStr.length >= 2 && enStr !in variants) variants.add(enStr)
        }
        return variants
    }

    private val YEAR_REGEX = Regex("\\b(19[2-9]\\d|20[0-3]\\d)\\b")
    fun extractYear(name: String, categoryName: String): Int? {
        val matches = YEAR_REGEX.findAll(name).toList()
        if (matches.isNotEmpty()) {
            val endThreshold = maxOf(0, name.length - 25)
            val trailing = matches.filter { it.range.first >= endThreshold }
            if (trailing.isNotEmpty()) return trailing.last().value.toIntOrNull()
        }
        return YEAR_REGEX.find(categoryName)?.value?.toIntOrNull()
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────── Tokens ───────────────────────────────
    private val STOPWORDS = setOf(
        "ال", "في", "علي", "على", "من", "الي", "إلي", "عن", "لا", "ما", "هو", "هي",
        "ان", "أن", "إن", "قد", "كان", "كانت", "مع", "او", "أو", "ثم", "هذا", "هذه", "و",
        "the", "a", "an", "of", "in", "on", "at", "to", "for", "and", "or", "with", "by",
        "is", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being", "this", "that", "these", "those",
    )

    private fun stripArticle(t: String): String {
        for (pre in listOf("وال", "بال", "كال")) {
            if (t.startsWith(pre) && t.length > 4) return t.substring(3)
        }
        for (pre in listOf("ال", "لل")) {
            if (t.startsWith(pre) && t.length > 3) return t.substring(2)
        }
        return t
    }

    fun tokenize(s: [REDACTED]
        val norm = normalizeArabic(s.lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
        val out = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (t in Regex("\\W+").split(norm)) {
            if (t.length < 2) continue
            val stripped = stripArticle(t)
            if (stripped in STOPWORDS || stripped.length < 2) continue
            out.add(stripped)
        }
        return out
    }

    fun jaccardTokens(a: [REDACTED]
        val ta = [REDACTED]
        val tb = [REDACTED]
        if (ta.isEmpty() || tb.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        val inter = ta.intersect(tb).size.toDouble()
        val union = ta.union(tb).size.toDouble()
        return if (union == 0.0) 0.0 else inter / union
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────── Jaro-Winkler ───────────────────────────────
    private fun jaro(s1: String, s2: String): Double {
        if (s1 == s2) return 1.0
        if (s1.isEmpty() || s2.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        val md = maxOf(s1.length, s2.length) / 2 - 1
        val m1 = BooleanArray(s1.length)
        val m2 = BooleanArray(s2.length)
        var matches = 0
        for (i in s1.indices) {
            val start = maxOf(0, i - md)
            val end = minOf(i + md + 1, s2.length)
            for (j in start until end) {
                if (m2[j] || s1[i] != s2[j]) continue
                m1[i] = true; m2[j] = true; matches++; break
            }
        }
        if (matches == 0) return 0.0
        var t = 0.0
        var k = 0
        for (i in s1.indices) {
            if (!m1[i]) continue
            while (!m2[k]) k++
            if (s1[i] != s2[k]) t += 1
            k++
        }
        t /= 2
        return (matches.toDouble() / s1.length + matches.toDouble() / s2.length +
            (matches - t) / matches) / 3
    }

    fun jaroWinkler(s1: String, s2: String): Double {
        val a = s1.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val b = s2.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val j = jaro(a, b)
        var p = 0
        for (i in 0 until minOf(4, a.length, b.length)) {
            if (a[i] == b[i]) p++ else break
        }
        return j + p * 0.1 * (1.0 - j)
    }

    fun compareTitle(aRaw: String, bRaw: String): Double {
        var a = aRaw.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).trim()
        var b = bRaw.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).trim()
        for (pre in listOf("the ", "a ", "an ", "ال")) {
            if (a.startsWith(pre) && a.length > pre.length + 2) a = a.substring(pre.length).trim()
            if (b.startsWith(pre) && b.length > pre.length + 2) b = b.substring(pre.length).trim()
        }
        var jw = jaroWinkler(a, b)
        val (sh, lo) = if (a.length <= b.length) a to b else b to a
        if (sh.length >= 8 && lo.startsWith(sh)) {
            jw = min(jw + min(sh.length.toDouble() / lo.length, 1.0) * 0.10, 1.0)
        }
        return jw
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────── Score ───────────────────────────────
    fun scoreMatch(variants: List<String>, novaYear: Int?, tmdb: TmdbSearchResult): Score {
        val tt = normalizeArabic(tmdb.title)
        val to = normalizeArabic(tmdb.originalTitle)
        val tmdbYear = tmdb.releaseDate.take(4).toIntOrNull()
        val votes = tmdb.voteCount
        val pop = tmdb.popularity

        var bestJw = 0.0
        var bestJac = 0.0
        for (v in variants) {
            if (v.isEmpty()) continue
            bestJw = maxOf(bestJw, compareTitle(v, tt), compareTitle(v, to))
            bestJac = [REDACTED]
        }
        val titleSim = maxOf(bestJw, bestJac * 0.92)

        val (ym, final) = if (novaYear != null && tmdbYear != null) {
            val d = abs(novaYear - tmdbYear)
            val ym = when (d) {
                0 -> 1.0
                1 -> 0.85
                2 -> 0.25
                else -> 0.0
            }
            val vt = when {
                votes >= 1000 -> 1.0; votes >= 500 -> 0.85; votes >= 100 -> 0.65
                votes >= 50 -> 0.45; votes >= 10 -> 0.25; else -> 0.10
            }
            ym to (titleSim * 0.50 + ym * 0.25 + vt * 0.20 + min(pop / 100, 1.0) * 0.05)
        } else {
            val vt = when {
                votes >= 1000 -> 1.0; votes >= 500 -> 0.85; votes >= 100 -> 0.65
                votes >= 50 -> 0.45; votes >= 10 -> 0.25; else -> 0.05
            }
            0.5 to (titleSim * 0.60 + vt * 0.35 + min(pop / 100, 1.0) * 0.05)
        }

        return Score(
            titleSim = round3(titleSim),
            jw = round3(bestJw),
            jaccard = round3(bestJac),
            yearMatch = ym,
            final = round3(final),
            tmdbYear = tmdbYear,
            votes = votes,
        )
    }

    fun acceptLevel(m: Score): Level {
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.98 && m.yearMatch == 1.0) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.98 && m.yearMatch == 0.5 && m.votes >= 20) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.90 && m.yearMatch >= 0.85 && m.votes >= 10) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.final >= 0.70 && m.titleSim >= 0.85 && m.yearMatch >= 0.85 && m.votes >= 5) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.99 && m.yearMatch == 0.5 && m.votes >= 5) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.90 && m.yearMatch == 0.5 && m.votes >= 50) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.95 && m.yearMatch >= 0.85 && m.votes >= 1) return Level.STRONG
        if (m.titleSim >= 0.96 && m.votes >= 1) return Level.WEAK
        if (m.final >= 0.60 && m.titleSim >= 0.80) return Level.WEAK
        return Level.REJECT
    }

    private fun round3(v: Double): Double = Math.round(v * 1000.0) / 1000.0

    // ─────────────────────────────── Query cascade ───────────────────────────────
    data class Query(val q: String, val year: Int?, val lang: String)

    fun generateQueries(rawName: String, categoryName: String, year: Int?): Pair<List<Query>, List<String>> {
        val base = cleanIptv(rawName)
        if (base.isBlank()) return emptyList<Query>() to emptyList()
        val variants = extractTitleVariants(base)
        if (variants.isEmpty()) return emptyList<Query>() to emptyList()

        val queries = mutableListOf<Query>()
        fun add(q: String, yr: Int?, lang: String) {
            val qn = normalizeArabic(q)
            if (qn.length < 2) return
            if (queries.any { it.q == qn && it.year == yr && it.lang == lang }) return
            queries.add(Query(qn, yr, lang))
        }

        for (v in variants) {
            val isAr = Regex("[\\u0600-\\u06FF]").containsMatchIn(v)
            if (isAr) {
                add(v, year, "ar"); add(v, null, "ar")
                add(v, year, "en-US"); add(v, null, "en-US")
            } else {
                add(v, year, "en-US"); add(v, null, "en-US")
            }
        }

        for (v in variants) {
            val words = v.split(" ").filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            val wordsSig = words.filter { it.length > 1 && it.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) !in STOPWORDS }
            val sig = wordsSig.joinToString(" ")
            val lang = if (Regex("[\\u0600-\\u06FF]").containsMatchIn(v)) "ar" else "en-US"
            if (sig.isNotEmpty() && sig != v) {
                add(sig, year, lang); add(sig, null, lang)
            }
            if (wordsSig.size >= 4) {
                add(wordsSig.take(3).joinToString(" "), year, lang)
                add(wordsSig.take(3).joinToString(" "), null, lang)
            }
            if (wordsSig.size >= 3) {
                add(wordsSig.take(2).joinToString(" "), year, lang)
                add(wordsSig.take(2).joinToString(" "), null, lang)
            }
            if (wordsSig.size >= 2 && wordsSig[0].length >= 4) {
                add(wordsSig[0], year, lang); add(wordsSig[0], null, lang)
            }
        }
        return queries to variants
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────── Enrich entry point ───────────────────────────────
    suspend fun enrich(
        tmdb: TmdbApi,
        rawName: String,
        categoryName: String,
        novaYear: Int?,
        maxQueries: Int = 4,
        mediaType: String = "movie",
    ): EnrichResult {
        val isTv = mediaType.equals("series", ignoreCase = true) || mediaType.equals("tv", ignoreCase = true)
        val (queries, variants) = generateQueries(rawName, categoryName, novaYear)
        if (queries.isEmpty()) {
            return EnrichResult(null, null, null, Level.EMPTY, "", 0)
        }

        var bestWeak: Pair<TmdbSearchResult, Score>? = null
        var tried = 0
        var sawNetworkError = false

        for (q in queries.take(maxQueries)) {
            tried++
            val searchOutcome = if (isTv) {
                tmdb.searchTvOutcome(q.q, q.year, q.lang)
            } else {
                tmdb.searchMovieOutcome(q.q, q.year, q.lang)
            }
            val results = when (val out = searchOutcome) {
                is TmdbApi.SearchOutcome.Ok -> out.results
                TmdbApi.SearchOutcome.MissingKey -> {
                    return EnrichResult(null, null, null, Level.NETWORK_ERROR, q.q, tried)
                }
                TmdbApi.SearchOutcome.NetworkError -> {
                    sawNetworkError = true
                    continue
                }
            }
            if (results.isEmpty()) continue

            for (c in results.take(5)) {
                val s = scoreMatch(variants, novaYear, c)
                when (acceptLevel(s)) {
                    Level.STRONG -> {
                        val details = if (isTv) tmdb.getTvDetailsById(c.id) else tmdb.getMovieDetailsById(c.id)
                        return EnrichResult(c.id, details, s, Level.STRONG, q.q, tried)
                    }
                    Level.WEAK -> {
                        if (bestWeak == null || s.final > bestWeak!!.second.final) {
                            bestWeak = c to s
                        }
                    }
                    else -> Unit
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestWeak != null) {
            val (c, s) = bestWeak!!
            val details = if (isTv) tmdb.getTvDetailsById(c.id) else tmdb.getMovieDetailsById(c.id)
            return EnrichResult(c.id, details, s, Level.WEAK, "", tried)
        }
        val finalLevel = if (sawNetworkError) Level.NETWORK_ERROR else Level.REJECT
        return EnrichResult(null, null, null, finalLevel, "", tried)
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel

import androidx.room.Dao
import androidx.room.Insert
import androidx.room.OnConflictStrategy
import androidx.room.Query
import androidx.room.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

@Dao
interface ChannelDao {

    // ═══ Channels ═══

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channels WHERE isHidden = 0 ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, displayName ASC")
    fun observeVisible(): Flow<List<ChannelEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channels WHERE isHidden = 0 AND categoryId = :categoryId ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, displayName ASC")
    fun observeByCategory(categoryId: String): Flow<List<ChannelEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channels WHERE streamId = :streamId")
    suspend fun findById(streamId: String): ChannelEntity?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channels WHERE epgId = :epgId LIMIT 1")
    suspend fun findByEpgId(epgId: String): ChannelEntity?

    @Query("SELECT streamId, logoUrl FROM channels WHERE logoUrl != ''")
    suspend fun getLogosList(): List<LogoRow>

    @Query("SELECT streamId FROM channels")
    suspend fun allStreamIds(): List<String>

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channels")
    suspend fun count(): Int

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channels WHERE isHidden = 0 ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, displayName ASC")
    suspend fun visibleOrdered(): List<ChannelEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channels ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, displayName ASC")
    suspend fun all(): List<ChannelEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun upsert(items: List<ChannelEntity>)

    @Query("UPDATE channels SET isFavorite = :fav, updatedAt = :now WHERE streamId = :streamId")
    suspend fun setFavorite(streamId: String, fav: Boolean, now: Long)

    @Query("UPDATE channels SET isHidden = :hidden, updatedAt = :now WHERE streamId = :streamId")
    suspend fun setHidden(streamId: String, hidden: Boolean, now: Long)

    @Query("SELECT streamId FROM channels WHERE isHidden = 1")
    fun observeHiddenIds(): Flow<List<String>>

    @Query("UPDATE channels SET isHidden = 0, updatedAt = :now WHERE isHidden = 1")
    suspend fun unhideAll(now: Long)

    @Query("UPDATE channels SET sortOrder = :order, updatedAt = :now WHERE streamId = :streamId")
    suspend fun setSortOrder(streamId: String, order: Int, now: Long)

    @Query("UPDATE channels SET lastWatchedAt = :now WHERE streamId = :streamId")
    suspend fun markWatched(streamId: String, now: Long)

    @Query("DELETE FROM channels WHERE streamId IN (:streamIds)")
    suspend fun deleteByStreamIds(streamIds: List<String>)

    @Query("DELETE FROM channels")
    suspend fun clearAll()

    // ═══ EPG ═══

    @Query("SELECT DISTINCT epgId FROM channels WHERE epgId != ''")
    suspend fun distinctEpgIds(): List<String>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM epg_programs WHERE epgId = :epgId AND end > :nowSec ORDER BY start ASC")
    suspend fun programsForChannel(epgId: String, nowSec: Long): List<EpgProgramEntity>

    @Query("""
        SELECT p.* FROM epg_programs p
        INNER JOIN channels c ON c.epgId = p.epgId
        WHERE c.streamId = :streamId
          AND p.start <= :nowSec AND p.end > :nowSec
        ORDER BY p.start ASC
        LIMIT 1
    """)
    suspend fun currentProgramFor(streamId: String, nowSec: Long): EpgProgramEntity?

    @Query("""
        SELECT p.* FROM epg_programs p
        INNER JOIN channels c ON c.epgId = p.epgId
        WHERE c.streamId = :streamId
          AND p.start > :nowSec
        ORDER BY p.start ASC
        LIMIT 1
    """)
    suspend fun nextProgramFor(streamId: String, nowSec: Long): EpgProgramEntity?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM epg_programs WHERE start <= :nowSec AND end > :nowSec ORDER BY start ASC")
    fun observeNowPlaying(nowSec: Long): Flow<List<EpgProgramEntity>>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun upsertPrograms(items: List<EpgProgramEntity>)

    @Query("DELETE FROM epg_programs WHERE epgId = :epgId")
    suspend fun deleteProgramsForChannel(epgId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM epg_programs WHERE end < :cutoffSec")
    suspend fun deleteOldPrograms(cutoffSec: Long): Int

    @Query("DELETE FROM epg_programs")
    suspend fun clearAllPrograms()

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM epg_programs")
    suspend fun programCount(): Int

    // ═══ Custom Lists ═══

    @Query("SELECT * FROM channel_lists WHERE accountId = :accountId OR accountId = '' ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, name ASC")
    fun observeLists(accountId: String = ""): Flow<List<ChannelListEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT streamId FROM channel_list_items WHERE listId = :listId ORDER BY position ASC")
    suspend fun itemsOfList(listId: String): List<String>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun upsertList(list: ChannelListEntity)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun upsertListItems(items: List<ChannelListItemEntity>)

    @Query("DELETE FROM channel_list_items WHERE listId = :listId")
    suspend fun clearListItems(listId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM channel_lists WHERE listId = :listId")
    suspend fun deleteList(listId: String)

    @Transaction
    suspend fun replaceListItems(listId: String, orderedChannelIds: List<String>) {
        clearListItems(listId)
        if (orderedChannelIds.isNotEmpty()) {
            upsertListItems(
                orderedChannelIds.mapIndexed { idx, id ->
                    ChannelListItemEntity(listId = listId, streamId = id, position = idx)
                },
            )
        }
    }

    @Transaction
    suspend fun toggleChannelInList(listId: String, channelId: String) {
        val current = itemsOfList(listId).toMutableList()
        if (!current.remove(channelId)) {
            current.add(channelId)
        }
        replaceListItems(listId, current)
    }

    @Transaction
    suspend fun deleteListAndItems(listId: String) {
        clearListItems(listId)
        deleteList(listId)
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel

import android.content.Context
import androidx.room.Database
import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.room.RoomDatabase
import androidx.room.migration.Migration
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase

/**
 * قاعدة بيانات القنوات المباشرة ودليل البرامج (EPG) وقوائم المستخدم المخصصة.
 * تستخدم هجرات صريحة لحماية القوائم المخصصة وإخفاء وترتيب القنوات من الضياع.
 */
@Database(
    entities = [
        ChannelEntity::class,
        EpgProgramEntity::class,
        ChannelListEntity::class,
        ChannelListItemEntity::class,
    ],
    version = 3,
    exportSchema = true,
)
abstract class ChannelDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun channelDao(): ChannelDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: ChannelDatabase? = null

        private fun hasColumn(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase, table: String, column: String): Boolean {
            db.query("PRAGMA table_info(`$table`)").use { cursor ->
                val nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndex("name")
                if (nameIndex < 0) return false
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    if (cursor.getString(nameIndex) == column) return true
                }
            }
            return false
        }

        private fun hasTable(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase, table: String): Boolean {
            db.query(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?",
                arrayOf(table),
            ).use { cursor ->
                return cursor.moveToFirst()
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_1_2 = object : Migration(1, 2) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                if (hasTable(db, "channels") && !hasColumn(db, "channels", "lastFirebaseCheckAt")) {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "ALTER TABLE `channels` ADD COLUMN `lastFirebaseCheckAt` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
                    )
                }
                if (hasTable(db, "channels")) {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_channels_lastFirebaseCheckAt` ON `channels` (`lastFirebaseCheckAt`)",
                    )
                }

                if (hasTable(db, "channel_lists") && !hasColumn(db, "channel_lists", "listId")) {
                    db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE `channel_lists` RENAME TO `channel_lists_legacy`")
                    db.execSQL(
                        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `channel_lists` (`listId` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `icon` TEXT NOT NULL, `sortOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sortMode` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`listId`))",
                    )
                    if (hasColumn(db, "channel_lists_legacy", "id")) {
                        db.execSQL(
                            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO `channel_lists` (`listId`, `name`, `icon`, `sortOrder`, `sortMode`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`) SELECT `id`, `name`, '', `sortOrder`, 'custom', `updatedAt`, `updatedAt` FROM `channel_lists_legacy`",
                        )
                    }
                    db.execSQL("DROP TABLE `channel_lists_legacy`")
                } else {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `channel_lists` (`listId` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `icon` TEXT NOT NULL, `sortOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sortMode` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`listId`))",
                    )
                }

                db.execSQL(
                    "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `channel_list_items` (`listId` TEXT NOT NULL, `streamId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`listId`, `streamId`))",
                )
                db.execSQL(
                    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_channel_list_items_listId_position` ON `channel_list_items` (`listId`, `position`)",
                )
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_2_3 = object : Migration(2, 3) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                if (hasTable(db, "channel_lists") && !hasColumn(db, "channel_lists", "accountId")) {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "ALTER TABLE `channel_lists` ADD COLUMN `accountId` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''",
                    )
                }
                if (hasTable(db, "channel_lists")) {
                    db.execSQL(
                        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_channel_lists_accountId` ON `channel_lists` (`accountId`)",
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        fun getInstance(context: Context): ChannelDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                INSTANCE ?: Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    ChannelDatabase::class.java,
                    "channel.db",
                )
                    .addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2, MIGRATION_2_3)
                    .build()
                    .also { INSTANCE = it }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel

import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.Index
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey

/** Minimal projection for logo lookups — avoids Room Map return type quirks. */
data class LogoRow(val streamId: String, val logoUrl: String)

@Entity(
    tableName = "channels",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["epgId"]),
        Index(value = ["groupId"]),
        Index(value = ["categoryId"]),
        Index(value = ["sortOrder"]),
        Index(value = ["isHidden"]),
        Index(value = ["isFavorite"]),
        Index(value = ["lastFirebaseCheckAt"]),
    ],
)
data class ChannelEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val streamId: String,
    val name: String,
    val displayName: String,
    val logoUrl: String = "",
    val categoryId: String = "",
    val categoryName: String = "",
    val channelNumber: Int? = null,
    val epgId: String = "",
    val qualityTag: String = "",
    val groupId: String = "",
    val streamUrlTemplate: String,
    val sortOrder: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE,
    val isFavorite: Boolean = false,
    val isHidden: Boolean = false,
    val lastWatchedAt: Long = 0L,
    val updatedAt: Long,
    /**
     * Unix millis of last Firebase lookup for this channel.
     * 0 = never checked. Used with a 7-day TTL to avoid re-querying channels
     * that don't yet exist in global_channels.
     */
    val lastFirebaseCheckAt: Long = 0L,
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "epg_programs",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["epgId", "start"]),
        Index(value = ["start", "end"]),
    ],
)
data class EpgProgramEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val id: String,
    val epgId: String,
    val start: Long,
    val end: Long,
    val title: String,
    val description: String = "",
    val category: String? = null,
    val updatedAt: Long,
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "channel_lists",
    indices = [Index(value = ["accountId"])],
)
data class ChannelListEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val listId: String,
    val name: String,

)

    tableName = "channel_list_items",
