=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/channel/ChannelSync.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldPath
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Channel
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Repository
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

/**
 * Syncs the user's Xtream live channels into Room (channel.db),
 * enriched with Firebase `global_channels` metadata.
 *
 * Firebase cost & performance strategy:
 *  - Room IS our cache: channels with a valid epgId are SKIPPED (0 reads).
 *  - Channels without epgId are re-queried at most every 7 days (lastFirebaseCheckAt TTL).
 *  - Enrichment uses `whereIn(FieldPath.documentId(), ...)` — 30 IDs per query.
 *    Cost is unchanged (per-document billing) but latency drops from ~1510
 *    round-trips to ~51 (massive UX improvement).
 *  - No silent failures: every error is captured in Stats.errors and Log.e.
 */
class ChannelSync(
    private val dao: ChannelDao,
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(),
) {
    data class Stats(
        val total: Int = 0,
        val inserted: Int = 0,
        val updated: Int = 0,
        val enriched: Int = 0,
        val firebaseReads: Int = 0,
        val failedBatches: Int = 0,
        val errors: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val durationMs: Long = 0L,
    ) {
        val isSuccess: Boolean get() = errors.isEmpty()
        val hasPartialFailure: Boolean get() = errors.isNotEmpty() && total > 0
    }

    private val _syncing = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val syncing: StateFlow<Boolean> = _syncing

    suspend fun sync(repo: Repository, forceFullRefresh: Boolean = false): Stats =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            // Atomic lock — prevents race between concurrent calls
            if (!_syncing.compareAndSet(expect = false, update = true)) {
                return@withContext Stats(errors = listOf("Sync already in progress — ignored"))
            }
            val start = System.currentTimeMillis()
            val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
            try {
                val now = System.currentTimeMillis()

                // 1) Xtream fetch
                val remote = try {
                    repo.liveChannels(null, forceNetwork = true)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "liveChannels failed", e)
                    return@withContext Stats(
                        errors = listOf("Xtream liveChannels failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}"),
                        durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                    )
                }
                if (remote.isEmpty()) {
                    return@withContext Stats(
                        errors = listOf("Xtream returned 0 channels — check subscription/credentials"),
                        durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                    )
                }

                // 2) Room snapshot (our cache)
                val existing = try {
                    dao.all().associateBy { it.streamId }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Room read failed", e)
                    return@withContext Stats(
                        errors = listOf("Room read failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}"),
                        durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                    )
                }

                // 3) Which channels need Firebase?
                //    Skip channels whose epgId is already populated.
                //    For those without epgId, re-query only after RETRY_TTL_MS.
                val retryCutoff = now - RETRY_TTL_MS
                val needEnrich = if (forceFullRefresh) remote
                else remote.filter { ch ->
                    val prev = existing[ch.id]
                    prev == null || (prev.epgId.isEmpty() && prev.lastFirebaseCheckAt < retryCutoff)
                }

                // 4) Firebase fetch
                val fbResult = if (needEnrich.isNotEmpty()) fetchFirebase(needEnrich)
                else FirebaseFetchResult(emptyMap(), emptySet(), 0, emptyList())
                errors.addAll(fbResult.errors)

                // 5) Build rows (preserve prev values on partial refresh)
                val rows = remote.mapIndexed { idx, ch ->
                    val chSlug = slug(ch.name)
                    buildEntity(
                        ch = ch,
                        listIndex = idx,
                        fb = fbResult.data[chSlug],
                        prev = existing[ch.id],
                        now = now,
                        wasQueried = chSlug in fbResult.queriedSlugs,
                    )
                }

                // 6) Room upsert
                var inserted = 0
                var updated = 0
                var enriched = 0
                try {
                    rows.chunked(ROOM_BATCH_SIZE).forEach { batch ->
                        dao.upsert(batch)
                        batch.forEach { e ->
                            if (existing.containsKey(e.streamId)) updated++ else inserted++
                            if (e.epgId.isNotEmpty()) enriched++
                        }
                    }
                    val remoteIds = remote.mapTo(HashSet(remote.size)) { it.id }
                    val removedIds = existing.keys.filter { it !in remoteIds }
                    removedIds.chunked(ROOM_BATCH_SIZE).forEach { batch ->
                        dao.deleteByStreamIds(batch)
                    }
                    repo.invalidateLiveChannelCache()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Room upsert failed", e)
                    errors.add("Room write failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}")
                }

                Stats(
                    total = rows.size,
                    inserted = inserted,
                    updated = updated,
                    enriched = enriched,
                    firebaseReads = fbResult.data.size,
                    failedBatches = fbResult.failedBatches,
                    errors = errors.toList(),
                    durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                )
            } finally {
                _syncing.value = false
            }
        }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Firebase (whereIn batches — max 30 IDs per query)
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private data class FirebaseFetchResult(
        val data: Map<String, FirebaseChannelData>,
        val queriedSlugs: Set<String>,
        val failedBatches: Int,
        val errors: List<String>,
    )

    private suspend fun fetchFirebase(channels: List<Channel>): FirebaseFetchResult {
        val slugs = channels.map { slug(it.name) }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.distinct()
        if (slugs.isEmpty()) return FirebaseFetchResult(emptyMap(), emptySet(), 0, emptyList())

        val result = mutableMapOf<String, FirebaseChannelData>()
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        var failedBatches = 0

        // whereIn: Firestore allows up to 30 values per query
        slugs.chunked(WHERE_IN_LIMIT).forEachIndexed { index, chunk ->
            try {
                val docs = queryByIds(chunk)
                docs.forEach { doc ->
                    docToFirebaseData(doc)?.let { result[doc.id] = it }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                failedBatches++
                val msg = "Firebase query #${index + 1} (${chunk.size} ids): " +
                    (e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName)
                Log.e(TAG, msg, e)
                errors.add(msg)
            }
        }

        return FirebaseFetchResult(
            data = result,
            queriedSlugs = slugs.toSet(),
            failedBatches = failedBatches,
            errors = errors,
        )
    }

    private suspend fun queryByIds(slugs: List<String>): List<DocumentSnapshot> =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            firestore.collection("global_channels")
                .whereIn(FieldPath.documentId(), slugs)
                .get()
                .addOnSuccessListener { snap ->
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(snap.documents)
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { e ->
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resumeWithException(e)
                }
        }

    private fun docToFirebaseData(doc: DocumentSnapshot): FirebaseChannelData? {
        if (!doc.exists()) return null
        val d = doc.data ?: return null
        return FirebaseChannelData(
            displayName = d["displayName"] as? String ?: "",
            logoUrl = d["logoUrl"] as? String ?: "",
            epgId = d["epgId"] as? String ?: "",
            qualityTag = d["qualityTag"] as? String ?: "",
            groupId = d["groupId"] as? String ?: "",
            channelNumber = (d["channelNumber"] as? Number)?.toInt(),
            categoryName = d["category"] as? String ?: "",
        )
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Entity builder — preserves previous data on partial refresh
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private fun buildEntity(
        ch: Channel,
        listIndex: Int,
        fb: FirebaseChannelData?,
        prev: ChannelEntity?,
        now: Long,
        wasQueried: Boolean,
    ): ChannelEntity = ChannelEntity(
        streamId = ch.id,
        name = ch.name,
        // Firebase wins, then previous row, then Xtream original
        displayName = fb?.displayName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: prev?.displayName ?: ch.name,
        logoUrl = fb?.logoUrl?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: prev?.logoUrl ?: ch.icon,
        categoryId = ch.categoryId,
        categoryName = fb?.categoryName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: prev?.categoryName ?: "",
        channelNumber = fb?.channelNumber ?: prev?.channelNumber,
        epgId = fb?.epgId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: prev?.epgId ?: ch.epgId,
        qualityTag = fb?.qualityTag?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: prev?.qualityTag ?: "",
        groupId = fb?.groupId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: prev?.groupId ?: "",
        streamUrlTemplate = if (ch.url.isNotBlank()) ch.url else STREAM_TEMPLATE,
        sortOrder = prev?.sortOrder ?: (fb?.channelNumber ?: listIndex),
        isFavorite = prev?.isFavorite ?: false,
        isHidden = prev?.isHidden ?: false,
        lastWatchedAt = prev?.lastWatchedAt ?: 0L,
        updatedAt = now,
        // Only update this when we actually queried Firebase for this slug
        lastFirebaseCheckAt = if (wasQueried) now else (prev?.lastFirebaseCheckAt ?: 0L),
    )

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "ChannelSync"
        private const val ROOM_BATCH_SIZE = 500
        private const val WHERE_IN_LIMIT = 30            // Firestore max per whereIn
        private const val RETRY_TTL_MS = 24L * 3600_000L       // 24 hours
        private const val STREAM_TEMPLATE = "/live/{USER}/{PASS}/{streamId}.{ext}"
        private val SLUG_NON_WORD_REGEX = Regex("[^\\w\\u0600-\\u06FF]+")
        private val SLUG_EDGE_UNDERSCORES = Regex("^_+|_+$")
        private val SLUG_MULTI_UNDERSCORES = Regex("_+")

        fun slug(name: String): String = name.lowercase(Locale.US).trim()
            .replace(SLUG_NON_WORD_REGEX, "_")
            .replace(SLUG_EDGE_UNDERSCORES, "")
            .replace(SLUG_MULTI_UNDERSCORES, "_")
            .take(200)
    }
}

private data class FirebaseChannelData(
    val displayName: String,
    val logoUrl: String,
    val epgId: String,
    val qualityTag: String,
    val groupId: String,
    val channelNumber: Int?,
    val categoryName: String,
)

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/channel/EpgSync.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldPath
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

/**
 * Fetches EPG programmes from Firebase `global_epg/{epgId}` for all channels
 * that have an epgId in Room, upserts them into Room, and prunes old entries.
 *
 * Firebase cost & performance:
 *  - Only queries epgIds that actually exist in the local channels table.
 *  - Uses whereIn(FieldPath.documentId(), ...) — 30 IDs per query.
 *  - ~249 epgIds → ~9 queries instead of 249.
 *  - Prunes programmes ending more than 1h ago (keeps the "just ended" row visible).
 *
 * Failure policy: NEVER fail silently. All errors captured in Stats.errors + Log.e.
 */
class EpgSync(
    private val dao: ChannelDao,
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(),
) {
    data class Stats(
        val epgIdsProcessed: Int = 0,
        val programsUpserted: Int = 0,
        val programsDeleted: Int = 0,
        val failedBatches: Int = 0,
        val errors: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val durationMs: Long = 0L,
    ) {
        val isSuccess: Boolean get() = errors.isEmpty()
        val hasPartialFailure: Boolean get() = errors.isNotEmpty() && programsUpserted > 0
    }

    private val _syncing = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val syncing: StateFlow<Boolean> = _syncing

    suspend fun sync(priorityEpgIds: Set<String> = emptySet()): Stats = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!_syncing.compareAndSet(expect = false, update = true)) {
            return@withContext Stats(errors = listOf("EPG sync already in progress — ignored"))
        }
        val start = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        try {
            val nowSec = start / 1000
            val cutoffSec = nowSec - 3600

            // 1) Distinct epgIds from channels (populated by ChannelSync)
            val epgIds = try {
                dao.distinctEpgIds()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed to read epgIds from Room", e)
                return@withContext Stats(
                    errors = listOf("Room read failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}"),
                    durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                )
            }
            if (epgIds.isEmpty()) {
                Log.w(TAG, "No epgIds — run ChannelSync first")
                return@withContext Stats(
                    errors = listOf("No channels with epgId — run ChannelSync first"),
                    durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
                )
            }

            // 2) Fetch from Firebase
            val orderedIds = if (priorityEpgIds.isEmpty()) epgIds
                else epgIds.sortedByDescending { it in priorityEpgIds }
            val fetchResult = fetchFirebase(orderedIds, cutoffSec)
            errors.addAll(fetchResult.errors)

            // 3) Upsert programmes into Room (batched)
            var upserted = 0
            try {
                fetchResult.entities.chunked(ROOM_BATCH_SIZE).forEach { batch ->
                    dao.upsertPrograms(batch)
                    upserted += batch.size
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Room program upsert failed", e)
                errors.add("Room program upsert failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}")
            }

            // 4) Prune old programmes
            var deleted = 0
            try {
                deleted = dao.deleteOldPrograms(cutoffSec)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Cleanup failed", e)
                errors.add("Cleanup failed: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}")
            }

            Stats(
                epgIdsProcessed = epgIds.size,
                programsUpserted = upserted,
                programsDeleted = deleted,
                failedBatches = fetchResult.failedBatches,
                errors = errors.toList(),
                durationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start,
            )
        } finally {
            _syncing.value = false
        }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Firebase
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private data class FirebaseFetchResult(
        val entities: List<EpgProgramEntity>,
        val failedBatches: Int,
        val errors: List<String>,
    )

    private suspend fun fetchFirebase(
        epgIds: List<String>,
        cutoffSec: Long,
    ): FirebaseFetchResult {
        val out = mutableListOf<EpgProgramEntity>()
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        var failedBatches = 0

        epgIds.chunked(WHERE_IN_LIMIT).forEachIndexed { index, chunk ->
            try {
                val docs = queryByIds(chunk)
                docs.forEach { doc ->
                    out.addAll(docToPrograms(doc, cutoffSec))
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                failedBatches++
                val msg = "Firebase epg query #${index + 1} (${chunk.size} ids): " +
                    (e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName)
                Log.e(TAG, msg, e)
                errors.add(msg)
            }
        }

        return FirebaseFetchResult(out, failedBatches, errors)
    }

    private suspend fun queryByIds(epgIds: List<String>): List<DocumentSnapshot> =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            firestore.collection("global_epg")
                .whereIn(FieldPath.documentId(), epgIds)
                .get()
                .addOnSuccessListener { snap ->
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(snap.documents)
                }
                .addOnFailureListener { e ->
                    if (cont.isActive) cont.resumeWithException(e)
                }
        }

    private fun docToPrograms(doc: DocumentSnapshot, cutoffSec: Long): List<EpgProgramEntity> {
        if (!doc.exists()) return emptyList()
        val d = doc.data ?: return emptyList()
        val epgId = doc.id
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val raw = d["programs"] as? List<Map<String, Any?>> ?: return emptyList()
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val result = ArrayList<EpgProgramEntity>(raw.size)
        raw.forEach { m ->
            val startSec = (m["start"] as? Number)?.toLong() ?: return@forEach
            val endSec = (m["end"] as? Number)?.toLong() ?: return@forEach
            if (endSec < cutoffSec) return@forEach
            val title = m["title"] as? String ?: ""
            if (title.isBlank()) return@forEach
            val desc = m["description"] as? String ?: ""
            result.add(
                EpgProgramEntity(
                    id = "${epgId}_$startSec",
                    epgId = epgId,
                    start = startSec,
                    end = endSec,
                    title = title,
                    description = desc,
                    category = null,
                    updatedAt = now,
                )
            )
        }
        return result
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "EpgSync"
        private const val ROOM_BATCH_SIZE = 500
        private const val WHERE_IN_LIMIT = 30
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/weather/WeatherService.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.weather

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.util.Log
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import java.util.Locale

enum class WeatherCondition {
    CLEAR_DAY,
    CLEAR_NIGHT,
    PARTLY_CLOUDY,
    CLOUDY,
    FOG,
    RAIN,
    SNOW,
    THUNDERSTORM,
}

data class WeatherData(
    val tempC: Int = 24,
    val city: String = "الكويت",
    val condition: WeatherCondition = WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY,
    val conditionText: String = "صافٍ",
    val isDay: Boolean = true,
    val isLoaded: Boolean = false,
)

class WeatherService(
    private val client: OkHttpClient,
    context: Context? = null,
    prefsOverride: SharedPreferences? = null,
    private val geoBaseUrl: String = "https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com",
    private val forecastBaseUrl: String = "https://api.open-meteo.com",
    private val ipGeoUrl: String = "https://ipwho.is/?lang=ar",
) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences? = prefsOverride
        ?: context?.applicationContext?.getSharedPreferences("sahab_weather_cache", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private val _weather = MutableStateFlow(loadCachedWeather())
    val weather: StateFlow<WeatherData> = _weather.asStateFlow()

    private var lastFetchMs: Long = 0L

    fun getManualCity(): String = prefs?.getString("manual_city", "") ?: ""

    suspend fun setManualCity(cityName: String): Boolean {
        val trimmed = cityName.trim()
        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
            prefs?.edit()?.remove("manual_city")?.remove("manual_lat")?.remove("manual_lon")?.apply()
            refreshIfNeeded(force = true)
            return true
        }
        val geo = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            runCatching {
                val encoded = java.net.URLEncoder.encode(trimmed, "UTF-8")
                val req = Request.Builder()
                    .url("${geoBaseUrl.trimEnd('/')}/v1/search?name=$encoded&count=1&language=ar")
                    .build()
                client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                    if (!resp.isSuccessful) return@use null
                    val body = resp.body?.string().orEmpty()
                    if (body.isBlank()) return@use null
                    val parsed = json.decodeFromString(GeoSearchResponse.serializer(), body)
                    val item = parsed.results.firstOrNull() ?: return@use null
                    Triple(
                        item.latitude.toFloat(),
                        item.longitude.toFloat(),
                        item.name.ifBlank { trimmed },
                    )
                }
            }.getOrNull()
        } ?: return false
        prefs?.edit()
            ?.putString("manual_city", geo.third)
            ?.putFloat("manual_lat", geo.first)
            ?.putFloat("manual_lon", geo.second)
            ?.apply()
        refreshIfNeeded(force = true)
        return true
    }

    suspend fun refreshIfNeeded(force: Boolean = false) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (!force && now - lastFetchMs < 30 * 60 * 1000L && _weather.value.isLoaded) {
            return
        }

        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                // 1. Manual city override first, else IP geolocation
                val manualCity = prefs?.getString("manual_city", "").orEmpty()
                val hasManual = manualCity.isNotBlank() &&
                    prefs?.contains("manual_lat") == true &&
                    prefs.contains("manual_lon")
                val loc = if (hasManual) null else fetchIpLocation()
                val lat = if (hasManual) prefs?.getFloat("manual_lat", 29.37f)?.toDouble() ?: 29.37 else (loc?.first ?: 29.37)
                val lon = if (hasManual) prefs?.getFloat("manual_lon", 47.98f)?.toDouble() ?: 47.98 else (loc?.second ?: 47.98)
                val rawCity = if (hasManual) manualCity else (loc?.third ?: "Kuwait City")

                // 2. Real-time weather from Open-Meteo
                val url = "${forecastBaseUrl.trimEnd('/')}/v1/forecast?latitude=$lat&longitude=$lon&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,is_day&timezone=auto"
                val req = Request.Builder()
                    .url(url)
                    .header("User-Agent", "Sahab/1.0 (Android)")
                    .build()

                client.newCall(req).execute().use { res ->
                    if (!res.isSuccessful) return@withContext
                    val body = res.body?.string() ?: return@withContext
                    val parsed = json.decodeFromString(OpenMeteoResponse.serializer(), body)
                    val current = parsed.current ?: return@withContext
                    val temp = current.temperature_2m.toInt()
                    val code = current.weather_code
                    val isDay = current.is_day == 1

                    val (condition, text) = mapWmoCode(code, isDay)
                    val arabCity = translateCity(rawCity)

                    val data = WeatherData(
                        tempC = temp,
                        city = arabCity,
                        condition = condition,
                        conditionText = text,
                        isDay = isDay,
                        isLoaded = true,
                    )

                    _weather.value = data
                    lastFetchMs = now
                    saveCachedWeather(data)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                runCatching { Log.w("WeatherService", "Weather refresh failed: ${e.message}") }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun fetchIpLocation(): Triple<Double, Double, String>? {
        return try {
            val req = Request.Builder()
                .url(ipGeoUrl)
                .header("User-Agent", "Sahab/1.0 (Android)")
                .build()
            client.newCall(req).execute().use { res ->
                if (!res.isSuccessful) return null
                val body = res.body?.string() ?: return null
                val parsed = json.decodeFromString(IpWhoResponse.serializer(), body)
                if (!parsed.success) return null
                val lat = parsed.latitude ?: return null
                val lon = parsed.longitude ?: return null
                val city = parsed.city.ifBlank { "Kuwait City" }
                Triple(lat, lon, city)
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    @Serializable
    private data class GeoSearchResponse(
        val results: List<GeoCityDto> = emptyList(),
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class GeoCityDto(
        val latitude: Double,
        val longitude: Double,
        val name: String = "",
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class OpenMeteoResponse(
        val current: OpenMeteoCurrentDto? = null,
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class OpenMeteoCurrentDto(
        val temperature_2m: Double = 24.0,
        val weather_code: Int = 0,
        val is_day: Int = 1,
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class IpWhoResponse(
        val success: Boolean = true,
        val latitude: Double? = null,
        val longitude: Double? = null,
        val city: String = "Kuwait City",
    )

    private fun mapWmoCode(code: Int, isDay: Boolean): Pair<WeatherCondition, String> {
        return when (code) {
            0 -> if (isDay) (WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY to "صافٍ") else (WeatherCondition.CLEAR_NIGHT to "سماء صافية")
            1, 2 -> (WeatherCondition.PARTLY_CLOUDY to "غائم جزئياً")
            3 -> (WeatherCondition.CLOUDY to "غائم")
            45, 48 -> (WeatherCondition.FOG to "ضباب")
            51, 53, 55, 56, 57 -> (WeatherCondition.RAIN to "رذاذ خفيف")
            61, 63, 65, 66, 67 -> (WeatherCondition.RAIN to "أمطار")
            71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86 -> (WeatherCondition.SNOW to "تساقط ثلوج")
            80, 81, 82 -> (WeatherCondition.RAIN to "زخات مطر")
            95, 96, 99 -> (WeatherCondition.THUNDERSTORM to "عواصف رعدية")
            else -> if (isDay) (WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY to "معتدل") else (WeatherCondition.CLEAR_NIGHT to "معتدل")
        }
    }

    private fun translateCity(name: String): String {
        val norm = name.trim().lowercase(Locale.US)
        return when {
            norm.contains("kuwait") -> "الكويت"
            norm.contains("cairo") -> "القاهرة"
            norm.contains("giza") -> "الجيزة"
            norm.contains("alexandria") -> "الإسكندرية"
            norm.contains("riyadh") -> "الرياض"
            norm.contains("jeddah") -> "جدة"
            norm.contains("mecca") || norm.contains("makkah") -> "مكة المكرمة"
            norm.contains("medina") || norm.contains("madinah") -> "المدينة المنورة"
            norm.contains("dammam") -> "الدمام"
            norm.contains("dubai") -> "دبي"
            norm.contains("abu dhabi") -> "أبوظبي"
            norm.contains("sharjah") -> "الشارقة"
            norm.contains("doha") -> "الدوحة"
            norm.contains("manama") -> "المنامة"
            norm.contains("muscat") -> "مسقط"
            norm.contains("amman") -> "عمّان"
            norm.contains("beirut") -> "بيروت"
            norm.contains("baghdad") -> "بغداد"
            norm.contains("damascus") -> "دمشق"
            norm.contains("tunis") -> "تونس"
            norm.contains("algiers") -> "الجزائر"
            norm.contains("rabat") -> "الرباط"
            norm.contains("casablanca") -> "الدار البيضاء"
            norm.contains("tripoli") -> "طرابلس"
            norm.contains("khartoum") -> "الخرطوم"
            norm.contains("sanaa") -> "صنعاء"
            else -> name
        }
    }

    private fun loadCachedWeather(): WeatherData {
        val store = prefs ?: return WeatherData()
        val temp = store.getInt("cached_temp", 24)
        val city = store.getString("cached_city", "الكويت") ?: "الكويت"
        val codeName = store.getString("cached_cond", WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY.name) ?: WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY.name
        val cond = try { WeatherCondition.valueOf(codeName) } catch (_: Exception) { WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY }
        val text = store.getString("cached_text", "صافٍ") ?: "صافٍ"
        val isDay = store.getBoolean("cached_is_day", true)
        val loaded = store.getBoolean("cached_loaded", false)
        return WeatherData(temp, city, cond, text, isDay, loaded)
    }

    private fun saveCachedWeather(data: WeatherData) {
        prefs?.edit()
            ?.putInt("cached_temp", data.tempC)
            ?.putString("cached_city", data.city)
            ?.putString("cached_cond", data.condition.name)
            ?.putString("cached_text", data.conditionText)
            ?.putBoolean("cached_is_day", data.isDay)
            ?.putBoolean("cached_loaded", true)
            ?.apply()
    }
}

@Composable
fun AppRoot(container: AppContainer, onReady: () -> Unit = {}) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val nav = rememberNavController()
    var start by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    LaunchedEffect(start) {
        if (start != null) onReady()
    }

    LaunchedEffect(container.userSyncService) {
        container.userSyncService.syncWriteErrors.collect { msg ->
            android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, msg, android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        val localAccount = container.prefs.account.first()
        if (localAccount != null) {
            container.repo.setAccount(localAccount)
            start = Routes.HOME
            onReady()
            if (container.authManager.currentUser != null) {
                container.syncCoordinator.syncFcmToken(context)
                container.appScope.launch {
                    container.syncCoordinator.performCloudRestoreAndMerge(waitForMerge = false)
                }
            }
            container.syncCoordinator.triggerFullSync(context, forceCatalog = false, reason = "startup_local")
        } else if (container.authManager.currentUser != null) {
            container.syncCoordinator.syncFcmToken(context)
            val restoredAccount = container.syncCoordinator.performCloudRestoreAndMerge(
                waitForMerge = false,
                accountTimeoutMs = 2_800L,
            )
            if (restoredAccount != null) {
                container.repo.setAccount(restoredAccount)
                start = Routes.HOME
                onReady()
                container.syncCoordinator.triggerFullSync(context, forceCatalog = false, reason = "startup_cloud")
            } else {
                start = Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN
                onReady()
            }
        } else {
            start = Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN
            onReady()
        }
    }

    val light by container.prefs.lightEffects.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = false)
    val themePreferences by container.prefs.themePreferences.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ThemePreferences())
    val entry by nav.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
    val currentRoute = entry?.destination?.route
    val onPlayer = currentRoute == Routes.PLAYER
    val focusController = remember { FocusNavigationController() }
    var previousScreenKey by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    LaunchedEffect(entry?.id, currentRoute) {
        val resolvedKey = when (currentRoute) {
            Routes.MOVIE_PATTERN -> "movie/${entry?.arguments?.getString("id").orEmpty()}"
            Routes.SERIES_PATTERN -> "series/${entry?.arguments?.getString("id").orEmpty()}"
            else -> currentRoute
        }
        if (resolvedKey != null) {
            if (previousScreenKey != null && previousScreenKey != resolvedKey) {
                focusController.onScreenResumed(resolvedKey)
            }
            previousScreenKey = resolvedKey
        }
    }

    val onTab: (String) -> Unit = remember(nav, focusController) {
        { route ->
            if (nav.currentDestination?.route != route && focusController.canNavigateNow()) {
                focusController.onScreenResumed(route)
                nav.navigate(route) {
                    popUpTo(Routes.HOME) { saveState = true }
                    launchSingleTop = true
                    restoreState = true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalLightEffects provides light,
        LocalTabNavigator provides onTab,
        LocalFocusNavigation provides focusController,
    ) {
        BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val isTv = LocalIsTv.current
            val windowInfo = computeAdaptiveWindowInfo(maxWidth, maxHeight, isTv)
            val scale = 1f
            CompositionLocalProvider(
                LocalAppScale provides scale,
                LocalWindowInfo provides windowInfo,
                LocalDisplayMode provides windowInfo.mode,
            ) {
                val layoutDir = LocalLayoutDirection.current
                val safeInsets = WindowInsets.safeDrawing.asPaddingValues()
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(Palette.Bg),
                ) {
                    if (!onPlayer) DreamyBackground()
                    val contentModifier = when {
                        windowInfo.mode != DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT -> Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                        else -> Modifier.fillMaxSize().safeDrawingPadding()
                    }
                    val oledPhoneNavigation = themePreferences.selectedThemeId == "oled_cinema" && windowInfo.mode == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT
                    val oledWideNavigation = themePreferences.selectedThemeId == "oled_cinema" && windowInfo.mode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
                    val navigationVisible = LocalThemeCustomization.current.isVisible("global_navigation")
                    val adjustedContentModifier = when {
                        onPlayer -> contentModifier
                        oledPhoneNavigation && navigationVisible ->
                            contentModifier.padding(bottom = 76.dp)
                        oledWideNavigation && navigationVisible ->
                            contentModifier.padding(start = 84.dp)
                        else -> contentModifier
                    }
                    Box(adjustedContentModifier) {
                        val startRoute = start
                        if (startRoute != null) AppNavHost(nav, container, startRoute)
                    }

                    if (!onPlayer && navigationVisible && (oledPhoneNavigation || oledWideNavigation)) {
                        val navigationPlacement = LocalThemeCustomization.current.componentPlacement["global_navigation"] ?: "center"
                        val chromeAlignment = when {
                            oledPhoneNavigation -> Alignment.BottomCenter
                            navigationPlacement == "start" -> Alignment.TopStart
                            navigationPlacement == "end" -> Alignment.BottomStart
                            else -> Alignment.CenterStart
                        }
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(safeInsets),
                            contentAlignment = chromeAlignment,
                        ) {
                            OledNavigationChrome(currentRoute, onTab, windowInfo.mode)
                        }
                    }

                    val repoSyncing by container.repo.syncing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    val catalogSyncing by container.catalogSync.syncing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    val channelSyncing by container.channelSync.syncing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    val epgSyncing by container.epgSync.syncing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    val switchingAccount by container.switchingAccount.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    val syncing = repoSyncing || catalogSyncing || channelSyncing || epgSyncing || switchingAccount
                    if (switchingAccount && !onPlayer) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxSize()
                                .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.58f))
                                .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures { } },
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                        ) {
                            GlassPanel(shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), strong = true, padding = 28.dp) {
                                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                                    CircularProgressIndicator(color = Palette.FocusCyan)
                                    Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
                                    Text(
                                        text = "جاري تبديل الاشتراك وتحديث القنوات والأفلام...",
                                        color = Palette.Text,
                                        fontSize = 15.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Box(
                        Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter,
                    ) {
                        SyncOverlay(
                            visible = syncing && !switchingAccount && !onPlayer,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 24.dp),
                        )
                    }

                    NotificationPermissionPrompt(
                        currentRoute = currentRoute,
                        isTv = isTv,
                    )

                    if (!onPlayer) {
                        SyncPinUnlockDialog(
                            container = container,
                            nav = nav,
                        )

                        GithubUpdatePrompt(container = container)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun AppNavHost(nav: NavHostController, container: AppContainer, start: String) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val focusController = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val play: (PlayRequest) -> Unit = { request ->
        if (focusController.canNavigateNow()) {
            container.playback = request
            container.savePendingPlayback(request)
            nav.navigate(Routes.PLAYER) { launchSingleTop = true }
        }
    }
    val open: (String) -> Unit = { route ->
        if (focusController.canNavigateNow()) {
            nav.navigate(route) { launchSingleTop = true }
        }
    }
    val back: () -> Unit = {
        nav.popBackStack()
    }
    val idArgument = listOf(navArgument("id") { type = NavType.StringType })

    NavHost(
        navController = nav,
        startDestination = start,
        enterTransition = { fadeIn(tween(140)) },
        exitTransition = { fadeOut(tween(100)) },
        popEnterTransition = { fadeIn(tween(140)) },
        popExitTransition = { fadeOut(tween(100)) },
    ) {
        composable(Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN) {
            val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
            var restoringCloud by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
            val fromSettings = remember { nav.previousBackStackEntry?.destination?.route == Routes.SETTINGS }

            BackHandler(enabled = fromSettings && !restoringCloud) {
                nav.popBackStack()
            }

            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                CloudLoginScreen(
                    skipLabel = if (fromSettings) "رجوع" else "تخطي الآن (بدون حفظ سحابي)",
                    onSuccess = {
                        if (!restoringCloud) {
                            restoringCloud = true
                            scope.launch {
                                container.syncCoordinator.syncFcmToken(context)
                                val restoredAccount = runCatching {
                                    container.syncCoordinator.performCloudRestoreAndMerge()
                                }.getOrNull()
                                restoringCloud = false
                                if (restoredAccount != null) {
                                    container.prefs.setActiveAccount(restoredAccount.id)
                                    container.repo.setAccount(restoredAccount)
                                    container.syncCoordinator.triggerFullSync(
                                        context = context,
                                        forceCatalog = false,
                                        reason = "cloud_login_restore",
                                    )
                                    nav.navigate(Routes.HOME) {
                                        popUpTo(Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    nav.navigate(Routes.LOGIN) {
                                        popUpTo(Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    onSkip = {
                        if (fromSettings) {
                            nav.popBackStack()
                        } else {
                            // مسار التخطي بدون حساب سحابي: لا يتم تفعيل أي رفع سحابي
                            container.mergeCoordinator.reset()
                            nav.navigate(Routes.LOGIN) { popUpTo(Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN) { inclusive = true } }
                        }
                    }
                )

                if (restoringCloud) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.68f))
                            .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures { } },
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                    ) {
                        GlassPanel(shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), strong = true, padding = 28.dp) {
                            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                                CircularProgressIndicator(color = Palette.FocusCyan)
                                Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
                                Text(
                                    text = "جاري استعادة الاشتراك والمفضلة من السحابة...",
                                    color = Palette.Text,
                                    fontSize = 15.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(onLoggedIn = {
                container.syncCoordinator.triggerFullSync(
                    context = context,
                    forceCatalog = false,
                    reason = "login",
                )
                nav.navigate(Routes.HOME) { popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true } }
            })
        }
        composable(Routes.HOME) { HomeScreen(onOpen = open, onPlay = play) }
        composable(Routes.LIVE) { LiveScreen(onBack = back, onPlay = play) }
        composable(Routes.MOVIES) {
            BrowseScreen(series = false, onBack = back, onOpenItem = { open(Routes.movie(it)) }, onPlay = play)
        }
        composable(Routes.SERIES) {
            BrowseScreen(series = true, onBack = back, onOpenItem = { open(Routes.series(it)) }, onPlay = play)
        }
        composable(Routes.FAVORITES) { FavoritesScreen(onBack = back, onOpen = open, onPlay = play) }
        composable(Routes.SETTINGS) {
            val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
            SettingsScreen(
                onBack = back,
                onOpenCloudLogin = { nav.navigate(Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN) },
                onLoggedOut = {
                    container.mergeCoordinator.reset()
                    container.authManager.signOut(context)
                    container.repo.setAccount(null)
                    scope.launch {
                        container.clearAllLocalData(clearPrefsAccount = true)
                        nav.navigate(Routes.CLOUD_LOGIN) {
                            popUpTo(nav.graph.findStartDestination().id) { inclusive = true }
                            launchSingleTop = true
                        }
                    }
                },
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.MOVIE_PATTERN, arguments = idArgument) { entry ->
            MovieDetailScreen(
                id = entry.arguments?.getString("id").orEmpty(),
                onBack = back,
                onPlay = play,
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.SERIES_PATTERN, arguments = idArgument) { entry ->
            SeriesDetailScreen(
                id = entry.arguments?.getString("id").orEmpty(),
                onBack = back,
                onPlay = play,
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.PLAYER) { PlayerScreen(container = container, onBack = back) }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun NotificationPermissionPrompt(
    currentRoute: String?,
    isTv: Boolean,
) {
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) return
    if (currentRoute != Routes.HOME || isTv) return

    val context = LocalContext.current
    val fcmPrefs = remember(context) {
        context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences("sahab_fcm_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    }
    var showPrompt by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val launcher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(),
    ) { _ ->
        fcmPrefs.edit().putBoolean("prompted_notifications", true).apply()
        showPrompt = false
    }

    LaunchedEffect(currentRoute) {
        val alreadyGranted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
            context,
            Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS,
        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val alreadyPrompted = fcmPrefs.getBoolean("prompted_notifications", false)
        if (!alreadyGranted && !alreadyPrompted) {
            showPrompt = true
        }
    }

    if (showPrompt) {
        androidx.compose.ui.window.Dialog(
            onDismissRequest = {
                fcmPrefs.edit().putBoolean("prompted_notifications", true).apply()
                showPrompt = false
            },
        ) {
            GlassPanel(shape = RoundedCornerShape(22.dp), strong = true, padding = 22.dp) {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    Text(
                        text = "تفعيل الإشعارات",
                        color = Palette.Text,
                        fontSize = 18.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "هل ترغب في استقبال تنبيهات المباريات والأفلام والتحديثات الجديدة من سحاب؟",
                        color = Palette.TextDim,
                        fontSize = 14.sp,
                    )
                    androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row(
                        horizontalArrangement = androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                    ) {
                        com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassButton(
                            text = "تفعيل",
                            primary = true,
                            onClick = {
                                showPrompt = false
                                runCatching { launcher.launch(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) }
                            },
                        )
                        com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassButton(
                            text = "لاحقاً",
                            onClick = {
                                fcmPrefs.edit().putBoolean("prompted_notifications", true).apply()
                                showPrompt = false
                            },
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SyncPinUnlockDialog(
    container: AppContainer,
    nav: NavHostController,
) {
    val needsPin by container.syncCoordinator.needsSyncPinPrompt.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    if (!needsPin) return

    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var pin by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var errorMsg by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var unlocking by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    androidx.compose.ui.window.Dialog(
        onDismissRequest = { container.syncCoordinator.dismissSyncPinPrompt() },
    ) {
        GlassPanel(shape = RoundedCornerShape(22.dp), strong = true, padding = 22.dp) {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "استعادة الاشتراك المشفر",
                    color = Palette.Text,
                    fontSize = 18.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                )
                Text(
                    text = "اشتراكك السحابي محمي برمز مزامنة (Sync PIN). أدخل الرمز لفك التشفير واستعادته:",
                    color = Palette.TextDim,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                )
                com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassTextField(
                    value = pin,
                    onValueChange = { pin = it; errorMsg = null },
                    placeholder = "رمز المزامنة (Sync PIN)",
                    keyboardType = [REDACTED]
                    password = [REDACTED]
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                if (errorMsg != null) {
                    Text(errorMsg!!, color = Palette.Danger, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
                androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                ) {
                    com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassButton(
                        text = if (unlocking) "جاري الفك..." else "استعادة",
                        primary = true,
                        onClick = {
                            if (unlocking) return@GlassButton
                            unlocking = true
                            scope.launch {
                                when (container.syncCoordinator.submitRestorePin(context, pin)) {
                                    is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.CloudAccountRestoreResult.Restored -> {
                                        nav.navigate(Routes.HOME) {
                                            popUpTo(nav.graph.findStartDestination().id) { inclusive = true }
                                            launchSingleTop = true
                                        }
                                    }
                                    is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth.CloudAccountRestoreResult.WrongPin -> {
                                        errorMsg = "رمز المزامنة غير صحيح"
                                    }
                                    else -> {
                                        errorMsg = "تعذر العثور على اشتراك بهذا الرمز"
                                    }
                                }
                                unlocking = false
                            }
                        },
                    )
                    com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassButton(
                        text = "لاحقاً",
                        onClick = { container.syncCoordinator.dismissSyncPinPrompt() },
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun GithubUpdatePrompt(container: AppContainer) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var pendingUpdate by remember { mutableStateOf<com.saydlawy.sahab.data.GithubReleaseUpdate?>(null) }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(5_000L)
        pendingUpdate = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.GithubReleaseUpdater.checkForUpdate(container.client)
    }

    val update = pendingUpdate ?: return
    androidx.compose.ui.window.Dialog(onDismissRequest = { pendingUpdate = null }) {
        com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassPanel(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape(22.dp),
            strong = true,
            padding = 20.dp,
        ) {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                Text(
                    "تحديث جديد متاح (${update.versionCode})",
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 16.sp,
                )
                Text(
                    "يتوفر إصدار أحدث من سحاب (${update.title}). يمكنك تحميله الآن أو لاحقاً.",
                    color = Palette.TextDim,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                )
                androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassButton(
                        text = "تحديث الآن",
                        primary = true,
                        onClick = {
                            val target = update.apkUrl.ifBlank { update.htmlUrl }
                            if (com.saydlawy.sahab.data.GithubReleaseUpdater.isTrustedReleaseUrl(target)) {
                                runCatching {
                                    context.startActivity(
                                        android.content.Intent(
                                            android.content.Intent.ACTION_VIEW,
                                            android.net.Uri.parse(target),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            pendingUpdate = null
                        },
                    )
                    com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.components.GlassButton(
                        text = "لاحقاً",
                        onClick = { pendingUpdate = null },
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

import androidx.compose.runtime.staticCompositionLocalOf

enum class WidthSizeClass { COMPACT, MEDIUM, EXPANDED }

enum class HeightSizeClass { COMPACT, MEDIUM, EXPANDED }

/**
 * Three independent adaptive display modes:
 * - [PHONE_PORTRAIT]: Vertical single-column mobile layout (video on top, lists below).
 * - [PHONE_LANDSCAPE]: Horizontal mobile layout (video-first or 2-pane compact, no TV clutter).
 * - [TABLET_OR_TV]: Large screen multi-column / full TV OSD layout.
 */
enum class DisplayMode {
    PHONE_PORTRAIT,
    PHONE_LANDSCAPE,
    TABLET_OR_TV,
}

data class AdaptiveWindowInfo(
    val widthClass: WidthSizeClass = WidthSizeClass.COMPACT,
    val heightClass: HeightSizeClass = HeightSizeClass.MEDIUM,
    val mode: DisplayMode = DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT,
    val widthDp: Dp = 390.dp,
    val heightDp: Dp = 844.dp,
) {
    val isPhone: Boolean get() = mode != DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
    val isPhonePortrait: Boolean get() = mode == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT
    val isPhoneLandscape: Boolean get() = mode == DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE
    val isLargeScreen: Boolean get() = mode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
}

fun computeAdaptiveWindowInfo(
    maxWidth: Dp,
    maxHeight: Dp,
    isTv: Boolean,
): AdaptiveWindowInfo {
    val widthClass = when {
        maxWidth < 600.dp -> WidthSizeClass.COMPACT
        maxWidth < 840.dp -> WidthSizeClass.MEDIUM
        else -> WidthSizeClass.EXPANDED
    }
    val heightClass = when {
        maxHeight < 480.dp -> HeightSizeClass.COMPACT
        maxHeight < 900.dp -> HeightSizeClass.MEDIUM
        else -> HeightSizeClass.EXPANDED
    }
    val smallestDimension = minOf(maxWidth, maxHeight)
    val isLandscape = maxWidth > maxHeight
    val mode = when {
        isTv -> DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
        smallestDimension >= 600.dp -> DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
        isLandscape -> DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE
        else -> DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT
    }
    return AdaptiveWindowInfo(
        widthClass = widthClass,
        heightClass = heightClass,
        mode = mode,
        widthDp = maxWidth,
        heightDp = maxHeight,
    )
}

val LocalContainer = staticCompositionLocalOf<AppContainer> { error("AppContainer is not provided") }

val LocalIsTv = staticCompositionLocalOf { false }

/** True when the person asked for a lighter look (no moving background, no scaling animations). */
val LocalLightEffects = staticCompositionLocalOf { false }

/** Global scale multiplier (kept at 1f on mobile so Arabic text is never shrunk). */
val LocalAppScale = compositionLocalOf { 1f }

/** Current adaptive window size class and display mode. */
val LocalWindowInfo = compositionLocalOf { AdaptiveWindowInfo() }

val LocalDisplayMode = compositionLocalOf { DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT }

/** Jumps to a top-level section (the tabs of the top bar) without piling up the back stack. */
val LocalTabNavigator = staticCompositionLocalOf<(String) -> Unit> { {} }

class SimpleFactory(private val build: () -> ViewModel) : ViewModelProvider.Factory {
    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    override fun <T : ViewModel> create(modelClass: Class<T>): T = build() as T
}

@Composable
inline fun <reified VM : ViewModel> appViewModel(
    key: String? = null,
    noinline build: (AppContainer) -> VM,
): VM {
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    return viewModel<VM>(key = key, factory = SimpleFactory { build(container) })
}

    const val SETTINGS = "settings"

    const val SERIES_PATTERN = "series/{id}"

    fun movie(id: String) = "movie/$id"
    fun series(id: String) = "series/$id"
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.browse

import androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween

import com.saydlawy.sahab.util.Ar

@Composable
fun BrowseScreen(
    series: Boolean,
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onOpenItem: (String) -> Unit,
    onPlay: (PlayRequest) -> Unit = {},
) {
    val route = if (series) Routes.SERIES else Routes.MOVIES
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val focusNav = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val savedCategory = remember(route) { focusNav.getSelectedCategory(route) }
    val savedQuery = remember(route) { focusNav.getSearchQuery(route) }

    val vm = appViewModel(key = route) { BrowseViewModel(it, series, savedCategory, savedQuery) }
    val state by vm.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val kind = if (series) Kind.SERIES else Kind.MOVIE

    val layoutStyle by remember(container, series) {
        if (series) container.prefs.seriesLayoutStyle else container.prefs.moviesLayoutStyle
    }.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC)

    val activeAccountId by container.prefs.activeAccountId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = container.prefs.currentActiveAccountId(),
    )
    val allFavorites by container.prefs.favorites.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val allRecents by container.prefs.recents.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val favorites = remember(allFavorites, activeAccountId) { allFavorites.forAccount(activeAccountId) }
    val recents = remember(allRecents, activeAccountId) { allRecents.forAccount(activeAccountId) }
    val favoriteIds = remember(favorites, kind) { favorites.filter { it.kind == kind }.map { it.id }.toSet() }
    val screenRecents = remember(recents, series) {
        if (series) recents.filter { it.kind == Kind.SERIES || it.kind == Kind.EPISODE }
        else recents.filter { it.kind == Kind.MOVIE }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(state.selectedId) {
        state.selectedId?.let { focusNav.setSelectedCategory(route, it) }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(state.query) {
        focusNav.setSearchQuery(route, state.query)
    }

    val playRecent: (RecentItem) -> Unit = { recent ->
        focusNav.markNavigateFrom(route, "browse_recent_${recent.kind}_${recent.id}")
        onPlay(
            PlayRequest(
                items = listOf(
                    PlayItem(
                        kind = recent.kind,
                        id = recent.id,
                        title = recent.title,
                        subtitle = recent.subtitle,
                        icon = recent.icon,
                        ext = recent.ext,
                        groupId = recent.groupId,
                    ),
                ),
                startIndex = 0,
                fromStart = false,
                initialPositionMs = recent.positionMs,
            ),
        )
    }

    val rawItems = state.visibleItems
    val items = remember(rawItems, state.selectedId, favoriteIds, state.searchResults, favorites, screenRecents) {
        when {
            state.selectedId == RECENTS_CAT_ID && state.searchResults == null -> {
                screenRecents.map { r ->
                    Poster(
                        id = if (series && r.groupId.isNotBlank()) r.groupId else r.id,
                        name = r.title,
                        image = r.icon,
                        rating = "",
                        ext = r.ext,
                        year = r.subtitle,
                    )
                }.distinctBy { it.id }
            }
            state.selectedId == FAV_CAT_ID && state.searchResults == null -> {
                val fromPool = rawItems.filter { it.id in favoriteIds }
                if (fromPool.isNotEmpty()) fromPool
                else favorites.filter { it.kind == kind }.map {
                    Poster(id = it.id, name = it.name, image = it.icon, rating = "", ext = it.ext, year = "")
                }
            }
            else -> rawItems
        }
    }

    val gridStorageKey = "${route}_grid_${state.selectedId ?: ALL_CAT_ID}"
    val gridState = rememberRestorableLazyGridState(gridStorageKey)
    val displayMode = LocalDisplayMode.current

    val callbacks = remember(route, vm, onOpenItem, onBack) {
        BrowseLayoutCallbacks(
            onSelectCategory = { catId ->
                focusNav.setSelectedCategory(route, catId)
                vm.select(catId)
            },
            onQuery = vm::onQuery,
            onOpenPoster = { poster ->
                focusNav.markNavigateFrom(route, "poster_${poster.id}")
                onOpenItem(poster.id)
            },
            onOpenPosterWithKey = { poster, focusKey ->
                focusNav.markNavigateFrom(route, focusKey)
                onOpenItem(poster.id)
            },
            onToggleFavorite = vm::toggleFavorite,
            onPosterFocused = vm::onPosterFocused,
            onPlayRecent = playRecent,
            onRetry = { state.selectedId?.let(vm::select) },
            onBack = onBack,
        )
    }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val showTopBar by remember(displayMode, gridState, layoutStyle) {
            derivedStateOf {
                displayMode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV ||
                    layoutStyle != VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC ||
                    !gridState.canScrollBackward ||
                    (gridState.firstVisibleItemIndex == 0 && gridState.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset < 28)
            }
        }

        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            AnimatedVisibility(
                visible = showTopBar,
                enter = expandVertically(tween(180)) + fadeIn(tween(160)),
                exit = shrinkVertically(tween(180)) + fadeOut(tween(140)),
            ) {
                SahabTopBar(current = route, onBack = onBack)
            }

            when {
                state.loadingCategories -> LoadingBox()
                state.categories.isEmpty() && items.isEmpty() -> MessageBox(
                    message = state.error ?: Ar.noCategories,
                    actionLabel = Ar.retry,
                    onAction = vm::loadCategories,
                )
                else -> when (layoutStyle) {
                    VodLayoutStyle.CLASSIC -> ClassicBrowseLayout(
                        route = route,
                        series = series,
                        state = state,
                        items = items,
                        favoriteIds = favoriteIds,
                        screenRecents = screenRecents,
                        gridState = gridState,
                        callbacks = callbacks,
                    )
                    VodLayoutStyle.PRIME -> PrimeBrowseLayout(
                        route = route,
                        state = state,
                        items = items,
                        favoriteIds = favoriteIds,
                        screenRecents = screenRecents,
                        gridState = gridState,
                        callbacks = callbacks,
                    )
                    VodLayoutStyle.NETFLIX -> NetflixBrowseLayout(
                        route = route,
                        series = series,
                        state = state,
                        items = items,
                        favoriteIds = favoriteIds,
                        callbacks = callbacks,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
