@Composable
private fun MoviePosterFrame(url: String, title: String, modifier: Modifier) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp)
    Box(
        modifier
            .aspectRatio(2f / 3f)
            .shadow(20.dp, shape, ambientColor = Palette.Royal, spotColor = Palette.Glow)
            .clip(shape)
            .background(Palette.Glass)
            .border(1.5.dp, Palette.Glow.copy(alpha = 0.45f), shape)
            .padding(6.dp),
    ) {
        RemoteImage(
            url = url,
            fallbackText = title,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)),
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MoviePostersStrip(
    posters: List<String>,
    selectedIndex: Int,
    title: String,
    onSelect: (Int) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    LazyRow(
        modifier = modifier,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        itemsIndexed(posters, key = { idx, url -> "${url}_$idx" }) { idx, url ->
            val selected = idx == selectedIndex
            val thumbShape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(46.dp)
                    .aspectRatio(2f / 3f)
                    .clip(thumbShape)
                    .border(
                        width = if (selected) 2.dp else 1.dp,
                        color = if (selected) Palette.Glow else Palette.GlassBorder,
                        shape = thumbShape,
                    )
                    .clickable { onSelect(idx) },
            ) {
                RemoteImage(
                    url = url,
                    fallbackText = title,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MovieInfoPanel(
    details: MovieDetails,
    activePoster: String,
    resumeMs: Long,
    durationMs: Long,
    isFavorite: Boolean,
    onToggleFavorite: () -> Unit,
    item: PlayItem,
    onPlay: (PlayRequest) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier,
    onGenerateStory: () -> Unit = {},
    aiState: AiGenerationState = AiGenerationState.Idle,
    refreshingMetadata: Boolean = false,
    onRefreshMetadata: () -> Unit = {},
) {
    val themeCustomization = LocalThemeCustomization.current
    val showMetadata = themeCustomization.isVisible("details_metadata")
    val showActions = themeCustomization.isVisible("details_actions")
    Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
        if (details.trailerUrl.isNotBlank()) {
            TrailerAutoPlayBox(
                trailerUrl = details.trailerUrl,
                posterUrl = details.backdrop.ifBlank { activePoster },
                title = details.name,
                autoPlayDelayMs = 200L,
                startMuted = false,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(210.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)),
            )
        }
        if (showMetadata) {
            Text(
                details.name,
                style = TextStyle(brush = Palette.BrandText, fontSize = 32.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
            )

            // Metadata badges row
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
            ) {
            qualityOf(details.name)?.let { q ->
                Tag(q, if (q == "4K") Palette.Gold else Palette.Glow)
            }
            if (details.year.isNotBlank()) {
                Tag(details.year, Palette.Royal)
            }
            if (details.duration.isNotBlank()) {
                Text(details.duration, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, color = Palette.TextDim)
            }
            if (details.rating.isNotBlank()) {
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(50))
                        .background(Palette.Gold.copy(alpha = 0.16f))
                        .border(1.dp, Palette.Gold.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(50))
                        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    Icon(Ic.Star, contentDescription = null, tint = Palette.Gold, modifier = Modifier.size(15.dp))
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                    Text(details.rating, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Palette.Gold)
                }
            }
            if (details.ext.isNotBlank()) {
                Tag(details.ext.uppercase(), Palette.TextDim)
            }
            }

            // Genre tags
            if (details.genre.isNotBlank()) {
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    details.genre.split(",", "،", "/").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.take(4).forEach { g ->
                        Tag(g, Palette.Glow, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                }
            }

            if (resumeMs > 10_000 && durationMs > 0) {
                ProgressLine((resumeMs.toFloat() / durationMs).coerceIn(0f, 1f), Modifier.fillMaxWidth(0.6f), height = 5.dp)
            }
        }

        // Actions
        val screenKey = remember(details.id) { "movie/${details.id}" }
        if (showActions) Row(
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            val canResume = resumeMs > 10_000
            GlassButton(
                text = if (canResume) Ar.resumeFrom(formatDuration(resumeMs)) else Ar.play,
                onClick = { onPlay(PlayRequest(listOf(item), 0, initialPositionMs = resumeMs)) },
                icon = Ic.Play,
                primary = true,
                autoFocus = false,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(
                    screenKey = screenKey,
                    itemKey = "movie_play_btn",
                    isDefaultEntry = true,
                ),
            )
            if (canResume) {
                GlassButton(
                    text = Ar.fromStart,
                    onClick = { onPlay(PlayRequest(listOf(item), 0, fromStart = true)) },
                    modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(
                        screenKey = screenKey,
                        itemKey = "movie_from_start_btn",
                    ),
                )
            }
            GlassIconButton(
                icon = if (isFavorite) Ic.Heart else Ic.HeartOutline,
                description = Ar.favorites,
                onClick = onToggleFavorite,
                size = 54.dp,
                selected = isFavorite,
                tint = if (isFavorite) Palette.Live else Palette.Glow,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(
                    screenKey = screenKey,
                    itemKey = "movie_fav_btn",
                ),
            )
            GlassIconButton(
                icon = Ic.Refresh,
                description = "تحديث المعلومات",
                onClick = onRefreshMetadata,
                size = 54.dp,
                selected = refreshingMetadata,
                tint = if (refreshingMetadata) Palette.Gold else Palette.Glow,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(
                    screenKey = screenKey,
                    itemKey = "movie_refresh_btn",
                ),
            )
        }

        // Plot & cast inside a glass panel
        if (showMetadata) GlassPanel(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(22.dp),
            padding = 20.dp,
        ) {
            AiStoryPlotSection(
                plot = details.plot,
                emptyLabel = "لا توجد قصة متاحة لهذا الفيلم.",
                aiState = aiState,
                onGenerateStory = onGenerateStory,
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(18.dp))

            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                if (details.director.isNotBlank()) {
                    DetailRow(Ar.director, details.director)
                }
                if (details.cast.isNotBlank()) {
                    DetailRow(Ar.cast, details.cast)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun DetailRow(label: String, value: String) {
    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top) {
        Text(
            text = label,
            fontSize = 14.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            color = Palette.Glow,
            modifier = Modifier.width(96.dp),
        )
        Text(
            text = value,
            fontSize = 14.sp,
            color = Palette.Text,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        )
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.detail

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope

data class DetailUiState<T>(
    val loading: Boolean = true,
    val data: T? = null,
    val error: String? = null,
)

class MovieDetailViewModel(private val container: AppContainer, private val id: String) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(DetailUiState<MovieDetails>())
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    private val _aiState = MutableStateFlow<com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState>(com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Idle)
    val aiState = _aiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _refreshingMetadata = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val refreshingMetadata = _refreshingMetadata.asStateFlow()

    fun generateAiStory() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Loading
            val details = _state.value.data
            if (details == null) {
                _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Error("لا توجد بيانات معروضة")
                return@launch
            }
            val entity = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamId(id) }.getOrNull()
            }
            val imdbId = entity?.imdbId ?: ""
            val result = generateStoryWithKeyRotation(
                container = container,
                rawName = details.name,
                year = details.year,
                imdbId = imdbId,
                posterUrl = details.image,
                contentType = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.ContentType.MOVIE,
            )
            if (result == null) {
                _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.NoKey
                return@launch
            }
            when (result) {
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.Success -> {
                    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    if (entity != null) {
                        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            container.catalogDb.movieDao().updateAiPlot(
                                sahabId = entity.sahabId,
                                plot = result.story,
                                source = "gemini_user_key",
                                confidence = result.confidence,
                                identifiedTitle = result.identifiedTitle,
                                now = now,
                            )
                        }
                    } else {
                        val newEntity = CatalogMovieEntity(
                            sahabId = "pending:$id",
                            novaStreamId = id,
                            titleAr = details.name,
                            year = details.year,
                            plot = result.story,
                            plotSource = "gemini_user_key",
                            plotConfidence = result.confidence,
                            identifiedTitle = result.identifiedTitle,
                            posterUrl = details.image,
                            backdropUrl = details.backdrop,
                            cast = details.cast,
                            director = details.director,
                            genre = details.genre,
                            runtime = details.duration,
                            rating = details.rating,
                            containerExtension = details.ext,
                            needsEnrichment = 0,
                            lastEnriched = now,
                            lastSeen = now,
                        )
                        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().upsert(newEntity) }
                        }
                    }
                    val updated = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamId(id) }.getOrNull()
                    }
                    if (updated != null) {
                        // رفع القصة الجديدة إلى السحابة (Firebase) ليستفيد منها باقي المستخدمين
                        container.appScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            container.firebaseCatalog.saveCatalogItem(updated)
                        }
                        _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = updated.toMovieDetails()) }
                    } else {
                        _state.update { st ->
                            val d = st.data
                            if (d != null) st.copy(data = d.copy(plot = result.story)) else st
                        }
                    }
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Success(result.story, result.sources)
                }
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.RateLimited -> {
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.RateLimited
                }
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.InvalidKey -> {
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.InvalidKey
                }
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.Error -> {
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Error(result.message)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun dismissAiDialog() {
        _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Idle
    }

    init {
        load()
    }

    private fun CatalogMovieEntity.toMovieDetails(): MovieDetails {
        val posters = postersJson
            .lineSequence()
            .map { line -> line.trim() }
            .filter { line -> line.isNotEmpty() }
            .toList()
        return MovieDetails(
            id = novaStreamId,
            name = titleAr.ifBlank { titleEn },
            image = posterUrl,
            backdrop = backdropUrl.ifBlank { posterUrl },
            plot = plot,
            cast = cast,
            director = director,
            genre = genre,
            year = year,
            duration = runtime,
            rating = rating,
            ext = containerExtension,
            posterUrls = posters,
            trailerUrl = trailerUrl,
        )
    }

    fun load() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            // 1. Instant: read from Room
            val fromRoom = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamId(id) }.getOrNull()
            }

            if (fromRoom != null) {
                var currentDetails = fromRoom.toMovieDetails()
                _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = currentDetails) }

                // 2. Background enrichment if needed or if plot is missing in Room
                if (fromRoom.needsEnrichment == 1 || currentDetails.plot.isBlank()) {
                    try {
                        container.catalogSync.enrichOne(container.repo, container.tmdb, id)
                        val updated = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamId(id) }.getOrNull()
                        }
                        if (updated != null) {
                            currentDetails = updated.toMovieDetails()
                            _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = currentDetails) }
                        }
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        // Keep showing basic data on enrichment failure
                    }
                }

                // 3. Fallback to repo.movieDetails when plot is still blank after Room lookup/enrichment
                if (currentDetails.plot.isBlank()) {
                    try {
                        val remote = container.repo.movieDetails(id)
                        val merged = currentDetails.copy(
                            image = currentDetails.image.ifBlank { remote.image },
                            backdrop = if (currentDetails.backdrop.isBlank() || currentDetails.backdrop == currentDetails.image) {
                                remote.backdrop.ifBlank { currentDetails.backdrop }
                            } else {
                                currentDetails.backdrop
                            },
                            plot = remote.plot.ifBlank { currentDetails.plot },
                            cast = currentDetails.cast.ifBlank { remote.cast },
                            director = currentDetails.director.ifBlank { remote.director },
                            genre = currentDetails.genre.ifBlank { remote.genre },
                            year = currentDetails.year.ifBlank { remote.year },
                            duration = currentDetails.duration.ifBlank { remote.duration },
                            rating = currentDetails.rating.ifBlank { remote.rating },
                        )
                        _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = merged) }
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        // Keep existing details if remote fallback fails
                    }
                }
                return@launch
            }

            // 3. Fallback: movie not yet in Room — use original repo path
            _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = true) }
            try {
                val details = container.repo.movieDetails(id)
                _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = details) }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, error = e.userMessage()) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun toggleFavorite(details: MovieDetails) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            container.prefs.toggleFavorite(
                FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, details.id, details.name, details.image, details.ext, accountId = container.prefs.currentActiveAccountId())
            )
        }
    }

    fun refreshMetadata() {
        if (_refreshingMetadata.value) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _refreshingMetadata.value = true
            try {
                container.catalogSync.enrichOne(container.repo, container.tmdb, id, force = true)
                val updated = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamId(id) }.getOrNull()
                }
                if (updated != null) {
                    _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = updated.toMovieDetails()) }
                } else {
                    val details = container.repo.movieDetails(id)
                    _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = details) }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                // Keep existing details visible if manual refresh fails
            } finally {
                _refreshingMetadata.value = false
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SeriesDetailScreen(id: String, onBack: () -> Unit, onPlay: (PlayRequest) -> Unit) {
    val vm = appViewModel(key = "series_$id") { SeriesDetailViewModel(it, id) }
    val state by vm.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val aiState by vm.aiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val activeAccountId by container.prefs.activeAccountId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = container.prefs.currentActiveAccountId(),
    )
    val favorites by container.prefs.favorites.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val allRecents by container.prefs.recents.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val recents = remember(allRecents, activeAccountId) { allRecents.forAccount(activeAccountId) }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val details = state.data
        if (details != null) {
            RemoteImage(details.backdrop.ifBlank { details.cover }, Modifier.fillMaxSize().alpha(0.22f))
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(
                                Palette.DeepBlue.copy(alpha = 0.55f),
                                Palette.DeepBlue.copy(alpha = 0.88f),
                                Palette.DeepBlue.copy(alpha = 0.98f),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
            )
        }

        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            SahabTopBar(current = Routes.SERIES, onBack = onBack)

            when {
                state.loading -> LoadingBox()
                details == null -> MessageBox(state.error ?: Ar.errUnknown, actionLabel = Ar.retry, onAction = vm::load)
                else -> {
                    val isFavorite = favorites.isFav(activeAccountId, Kind.SERIES, details.id)
                    SeriesContent(
                        details = details,
                        recents = recents,
                        isFavorite = isFavorite,
                        aiState = aiState,
                        onGenerateStory = { vm.generateAiStory() },
                        onToggleFavorite = { vm.toggleFavorite(details) },
                        onRefresh = { vm.refreshMetadata() },
                        onPlay = onPlay,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun playItem(details: SeriesDetails, episode: Episode) = PlayItem(
    kind = Kind.EPISODE,
    id = episode.id,
    title = details.name,
    subtitle = Ar.seasonEpisode(episode.season, episode.number),
    icon = episode.image.ifBlank { details.cover },
    ext = episode.ext,
    groupId = details.id,
)

@Composable
private fun SeriesContent(
    details: SeriesDetails,
    recents: List<RecentItem>,
    isFavorite: Boolean,
    aiState: com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState,
    onGenerateStory: () -> Unit,
    onToggleFavorite: () -> Unit,
    onRefresh: () -> Unit,
    onPlay: (PlayRequest) -> Unit,
) {
    val focusNav = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val screenKey = remember(details.id) { "series/${details.id}" }
    val seasons = details.seasons
    var selectedSeasonIndex by remember(details.id) {
        mutableIntStateOf(
            focusNav.getSelectedSeason(details.id).coerceIn(0, (seasons.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
        )
    }
    LaunchedEffect(selectedSeasonIndex) {
        focusNav.saveSelectedSeason(details.id, selectedSeasonIndex)
    }
    val season = seasons.getOrNull(selectedSeasonIndex) ?: seasons.firstOrNull()
    val visibleEpisodes = details.episodes.filter { it.season == season }
    val posterList = remember(details.id, details.cover, details.posterUrls, season, visibleEpisodes) {
        val seasonCovers = visibleEpisodes.map { it.image.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        val basePosters = if (details.posterUrls.isNotEmpty()) details.posterUrls else listOf(details.cover)
        (basePosters.map { it.trim() } + seasonCovers + listOf(details.cover.trim()))
            .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            .distinct()
    }
    var selectedPosterIndex by remember(details.id, season, posterList) { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val activePoster = posterList.getOrElse(selectedPosterIndex) { details.cover }
    val seasonPreviewPoster = visibleEpisodes.firstOrNull { it.image.isNotBlank() }?.image
        ?: details.backdrop.ifBlank { activePoster }
    val queue = remember(details) { details.episodes.map { playItem(details, it) } }
    val episodeIds = remember(details) { details.episodes.map { it.id }.toSet() }
    val progress = remember(recents, details.id, episodeIds) {
        recents.filter {
            it.kind == Kind.EPISODE && (it.groupId == details.id || it.id in episodeIds)
        }.associateBy { it.id }
    }
    val lastWatched = remember(recents, details.id, episodeIds) {
        recents.firstOrNull {
            it.kind == Kind.EPISODE && (it.groupId == details.id || it.id in episodeIds)
        }
    }
    val resumeIndex = lastWatched?.let { last -> details.episodes.indexOfFirst { it.id == last.id } } ?: -1
    val resumePosMs = lastWatched?.positionMs ?: -1L
    val episodesState = rememberRestorableLazyListState("series_episodes_${details.id}_$selectedSeasonIndex")
    val seasonsRowState = rememberRestorableLazyListState("series_seasons_${details.id}")

    val displayMode = LocalDisplayMode.current
    val hPad = when (displayMode) {
        DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV -> 36.dp
        DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE -> 20.dp
        DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT -> 16.dp
    }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {

        LazyColumn(
            state = episodesState,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().focusRestorer(),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = hPad, vertical = 14.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
        ) {
            item {
                when (displayMode) {
                    DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV -> {
                        Row(
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(36.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top,
                        ) {
                            Column(
                                modifier = Modifier.width(185.dp),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                            ) {
                                SeriesCoverFrame(activePoster, details.name, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                                if (posterList.size > 1) {
                                    SeriesPostersStrip(
                                        posters = posterList,
                                        selectedIndex = selectedPosterIndex,
                                        title = details.name,
                                        onSelect = { selectedPosterIndex = it },
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            SeriesInfoPanel(
                                details = details,
                                previewPoster = seasonPreviewPoster,
                                season = season,
                                resumeIndex = resumeIndex,
                                resumePositionMs = resumePosMs,
                                queue = queue,
                                isFavorite = isFavorite,
                                aiState = aiState,
                                onGenerateStory = onGenerateStory,
                                onToggleFavorite = onToggleFavorite,
                                onRefresh = onRefresh,
                                onPlay = onPlay,
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE -> {
                        Row(
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top,
                        ) {
                            Column(
                                modifier = Modifier.width(140.dp),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                            ) {
                                SeriesCoverFrame(activePoster, details.name, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                                if (posterList.size > 1) {
                                    SeriesPostersStrip(
                                        posters = posterList,
                                        selectedIndex = selectedPosterIndex,
                                        title = details.name,
                                        onSelect = { selectedPosterIndex = it },
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            SeriesInfoPanel(
                                details = details,
                                previewPoster = seasonPreviewPoster,
                                season = season,
                                resumeIndex = resumeIndex,
                                resumePositionMs = resumePosMs,
                                queue = queue,
                                isFavorite = isFavorite,
                                aiState = aiState,
                                onGenerateStory = onGenerateStory,
                                onToggleFavorite = onToggleFavorite,
                                onRefresh = onRefresh,
                                onPlay = onPlay,
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT -> {
                        Column {
                            SeriesCoverFrame(
                                activePoster,
                                details.name,
                                Modifier.width(160.dp).align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
                            )
                            if (posterList.size > 1) {
                                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                                SeriesPostersStrip(
                                    posters = posterList,
                                    selectedIndex = selectedPosterIndex,
                                    title = details.name,
                                    onSelect = { selectedPosterIndex = it },
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                )
                            }
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                            SeriesInfoPanel(
                                details = details,
                                previewPoster = seasonPreviewPoster,
                                season = season,
                                resumeIndex = resumeIndex,
                                resumePositionMs = resumePosMs,
                                queue = queue,
                                isFavorite = isFavorite,
                                aiState = aiState,
                                onGenerateStory = onGenerateStory,
                                onToggleFavorite = onToggleFavorite,
                                onRefresh = onRefresh,
                                onPlay = onPlay,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (seasons.size > 1) {
                item {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                    LazyRow(
                        state = seasonsRowState,
                        modifier = Modifier.focusRestorer(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 6.dp),
                    ) {
                        items(seasons.size, key = { index -> seasons[index] }) { index ->
                            Chip(
                                text = Ar.season(seasons[index]),
                                selected = index == selectedSeasonIndex,
                                onClick = { selectedSeasonIndex = index },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(top = 6.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    DotTitle(
                        text = if (season != null) "${Ar.season(season)} · ${visibleEpisodes.size} حلقة" else Ar.seriesSub,
                        dot = Palette.Glow,
                        fontSize = 16.sp,
                    )
                }
            }

            if (details.episodes.isEmpty()) {
                item { Text(Ar.noEpisodes, fontSize = 16.sp, color = Palette.TextDim) }
            }

            items(visibleEpisodes, key = { it.id }) { episode ->
                EpisodeRow(
                    episode = episode,
                    coverFallback = details.cover,
                    saved = progress[episode.id],
                    screenKey = screenKey,
                    onClick = {
                        val index = details.episodes.indexOfFirst { it.id == episode.id }
                        if (index >= 0) onPlay(PlayRequest(queue, index))
                    },
                )
            }
            item { Spacer(Modifier.height(48.dp)) }
        }
    }
}

@Composable

    posters: List<String>,

    title: String,
    onSelect: (Int) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    LazyRow(
        modifier = modifier,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        itemsIndexed(posters, key = { idx, url -> "${url}_$idx" }) { idx, url ->
            val selected = idx == selectedIndex
            val thumbShape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(46.dp)
                    .aspectRatio(2f / 3f)
                    .clip(thumbShape)
                    .border(
                        width = if (selected) 2.dp else 1.dp,
                        color = if (selected) Palette.Glow else Palette.GlassBorder,
                        shape = thumbShape,
                    )
                    .clickable { onSelect(idx) },
            ) {
                RemoteImage(
                    url = url,
                    fallbackText = title,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

    val showMetadata = themeCustomization.isVisible("details_metadata")
    val showActions = themeCustomization.isVisible("details_actions")
    val trailerKey = if (season != null) "${details.trailerUrl}#s$season" else details.trailerUrl
    Column(modifier, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
        if (details.trailerUrl.isNotBlank()) {

            ) {

            }

                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,

                    ProgressLine(saved.positionMs.toFloat() / saved.durationMs, height = 4.dp)
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))

        }
    }

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.detail

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.saydlawy.sahab.AppContainer
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.FavItem
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Kind
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.SeriesDetails
import com.saydlawy.sahab.util.userMessage
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

class SeriesDetailViewModel(private val container: AppContainer, private val id: String) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(DetailUiState<SeriesDetails>())
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    init {
        load()
    }

    fun load() {
        refreshMetadata()
    }

    fun refreshMetadata() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = true) }
            try {
                var details = container.repo.seriesDetails(id)
                val needsMeta = details.plot.isBlank() ||
                    details.genre.isBlank() ||
                    details.year.isBlank() ||
                    details.rating.isBlank() ||
                    details.cast.isBlank() ||
                    details.backdrop.isBlank()

                if (needsMeta) {
                    val mergedMeta = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        var candidate = runCatching {
                            container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamIdAndType(id, "series")
                        }.getOrNull()

                        if (candidate == null || candidate.plot.isBlank()) {
                            val remote = runCatching {
                                container.firebaseCatalog.getCatalogItem("series_pending:$id")
                            }.getOrNull()
                            if (remote != null && (remote.plot.isNotBlank() || remote.genre.isNotBlank() || remote.year.isNotBlank())) {
                                val normalized = remote.copy(novaStreamId = id, mediaType = "series")
                                runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().upsert(normalized) }
                                candidate = normalized
                            }
                        }

                        if (candidate == null || candidate.plot.isBlank()) {
                            runCatching {
                                container.catalogSync.enrichOne(
                                    repo = container.repo,
                                    tmdb = container.tmdb,
                                    streamId = id,
                                    mediaType = "series",
                                )
                                container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamIdAndType(id, "series")
                            }.getOrNull()?.let { enriched ->
                                candidate = enriched
                            }
                        }
                        candidate
                    }

                    if (mergedMeta != null) {
                        details = details.copy(
                            backdrop = details.backdrop.ifBlank { mergedMeta.backdropUrl },
                            plot = details.plot.ifBlank { mergedMeta.plot },
                            cast = details.cast.ifBlank { mergedMeta.cast },
                            genre = details.genre.ifBlank { mergedMeta.genre },
                            year = details.year.ifBlank { mergedMeta.year },
                            rating = details.rating.ifBlank { mergedMeta.rating },
                        )
                    }
                }
                val catalogRecord = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().findByStreamIdAndType(id, "series") }.getOrNull()
                }
                if (catalogRecord != null) {
                    val posters = catalogRecord.postersJson
                        .lineSequence()
                        .map { line -> line.trim() }
                        .filter { line -> line.isNotEmpty() }
                        .toList()
                    val resolvedTrailer = if (catalogRecord.trailerUrl.isNotBlank()) {
                        catalogRecord.trailerUrl
                    } else {
                        val tid = catalogRecord.tmdbId
                        if (tid != [REDACTED]
                            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                                runCatching { container.tmdb.getTvDetailsById(tid)?.trailerUrl }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
                            }
                        } else {
                            ""
                        }
                    }
                    details = details.copy(
                        backdrop = details.backdrop.ifBlank { catalogRecord.backdropUrl },
                        posterUrls = posters,
                        trailerUrl = resolvedTrailer,
                    )
                }
                _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, data = details) }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _state.update { DetailUiState(loading = false, error = e.userMessage()) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun toggleFavorite(details: SeriesDetails) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            container.prefs.toggleFavorite(
                FavItem(Kind.SERIES, details.id, details.name, details.cover, accountId = container.prefs.currentActiveAccountId())
            )
        }
    }

    private val _aiState = MutableStateFlow<com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState>(
        com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Idle,
    )
    val aiState = _aiState.asStateFlow()

    /** O-02: Generate series story using Gemini key rotation and persist to global_catalog. */
    fun generateAiStory() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Loading
            val details = _state.value.data
            if (details == null) {
                _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Error("لا توجد بيانات معروضة")
                return@launch
            }
            val result = generateStoryWithKeyRotation(
                container = container,
                rawName = details.name,
                year = details.year,
                imdbId = "",
                posterUrl = details.cover,
                contentType = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.ContentType.SERIES,
            )
            if (result == null) {
                _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.NoKey
                return@launch
            }
            when (result) {
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.Success -> {
                    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    val entity = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.CatalogMovieEntity(
                        sahabId = "series_pending:$id",
                        novaStreamId = id,
                        mediaType = "series",
                        titleAr = details.name,
                        year = details.year,
                        plot = result.story,
                        plotSource = "gemini_user_key",
                        plotConfidence = result.confidence,
                        identifiedTitle = result.identifiedTitle,
                        posterUrl = details.cover,
                        backdropUrl = details.backdrop,
                        cast = details.cast,
                        genre = details.genre,
                        rating = details.rating,
                        needsEnrichment = 0,
                        lastEnriched = now,
                        lastSeen = now,
                    )
                    kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO) {
                        runCatching { container.catalogDb.movieDao().upsert(entity) }
                    }
                    container.appScope.launch(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO) {
                        container.firebaseCatalog.saveCatalogItem(entity)
                    }
                    _state.update { st ->
                        val d = st.data
                        if (d != null) st.copy(data = d.copy(plot = result.story)) else st
                    }
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Success(result.story, result.sources)
                }
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.RateLimited -> {
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.RateLimited
                }
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.InvalidKey -> {
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.InvalidKey
                }
                is com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.GeminiResult.Error -> {
                    _aiState.value = com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ai.AiGenerationState.Error(result.message)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/ui/focus/FocusRestorationManager.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.focus

import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.compose.foundation.ExperimentalFoundationApi
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyListState
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.grid.LazyGridState
import androidx.compose.foundation.relocation.BringIntoViewRequester
import androidx.compose.foundation.relocation.bringIntoViewRequester
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.DisposableEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.Stable
import androidx.compose.runtime.compositionLocalOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateMapOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.snapshotFlow
import androidx.compose.runtime.withFrameNanos
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.focus.FocusRequester
import androidx.compose.ui.focus.focusRequester
import androidx.compose.ui.focus.onFocusChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged

data class SavedScrollPosition(
    val index: Int = 0,
    val offset: Int = 0,
)

/**
 * Central state coordinator for Android TV D-Pad Navigation & Exact Focus Restoration.
 *
 * Lifecycle tracked per screen:
 * 1. Focus Acquired / Changed -> [recordFocus]
 * 2. Item Activated (OK / Enter) -> [markNavigateFrom]
 * 3. Destination Screen / Dialog Opened
 * 4. Back Pressed -> [onBackToScreen]
 * 5. Previous Screen & Scroll Offset Restored -> [rememberRestorableLazyListState] / [rememberRestorableLazyGridState]
 * 6. Exact Element Focus Restored -> [restorableFocus]
 */
@Stable
class FocusNavigationController {

    /** Last known focused item key for each screenKey (e.g. "home" -> "trending_128491"). */
    private val lastFocusedByScreen = mutableStateMapOf<String, String>()

    /** Active pending restoration target per screenKey; non-null when returning via Back or closing a Dialog. */
    private val pendingRestoreByScreen = mutableStateMapOf<String, String>()

    /** Monotonic counter per screenKey so repeated restorations to the same itemKey re-trigger LaunchedEffect. */
    private val restoreGenerationByScreen = mutableStateMapOf<String, Int>()

    /** Saved scroll positions for LazyColumn / LazyRow keyed by logical container ID. */
    private val listScrollPositions = HashMap<String, SavedScrollPosition>()

    /** Saved scroll positions for LazyVerticalGrid keyed by logical container ID. */
    private val gridScrollPositions = HashMap<String, SavedScrollPosition>()

    /** Saved selected category / tab / filter per screenKey so state survives Back navigation. */
    private val selectedFilterByScreen = mutableStateMapOf<String, String>()

    /** Saved previewed item ID (channel or poster) per screenKey. */
    private val previewItemByScreen = mutableStateMapOf<String, String>()

    /** Saved selected season index per series ID. */
    private val selectedSeasonBySeries = mutableStateMapOf<String, Int>()

    /** Saved search query per screenKey. */
    private val searchQueryByScreen = mutableStateMapOf<String, String>()

    /** Guard against duplicate navigation on rapid OK / Center presses. */
    private var lastNavigationUptimeMs: Long = 0L

    fun canNavigateNow(debounceMs: Long = 320L): Boolean {
        val now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
        if (now - lastNavigationUptimeMs < debounceMs) return false
        lastNavigationUptimeMs = now
        return true
    }

    /** Called when an item receives D-Pad focus. */
    fun recordFocus(screenKey: String, itemKey: String) {
        if (screenKey.isNotBlank() && itemKey.isNotBlank()) {
            lastFocusedByScreen[screenKey] = itemKey
        }
    }

    /** Called immediately before opening a detail screen, player, or dialog from [itemKey]. */
    fun markNavigateFrom(screenKey: String, itemKey: String) {
        if (screenKey.isNotBlank() && itemKey.isNotBlank()) {
            lastFocusedByScreen[screenKey] = itemKey
            pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey] = itemKey
            restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] = (restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] ?: 0) + 1
        }
    }

    /** Called when a screen becomes active again after Back press or Dialog dismissal. */
    fun onScreenResumed(screenKey: String) {
        val target = pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey] ?: lastFocusedByScreen[screenKey]
        if (!target.isNullOrBlank()) {
            pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey] = target
            restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] = (restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] ?: 0) + 1
        }
    }

    /** Triggers focus restoration to the item that was focused before opening a Dialog/Sheet. */
    fun restoreAfterDialogDismiss(screenKey: String, fallbackItemKey: String? = null) {
        val target = lastFocusedByScreen[screenKey] ?: fallbackItemKey
        if (!target.isNullOrBlank()) {
            pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey] = target
            restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] = (restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] ?: 0) + 1
        }
    }

    fun pendingTarget(screenKey: String): String? = pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey]

    fun lastFocused(screenKey: String): String? = lastFocusedByScreen[screenKey]

    fun restoreGeneration(screenKey: String): Int = restoreGenerationByScreen[screenKey] ?: 0

    fun hasSavedFocus(screenKey: String): Boolean =
        !pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey].isNullOrBlank() || !lastFocusedByScreen[screenKey].isNullOrBlank()

    fun consumeRestore(screenKey: String, itemKey: String) {
        if (pendingRestoreByScreen[screenKey] == itemKey) {
            pendingRestoreByScreen.remove(screenKey)
        }
    }

    // --- Scroll State Persistence ---

    fun getListScroll(key: String): SavedScrollPosition =
        listScrollPositions[key] ?: SavedScrollPosition(0, 0)

    fun saveListScroll(key: String, index: Int, offset: Int) {
        listScrollPositions[key] = SavedScrollPosition(index, offset)
    }

    fun getGridScroll(key: String): SavedScrollPosition =
        gridScrollPositions[key] ?: SavedScrollPosition(0, 0)

    fun saveGridScroll(key: String, index: Int, offset: Int) {
        gridScrollPositions[key] = SavedScrollPosition(index, offset)
    }

    // --- Screen Filter / Category / Season / Preview Persistence ---

    fun getSelectedCategory(screenKey: String): String? = selectedFilterByScreen[screenKey]

    fun setSelectedCategory(screenKey: String, categoryId: String?) {
        if (categoryId == null) selectedFilterByScreen.remove(screenKey)
        else selectedFilterByScreen[screenKey] = categoryId
    }

    fun saveSelectedCategory(screenKey: String, categoryId: String?) =
        setSelectedCategory(screenKey, categoryId)

    fun getPreviewItem(screenKey: String): String? = previewItemByScreen[screenKey]

    fun setPreviewItem(screenKey: String, itemId: String?) {
        if (itemId == null) previewItemByScreen.remove(screenKey)
        else previewItemByScreen[screenKey] = itemId
    }

    fun getSelectedSeason(seriesId: String): Int = selectedSeasonBySeries[seriesId] ?: 0

    fun setSelectedSeason(seriesId: String, seasonIndex: Int) {
        selectedSeasonBySeries[seriesId] = seasonIndex
    }

    fun saveSelectedSeason(seriesId: String, seasonIndex: Int) =
        setSelectedSeason(seriesId, seasonIndex)

    fun getSearchQuery(screenKey: String): String = searchQueryByScreen[screenKey].orEmpty()

    fun setSearchQuery(screenKey: String, query: String) {
        if (query.isBlank()) searchQueryByScreen.remove(screenKey)
        else searchQueryByScreen[screenKey] = query
    }

    fun saveSearchQuery(screenKey: String, query: String) =
        setSearchQuery(screenKey, query)
}

val LocalFocusNavigation = compositionLocalOf { FocusNavigationController() }

/**
 * Remembers a [LazyListState] whose exact `(firstVisibleItemIndex, firstVisibleItemScrollOffset)`
 * is persisted inside [FocusNavigationController] under [storageKey].
 * When returning via Back navigation, the list starts at the exact saved scroll offset without jumping to 0.
 */
@Composable
fun rememberRestorableLazyListState(storageKey: String): LazyListState {
    val controller = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val initial = remember(storageKey) { controller.getListScroll(storageKey) }
    val state = remember(storageKey) {
        LazyListState(
            firstVisibleItemIndex = initial.index,
            firstVisibleItemScrollOffset = initial.offset,
        )
    }
    LaunchedEffect(state, storageKey) {
        snapshotFlow { state.firstVisibleItemIndex to state.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset }
            .distinctUntilChanged()
            .collect { (idx, off) ->
                controller.saveListScroll(storageKey, idx, off)
            }
    }
    DisposableEffect(storageKey) {
        onDispose {
            controller.saveListScroll(
                storageKey,
                state.firstVisibleItemIndex,
                state.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset,
            )
        }
    }
    return state
}

/**
 * Remembers a [LazyGridState] whose exact `(firstVisibleItemIndex, firstVisibleItemScrollOffset)`
 * is persisted inside [FocusNavigationController] under [storageKey].
 */
@Composable
fun rememberRestorableLazyGridState(storageKey: String): LazyGridState {
    val controller = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val initial = remember(storageKey) { controller.getGridScroll(storageKey) }
    val state = remember(storageKey) {
        LazyGridState(
            firstVisibleItemIndex = initial.index,
            firstVisibleItemScrollOffset = initial.offset,
        )
    }
    LaunchedEffect(state, storageKey) {
        snapshotFlow { state.firstVisibleItemIndex to state.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset }
            .distinctUntilChanged()
            .collect { (idx, off) ->
                controller.saveGridScroll(storageKey, idx, off)
            }
    }
    DisposableEffect(storageKey) {
        onDispose {
            controller.saveGridScroll(
                storageKey,
                state.firstVisibleItemIndex,
                state.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset,
            )
        }
    }
    return state
}

/**
 * Attaches deterministic D-Pad focus tracking and exact focus restoration to any focusable card/item.
 *
 * - Whenever this item receives D-Pad focus, its [itemKey] is saved under [screenKey].
 * - When returning to [screenKey] after Back navigation (or dialog close), if [itemKey] matches the
 *   saved focus target, it brings the item into view and requests focus on frame readiness.
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
fun Modifier.restorableFocus(
    screenKey: String,
    itemKey: String,
    isDefaultEntry: Boolean = false,
): Modifier {
    val controller = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val requester = remember(screenKey, itemKey) { FocusRequester() }
    val bringIntoViewRequester = remember(screenKey, itemKey) { BringIntoViewRequester() }

    val pendingTarget = controller.pendingTarget(screenKey)
    val restoreGen = controller.restoreGeneration(screenKey)
    val hasAnySaved = controller.hasSavedFocus(screenKey)

    val shouldRestoreThis = pendingTarget == itemKey ||
        (pendingTarget == null && !hasAnySaved && isDefaultEntry)

    if (shouldRestoreThis) {
        LaunchedEffect(screenKey, itemKey, restoreGen, pendingTarget) {
            withFrameNanos { }
            runCatching { bringIntoViewRequester.bringIntoView() }
            withFrameNanos { }
            val focusedOk = runCatching { requester.requestFocus() }.isSuccess
            if (focusedOk && pendingTarget == itemKey) {
                controller.consumeRestore(screenKey, itemKey)
            }
        }
    }

    return this
        .bringIntoViewRequester(bringIntoViewRequester)
        .focusRequester(requester)
        .onFocusChanged { focusState ->
            if (focusState.isFocused) {
                controller.recordFocus(screenKey, itemKey)
                if (controller.pendingTarget(screenKey) == itemKey) {
                    controller.consumeRestore(screenKey, itemKey)
                }
            }
        }
}

@Composable
fun FavoritesScreen(onBack: () -> Unit, onOpen: (String) -> Unit, onPlay: (PlayRequest) -> Unit) {
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val isTv = LocalIsTv.current
    val activeAccountId by container.prefs.activeAccountId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = container.prefs.currentActiveAccountId(),
    )
    val allFavorites by container.prefs.favorites.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val favorites = remember(allFavorites, activeAccountId) { allFavorites.forAccount(activeAccountId) }
    var filterKind by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val filtered = remember(favorites, filterKind) {
        if (filterKind == null) favorites else favorites.filter { it.kind == filterKind }
    }
    val gridState = rememberRestorableLazyGridState("favorites_grid_${filterKind ?: "all"}")

    val displayMode = LocalDisplayMode.current
    val hPad = if (displayMode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV) 24.dp else 14.dp

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        SahabTopBar(current = Routes.FAVORITES, onBack = onBack)

        if (favorites.isEmpty()) {
            MessageBox(Ar.noFavorites)
        } else {
            Row(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = hPad, vertical = 6.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
                LazyRow(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                ) {
                    item {
                        Chip("${Ar.all} (${favorites.size})", filterKind == null, { filterKind = null })
                    }
                    item {
                        Chip(Ar.live, filterKind == Kind.LIVE, { filterKind = Kind.LIVE })
                    }
                    item {
                        Chip(Ar.movies, filterKind == Kind.MOVIE, { filterKind = Kind.MOVIE })
                    }
                    item {
                        Chip(Ar.series, filterKind == Kind.SERIES, { filterKind = Kind.SERIES })
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))

            if (filtered.isEmpty()) {
                MessageBox(Ar.noFavorites)
            } else {
                LazyVerticalGrid(
                    columns = if (displayMode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV) GridCells.Fixed(6) else GridCells.Adaptive(132.dp),
                    state = gridState,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().focusRestorer(),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = hPad, vertical = 12.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                ) {
                    item(span = { GridItemSpan(maxLineSpan) }) {
                        Row(
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        ) {
                            DotTitle(Ar.favoritesSub, Palette.Glow, fontSize = 14.sp)
                            Text(Ar.favoritesHint, fontSize = 12.sp, color = Palette.TextDim)
                        }
                    }
                    items(filtered, key = { "${it.accountId}_${it.kind}_${it.id}" }) { favorite ->
                        PosterCard(
                            title = favorite.name,
                            imageUrl = favorite.icon,
                            quality = qualityOf(favorite.name),
                            subtitle = Ar.kindLabel(favorite.kind),
                            contentScale = if (favorite.kind == Kind.LIVE) ContentScale.Fit else ContentScale.Crop,
                            onClick = {
                                when (favorite.kind) {
                                    Kind.LIVE -> onPlay(
                                        PlayRequest(listOf(PlayItem(Kind.LIVE, favorite.id, favorite.name, icon = favorite.icon, url = favorite.url)), 0),
                                    )
                                    Kind.MOVIE -> onOpen(Routes.movie(favorite.id))
                                    else -> onOpen(Routes.series(favorite.id))
                                }
                            },
                            onLongClick = { scope.launch { container.prefs.toggleFavorite(favorite) } },
                            modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(
                                screenKey = Routes.FAVORITES,
                                itemKey = "fav_${favorite.kind}_${favorite.id}",
                            ),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun ContinueWatchingCard(
    item: ContinueCardModel,
    useRedBar: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val pct = (item.progress * 100).toInt().coerceIn(5, 99)
    val barColor = if (useRedBar) Palette.LiveBadgeRed else Palette.FocusCyan

    GlassCard(
        onClick = item.onClick,
        modifier = modifier,
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        focusScale = 1.04f,
    ) { focused ->
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .background(Palette.CardSurface),
        ) {
            RemoteImage(
                url = item.imageUrl,
                fallbackText = item.title,
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            )

            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            colorStops = arrayOf(
                                0.0f to Palette.CinematicBg.copy(alpha = 0.10f),
                                0.45f to Palette.CinematicBg.copy(alpha = 0.40f),
                                0.80f to Palette.CinematicBg.copy(alpha = 0.90f),
                                1.0f to Palette.CinematicBg.copy(alpha = 0.97f),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
            )

            if (focused) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .border(2.5.dp, Palette.FocusCyan, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
                )
            }

            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),

                Row(

                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,

                            color = Color.White,
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        )
                    }

                    if (item.progress > 0f) {
                        Text(
                            text = "$pct%",
                            color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,

    index: Int,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val focused by interaction.collectIsFocusedAsState()
    val isTv = LocalIsTv.current
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()

    val scale by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = when {
            pressed -> 0.96f
            focused && isTv -> 1.06f
            else -> 1f
        },
        animationSpec = tween(140),
        label = "chScale",
    )

    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
    val accentColors = listOf(
        Palette.LiveBadgeRed,
        Color(0xFF10B981),
        Color(0xFF8B5CF6),
        Palette.FocusCyan,
    )
    val bottomAccent = accentColors[index % accentColors.size]
    val circleSize = if (LocalDisplayMode.current == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV) 54.dp else 46.dp

    val primaryLogoUrl = remember(channel.icon, channel.name) {
        ChannelLogoResolver.resolvePrimaryUrl(channel.icon, channel.name)
    }
    val fallbackLogoUrl = remember(channel.name) {
        ChannelLogoResolver.resolveInternetLogoUrl(channel.name)
    }
    val (brandLabel, brandColor) = remember(channel.name) {
        ChannelLogoResolver.resolveBrandStyle(channel.name)
    }
    var activeLogoUrl by remember(primaryLogoUrl, fallbackLogoUrl) { mutableStateOf(primaryLogoUrl) }
    var logoFailed by remember(primaryLogoUrl, fallbackLogoUrl) { mutableStateOf(primaryLogoUrl.isBlank()) }

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .graphicsLayer {
                scaleX = scale
                scaleY = scale
            }
            .clip(shape)
            .background(if (focused) Palette.CardSurfaceElevated else Palette.CardSurface)
            .border(
                width = if (focused) 2.5.dp else 1.dp,
                color = if (focused) Palette.FocusCyan else Palette.CardBorderIdle,
                shape = shape,
            )
            .combinedClickable(
                interactionSource = interaction,
                indication = null,
                onClick = onClick,
            ),
    ) {
        // Centered circular channel badge with automatic internet logo resolution
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.Center)
                .offset(y = (-2).dp)
                .size(circleSize)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(Color.White)
                .border(1.5.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f), CircleShape)
                .padding(5.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            if (!logoFailed && activeLogoUrl.isNotBlank()) {
                AsyncImage(
                    model = activeLogoUrl,
                    contentDescription = channel.name,
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
                    onError = {
                        if (fallbackLogoUrl != null && activeLogoUrl != fallbackLogoUrl) {
                            activeLogoUrl = fallbackLogoUrl
                        } else {
                            logoFailed = true
                        }
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                )
            } else {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(brandColor.copy(alpha = 0.14f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = brandLabel,
                        color = brandColor,
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Red "مباشر" pill badge at TopEnd matching reference image
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.TopEnd)
                .padding(top = 6.dp, end = 8.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                .background(Palette.LiveBadgeRed)
                .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "مباشر",
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            )
        }

        // Subtle bottom progress/accent line matching reference image
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                .height(2.5.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(50))
                .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.14f)),
        ) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth(0.65f)
                    .height(2.5.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(50))
                    .background(bottomAccent),
            )
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SECTION E — تصفح الفئات السريعة (Quick Categories)
// Order from Right to Left (RTL): البث المباشر -> الأفلام -> المسلسلات
// ============================================================================
@Composable
internal fun QuickCategoriesSection(
    onOpenLive: () -> Unit,
    onOpenMovies: () -> Unit,
    onOpenSeries: () -> Unit,
) {
    val mode = LocalDisplayMode.current
    val isTvOrTablet = mode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
    val horizPad = if (isTvOrTablet) 24.dp else 14.dp
    val cardHeight = when (mode) {
        DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV -> 76.dp
        DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE -> 66.dp
        DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT -> 62.dp
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = horizPad),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
        ) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = Ic.FolderGrid,
                contentDescription = null,
                tint = Palette.TextMuted,
                modifier = Modifier.size(if (isTvOrTablet) 18.dp else 16.dp),
            )
            Text(
                text = "تصفح الفئات السريعة",
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = if (isTvOrTablet) 17.sp else 15.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            )
        }

        // Strict RTL order from Right to Left:
        // 1. البث المباشر (Right)  |  2. الأفلام (Center)  |  3. المسلسلات (Left)
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = horizPad),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isTvOrTablet) 14.dp else 8.dp),
        ) {
            QuickCategoryBanner(
                title = "البث المباشر",
                icon = Ic.Broadcast,
                gradient = Brush.horizontalGradient(
                    colors = listOf(Palette.CategoryLiveEnd, Palette.CategoryLiveStart),
                ),
                accentColor = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                compact = mode == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT,
                onClick = onOpenLive,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .height(cardHeight)
                    .restorableFocus(Routes.HOME, "home_quick_live"),
            )
            QuickCategoryBanner(
                title = "الأفلام",
                icon = Ic.Movie,
                gradient = Brush.horizontalGradient(
                    colors = listOf(Palette.CategoryMoviesEnd, Palette.CategoryMoviesStart),
                ),
                accentColor = Color(0xFFF87171),
                compact = mode == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT,
                onClick = onOpenMovies,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .height(cardHeight)
                    .restorableFocus(Routes.HOME, "home_quick_movies"),
            )
            QuickCategoryBanner(
                title = "المسلسلات",
                icon = Ic.Series,
                gradient = Brush.horizontalGradient(
                    colors = listOf(Palette.CategorySeriesEnd, Palette.CategorySeriesStart),
                ),
                accentColor = Color(0xFFA78BFA),
                compact = mode == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT,
                onClick = onOpenSeries,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .height(cardHeight)
                    .restorableFocus(Routes.HOME, "home_quick_series"),
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun QuickCategoryBanner(
    title: String,
    icon: ImageVector,
    gradient: Brush,
    accentColor: Color,
    compact: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    GlassCard(
        onClick = onClick,
        modifier = modifier,
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        fill = gradient,
        focusScale = 1.04f,
    ) { focused ->
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)),
        ) {
            if (!compact) {
                Canvas(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                        .size(96.dp),
                ) {
                    drawCircle(
                        color = accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.22f),
                        radius = size.minDimension * 0.55f,
                        center = Offset(size.width * 0.25f, size.height * 0.5f),
                    )
                    drawCircle(
                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f),
                        radius = size.minDimension * 0.35f,
                        center = Offset(size.width * 0.45f, size.height * 0.65f),
                    )
                }
            }

            if (focused) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .border(2.5.dp, Palette.FocusCyan, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)),
                )
            }

            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .padding(horizontal = if (compact) 6.dp else 18.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = if (compact) Arrangement.Center else Arrangement.Start,
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = icon,
                    contentDescription = title,
                    tint = Color.White,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(if (compact) 17.dp else 28.dp),
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.width(if (compact) 5.dp else 12.dp))
                Text(
                    text = title,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = if (compact) 12.sp else 18.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    softWrap = false,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Visible,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.home

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
