import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@Composable
fun HomeScreen(
    onOpen: (String) -> Unit,
    onPlay: (PlayRequest) -> Unit,
) {
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val vm: HomeViewModel = appViewModel { HomeViewModel(it, context.applicationContext) }
    val homeState by vm.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val focusNav = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val themeCustomization = LocalThemeCustomization.current
    val activeThemeId = LocalThemePreferences.current.selectedThemeId

    val activeAccountId by container.prefs.activeAccountId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = container.prefs.currentActiveAccountId(),
    )
    val allRecents by container.prefs.recents.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val allFavorites by container.prefs.favorites.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = emptyList())
    val recents = remember(allRecents, activeAccountId) { allRecents.forAccount(activeAccountId) }
    val favorites = remember(allFavorites, activeAccountId) { allFavorites.forAccount(activeAccountId) }
    val showRecents by container.prefs.showRecents.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = true)
    val showLiveChannels by container.prefs.showLiveChannelsOnHome.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = true)
    val showRecommended by container.prefs.showRecommendedOnHome.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = true)
    val showQuickCategories by container.prefs.showQuickCategoriesOnHome.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = true)

    val homeChannelsLayout by container.prefs.homeChannelsLayout.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = HomeChannelsLayout.CAROUSEL,
    )
    val homeChannelsSource by container.prefs.homeChannelsSource.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = HomeChannelsSource.AUTO,
    )
    val homeChannelsCategoryId by container.prefs.homeChannelsCategoryId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = "",
    )
    val homeCustomChannelIds by container.prefs.homeCustomChannelIds.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
        initialValue = emptySet(),
    )

    val featuredChannels = homeState.featuredChannels
    val trendingMovies = homeState.trendingMovies
    val topRatedMovies = homeState.topRatedMovies

    LaunchedEffect(
        container.repo.account,
        homeChannelsSource,
        homeChannelsCategoryId,
        homeCustomChannelIds,
        favorites,
    ) {
        vm.refreshFeaturedChannels(
            source = homeChannelsSource,
            categoryId = homeChannelsCategoryId,
            customIds = homeCustomChannelIds,
            favorites = favorites,
        )
    }

    LaunchedEffect(container.repo.account) {
        vm.refreshTrendingMovies()
    }

    val continueWatchingItems = remember(recents, trendingMovies) {
        if (recents.isNotEmpty()) {
            recents.take(10).mapIndexed { idx, item ->
                val rawProgress = if (item.durationMs > 0) {
                    (item.positionMs.toFloat() / item.durationMs.toFloat()).coerceIn(0.08f, 0.96f)
                } else {
                    0f
                }
                val itemFocusKey = "home_recent_${item.kind}_${item.id}_$idx"
                ContinueCardModel(
                    id = itemFocusKey,
                    title = item.title,
                    subtitle = item.subtitle.ifBlank { Ar.kindLabel(item.kind) },
                    imageUrl = item.icon,
                    progress = rawProgress,
                    onClick = {
                        focusNav.markNavigateFrom(Routes.HOME, itemFocusKey)
                        when (item.kind) {
                            Kind.LIVE -> onPlay(
                                PlayRequest(
                                    listOf(PlayItem(Kind.LIVE, item.id, item.title, icon = item.icon, url = item.url)),
                                    0,
                                ),
                            )
                            Kind.MOVIE -> onPlay(
                                PlayRequest(
                                    listOf(
                                        PlayItem(
                                            Kind.MOVIE,
                                            item.id,
                                            item.title,
                                            subtitle = item.subtitle,
                                            icon = item.icon,
                                            ext = item.ext.ifBlank { DEFAULT_VOD_EXT },
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                    startIndex = 0,
                                    fromStart = false,
                                    initialPositionMs = item.positionMs,
                                ),
                            )
                            Kind.EPISODE -> onPlay(
                                PlayRequest(
                                    listOf(
                                        PlayItem(
                                            Kind.EPISODE,
                                            item.id,
                                            item.title,
                                            subtitle = item.subtitle,
                                            icon = item.icon,
                                            ext = item.ext,
                                            groupId = item.groupId,
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                    startIndex = 0,
                                    fromStart = false,
                                    initialPositionMs = item.positionMs,
                                ),
                            )
                            else -> onOpen(Routes.series(item.id))
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
        } else {
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    val currentDisplayMode = LocalDisplayMode.current
    val isTvOrTablet = currentDisplayMode == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
    val mainFeedState = rememberRestorableLazyListState("home_main_vertical_feed")

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(
                Brush.verticalGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Palette.CinematicBg,
                        Palette.CinematicBgSecondary,
                        Palette.CinematicBg,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            // A. Top Navigation Bar (RTL)
            SahabTopBar(current = Routes.HOME)

            // Main scrollable vertical feed with preserved scroll & focus state
            LazyColumn(
                state = mainFeedState,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 28.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isTvOrTablet) 14.dp else 12.dp),
            ) {
                val sectionDefaultOrder = listOf(
                    "section_continue_watching", "section_live_channels", "section_trending_movies",
                    "section_top_rated", "section_quick_categories",
                )
                val orderedHomeSections = when (themeCustomization.componentPlacement["home_sections"]) {
                    "live_first" -> listOf("section_live_channels", "section_continue_watching", "section_trending_movies", "section_top_rated", "section_quick_categories")
                    "movies_first" -> listOf("section_trending_movies", "section_top_rated", "section_continue_watching", "section_live_channels", "section_quick_categories")
                    else -> sectionDefaultOrder
                }
                val visibleHomeSections = orderedHomeSections.filter { section ->
                    when (section) {
                        "section_continue_watching" -> showRecents && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_continue") && continueWatchingItems.isNotEmpty()
                        "section_live_channels" -> showLiveChannels && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_live_channels")
                        "section_trending_movies" -> showRecommended && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_recommendations")
                        "section_top_rated" -> showRecommended && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_recommendations") && topRatedMovies.isNotEmpty()
                        "section_quick_categories" -> showQuickCategories && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_categories")
                        else -> false
                    }
                }
                if (activeThemeId == "dynamic_bento" && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_highlights")) {
                    item(key = "bento_home_highlights") {
                        BentoHomeHighlights(
                            vertical = LocalDisplayMode.current == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT,
                            channelCount = featuredChannels.size,
                            movieCount = trendingMovies.size,
                            placement = themeCustomization.componentPlacement["home_highlights"] ?: "start",
                            onLive = { onOpen(Routes.LIVE) },
                            onMovies = { onOpen(Routes.MOVIES) },
                            onSeries = { onOpen(Routes.SERIES) },
                        )
                    }
                }
                if (activeThemeId == "oled_cinema" && themeCustomization.isVisible("home_spotlight") && currentDisplayMode != DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE) {
                    trendingMovies.firstOrNull()?.let { spotlight ->
                        item(key = "oled_home_spotlight") {
                            OledHomeSpotlight(
                                title = spotlight.titleAr,
                                subtitle = spotlight.year,
                                imageUrl = spotlight.posterUrl,
                                compact = LocalDisplayMode.current == DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT,
                                onClick = { onOpen(Routes.movie(spotlight.novaStreamId.ifEmpty { spotlight.sahabId })) },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                items(visibleHomeSections, key = { it }) { section ->
                    when (section) {
                        "section_continue_watching" -> ContinueWatchingSection(
                            items = continueWatchingItems,
                            hasRealRecents = recents.isNotEmpty(),
                            onClearRecents = { scope.launch { container.prefs.clearRecentsForAccount(activeAccountId) } },
                        )
                        "section_live_channels" -> FeaturedChannelsSection(
                            layout = homeChannelsLayout,
                            channels = featuredChannels,
                            onPlay = onPlay,
                            onSeeAll = {
                                focusNav.markNavigateFrom(Routes.HOME, "home_live_see_all")
                                onOpen(Routes.LIVE)
                            },
                        )
                        "section_trending_movies" -> TrendingMoviesSection(
                            movies = trendingMovies,
                            onMovieClick = { movie -> onOpen(Routes.movie(movie.novaStreamId.ifEmpty { movie.sahabId })) },
                        )
                        "section_top_rated" -> TrendingMoviesSection(
                            movies = topRatedMovies,
                            onMovieClick = { movie -> onOpen(Routes.movie(movie.novaStreamId.ifEmpty { movie.sahabId })) },
                            title = "الأعلى 10",
                            iconEmoji = "⭐",
                            rowKey = "home_top_rated_row",
                        )
                        "section_quick_categories" -> QuickCategoriesSection(
                            onOpenLive = { focusNav.markNavigateFrom(Routes.HOME, "home_quick_live"); onOpen(Routes.LIVE) },
                            onOpenMovies = { focusNav.markNavigateFrom(Routes.HOME, "home_quick_movies"); onOpen(Routes.MOVIES) },
                            onOpenSeries = { focusNav.markNavigateFrom(Routes.HOME, "home_quick_series"); onOpen(Routes.SERIES) },
                        )
                        else -> Unit
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

internal data class ContinueCardModel(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val subtitle: String,
    val imageUrl: String,
    val progress: Float,
    val onClick: () -> Unit,
)

@Composable
private fun BentoHomeHighlights(
    vertical: Boolean,
    channelCount: Int,
    movieCount: Int,
    placement: String,
    onLive: () -> Unit,
    onMovies: () -> Unit,
    onSeries: () -> Unit,
) {
    val live = Triple("البث المباشر", "$channelCount قناة", onLive)
    val movies = Triple("أفلام مقترحة", "$movieCount عملاً", onMovies)
    val series = Triple("المسلسلات", "تصفح المكتبة", onSeries)
    val highlights = when (placement) {
        "center" -> listOf(movies, live, series)
        "end" -> listOf(series, movies, live)
        else -> listOf(live, movies, series)
    }
    if (vertical) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
            highlights.forEach { (title, subtitle, action) -> BentoHighlightCard(title, subtitle, action, Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) }
        }
    } else {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 22.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            highlights.forEach { (title, subtitle, action) ->
                BentoHighlightCard(title, subtitle, action, Modifier.weight(1f))
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable

}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.home

import android.content.Context
import androidx.compose.runtime.Immutable
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.saydlawy.sahab.AppContainer
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Channel
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.FavItem
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.HomeChannelsSource
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Kind
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Repository
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.CatalogMovieEntity
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.Locale

@Immutable
data class HomeUiState(
    val featuredChannels: List<Channel> = emptyList(),
    val trendingMovies: List<CatalogMovieEntity> = emptyList(),
    val topRatedMovies: List<CatalogMovieEntity> = emptyList(),
)

/**
 * M-18: Owns Home screen data loading (featured channels, instant/enriched movies)
 * outside Composable state.
 */
class HomeViewModel(
    private val container: AppContainer,
    private val appContext: Context,
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(
        HomeUiState(trendingMovies = container.firebaseCatalog.peekCachedRecommendedMovies()),
    )
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    private var featuredJob: Job? = null
    private var trendingJob: Job? = null

    fun refreshFeaturedChannels(
        source: HomeChannelsSource,
        categoryId: String,
        customIds: Set<String>,
        favorites: List<FavItem>,
    ) {
        featuredJob?.cancel()
        featuredJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            val loaded = loadFeaturedChannels(
                repo = container.repo,
                source = source,
                categoryId = categoryId,
                customIds = customIds,
                favorites = favorites,
            )
            _state.update { it.copy(featuredChannels = loaded) }
        }
    }

    fun refreshTrendingMovies() {
        trendingJob?.cancel()
        trendingJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            val instant = runCatching {
                container.firebaseCatalog.getInstantRecommendedMovies(
                    repo = container.repo,
                    dao = container.catalogDb.movieDao(),
                    limit = 18,
                )
            }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
            if (instant.isNotEmpty()) {
                val topInstant = instant
                    .filter { (it.rating.toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0) > 0.0 }
                    .sortedByDescending { it.rating.toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0 }
                    .take(18)
                _state.update { it.copy(trendingMovies = instant, topRatedMovies = topInstant.ifEmpty { it.topRatedMovies }) }
            }

            val enriched = runCatching {
                container.firebaseCatalog.getXtreamRecommendedMovies(
                    repo = container.repo,
                    dao = container.catalogDb.movieDao(),
                    limit = 18,
                )
            }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
            if (enriched.isNotEmpty()) {
                val topEnriched = enriched
                    .filter { (it.rating.toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0) > 0.0 }
                    .sortedByDescending { it.rating.toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0 }
                    .take(18)
                _state.update { it.copy(trendingMovies = enriched, topRatedMovies = topEnriched.ifEmpty { it.topRatedMovies }) }
            }
        }
    }
}

internal suspend fun loadFeaturedChannels(
    repo: Repository,
    source: HomeChannelsSource,
    categoryId: String,
    customIds: Set<String>,
    favorites: List<FavItem>,
): List<Channel> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
    runCatching {
        val all = repo.peekAllLiveChannels() ?: repo.liveChannels(null)
        if (all.isEmpty()) return@withContext emptyList()

        when (source) {
            HomeChannelsSource.CUSTOM -> {
                if (customIds.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val byId = all.associateBy { it.id }
                    val picked = customIds.mapNotNull { byId[it] }
                    if (picked.isNotEmpty()) return@withContext picked
                }
            }
            HomeChannelsSource.FAVORITES -> {
                val favLiveIds = favorites.filter { it.kind == Kind.LIVE }.map { it.id }.toSet()
                if (favLiveIds.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val picked = all.filter { it.id in favLiveIds }
                    if (picked.isNotEmpty()) return@withContext picked
                }
            }
            HomeChannelsSource.CATEGORY -> {
                if (categoryId.isNotBlank()) {
                    val catChannels = all.filter { it.categoryId == categoryId }.ifEmpty {
                        runCatching { repo.liveChannels(categoryId) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                    }
                    if (catChannels.isNotEmpty()) return@withContext catChannels.take(18)
                }
            }
            HomeChannelsSource.AUTO -> Unit
        }

        val targetKeywords = listOf(
            listOf("bein sports 1", "bein sport 1", "بي ان سبورت 1"),
            listOf("mbc 1", "ام بي سي 1"),
            listOf("mbc action", "ام بي سي اكشن"),
            listOf("mbc masr", "ام بي سي مصر"),
            listOf("mbc drama", "ام بي سي دراما"),
            listOf("روتانا سينما", "rotana cinema"),
            listOf("روتانا خليجية", "rotana khalijiah", "rotana khalijia"),
            listOf("الجزيرة", "al jazeera", "aljazeera"),
            listOf("العربية", "alarabiya", "الحدث"),
            listOf("ssc 1", "ssc", "alkass", "الكأس", "on time"),
            listOf("ناشونال", "national geographic", "nat geo"),
            listOf("دبي", "dubai", "abu dhabi", "أبوظبي"),
        )

        val matched = mutableListOf<Channel>()
        val seen = mutableSetOf<String>()

        for (keywords in targetKeywords) {
            val candidate = all.firstOrNull { ch ->
                val lower = ch.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                keywords.any { kw -> lower.contains(kw.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)) } && seen.add(ch.id)
            }
            if (candidate != null) {
                matched.add(candidate)
            }
        }

        for (ch in all) {
            if (matched.size >= 14) break
            if (seen.add(ch.id)) {
                matched.add(ch)
            }
        }
        matched
    }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
}

import java.util.Locale

@Composable
fun CompactTopBarInfo(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val weather by container.weather.weather.collectAsState()
    var now by remember { mutableStateOf(System.currentTimeMillis()) }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        container.weather.refreshIfNeeded()
        while (true) {
            delay(30_000L)
            now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        }
    }

    val timeStr = remember(now) {
        formatNowMillis(now, "hh:mm a", Locale.forLanguageTag("ar"))
    }

    val (weatherIcon, weatherTint) = when (weather.condition) {
        WeatherCondition.CLEAR_DAY -> Ic.Sun to Color(0xFFFBBF24)
        WeatherCondition.CLEAR_NIGHT -> Ic.Cloud to Palette.Glow
        WeatherCondition.PARTLY_CLOUDY -> Ic.Sun to Color(0xFFFCD34D)
        WeatherCondition.CLOUDY, WeatherCondition.FOG -> Ic.Cloud to Palette.TextDim
        WeatherCondition.RAIN, WeatherCondition.THUNDERSTORM -> Ic.Cloud to Palette.FocusCyan
        WeatherCondition.SNOW -> Ic.Cloud to Color.White
    }

    Row(
        modifier = modifier.padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
        if (weather.city.isNotBlank()) {
            Text(
                text = weather.city,
                color = Palette.TextDim,
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
            )
        }
        Text(
            text = "${weather.tempC}°",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = 13.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        )
        Icon(
            imageVector = weatherIcon,
            contentDescription = weather.conditionText,
            tint = weatherTint,
            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),
        )
        Text(
            text = timeStr,
            color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.88f),
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun TrendingMoviesSection(
    movies: List<CatalogMovieEntity>,
    onMovieClick: (CatalogMovieEntity) -> Unit,
    title: String = "أفلام مقترحة لك",
    iconEmoji: String = "🔥",
    rowKey: String = "home_trending_movies_row",
) {
    if (movies.isEmpty()) return

    val focusNav = LocalFocusNavigation.current
    val isTvOrTablet = LocalDisplayMode.current == DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV
    val horizPad = if (isTvOrTablet) 24.dp else 14.dp
    val cardWidth = if (isTvOrTablet) 148.dp else 130.dp
    val rowState = rememberRestorableLazyListState(rowKey)

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(vertical = 2.dp),
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = horizPad, vertical = 6.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
            Text(
                text = iconEmoji,
                fontSize = if (isTvOrTablet) 17.sp else 15.sp,
            )
            Text(
                text = title,
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = if (isTvOrTablet) 17.sp else 15.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            )
        }

        LazyRow(
            state = rowState,
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = horizPad, vertical = 4.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
        ) {
            itemsIndexed(
                items = movies,
                key = { _, item -> "${rowKey}_${item.novaStreamId.ifEmpty { item.sahabId }}" },
            ) { index, movie ->
                val itemFocusKey = "${rowKey}_${movie.novaStreamId.ifEmpty { movie.sahabId }}"
                TrendingMovieCard(
                    movie = movie,
                    isNew = index < 4 || movie.year >= "2025",
                    onClick = {
                        focusNav.markNavigateFrom(Routes.HOME, itemFocusKey)
                        onMovieClick(movie)
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .width(cardWidth)
                        .restorableFocus(
                            screenKey = Routes.HOME,
                            itemKey = itemFocusKey,
                        ),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TrendingMovieCard(
    movie: CatalogMovieEntity,
    isNew: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val qualityTag = qualityOf(movie.titleAr)
    val ratingText = movie.rating.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "0" && it != "0.0" }
    val subtitleText = when {
        movie.genre.isNotBlank() -> movie.genre
        movie.plot.isNotBlank() -> movie.plot
        movie.year.isNotBlank() -> movie.year
        else -> ""
    }

    GlassCard(
        onClick = onClick,
        modifier = modifier.aspectRatio(2f / 3f),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        focusScale = 1.05f,
    ) { focused ->
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                .background(Palette.CardSurface),
        ) {
            RemoteImage(
                url = movie.posterUrl,
                fallbackText = movie.titleAr,
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            )

            // Smooth cinematic dark bottom gradient matching reference image
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            colorStops = arrayOf(
                                0.0f to Color.Transparent,
                                0.45f to Color(0x330B0D17),
                                0.74f to Color(0xCC0B0D17),
                                1.0f to Color(0xF80B0D17),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
            )

            // Focused glowing cyan border highlight matching reference image
            if (focused) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .border(2.5.dp, Palette.FocusCyan, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)),
                )
            }

            // Bottom metadata overlay
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = movie.titleAr,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
                Text(
                    text = subtitleText,
                    color = Palette.TextMuted,
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(3.dp))
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    // Right side in RTL: Gold star + rating (only when real rating exists)
                    if (ratingText != null) {
                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Ic.Star,
                                contentDescription = null,
                                tint = Palette.Gold,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(11.dp),
                            )
                            Text(
                                text = ratingText,
                                color = Palette.Gold,
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                            )
                        }
                    } else {
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(1.dp))
                    }

                    // Left side in RTL: Quality badge (only when real quality tag exists in title)
                    if (qualityTag != null) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                                .background(Color(0xCC1E2336))
                                .border(0.8.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.24f), RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                                .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = qualityTag,
                                color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.9f),
                                fontSize = 9.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun CategorySidebar(
    categories: List<Category>,
    customLists: List<ChannelListEntity> = emptyList(),
    selectedId: String?,
    onSelect: (String) -> Unit,
    onManageLists: () -> Unit = {},
    totalCount: Int,
    favCount: Int,
    categoryCounts: Map<String, Int>,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val listState = rememberRestorableLazyListState("live_categories_sidebar")
    LazyColumn(
        state = listState,
        modifier = modifier.focusRestorer(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(8)),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = appDp(4)),
    ) {
        item(key = FAV_CAT_ID) {
            SideNavItem(
                label = Ar.favorites,
                selected = selectedId == FAV_CAT_ID,
                onClick = { onSelect(FAV_CAT_ID) },
                count = favCount.takeIf { it > 0 },
                icon = Ic.HeartOutline,
                iconTint = Palette.Glow,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(Routes.LIVE, "live_cat_fav"),
            )
        }
        item(key = ALL_CAT_ID) {
            SideNavItem(
                label = Ar.all,
                selected = selectedId == ALL_CAT_ID || selectedId == null,
                onClick = { onSelect(ALL_CAT_ID) },
                count = totalCount.takeIf { it > 0 },
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(Routes.LIVE, "live_cat_all"),
            )
        }
        item(key = "manage_custom_lists") {
            SideNavItem(
                label = "إدارة القوائم المخصصة",
                selected = false,
                onClick = onManageLists,
                icon = Ic.Settings,
                iconTint = Palette.FocusCyan,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(Routes.LIVE, "live_cat_manage_lists"),
            )
        }
        items(customLists, key = { "custom_${it.listId}" }) { list ->
            val key = "$CUSTOM_LIST_PREFIX${list.listId}"
            SideNavItem(
                label = list.name,
                selected = selectedId == key,
                onClick = { onSelect(key) },
                icon = Ic.Tv,
                iconTint = Palette.Gold,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(Routes.LIVE, "live_cat_custom_${list.listId}"),
            )
        }
        items(categories, key = { it.id }) { cat ->
            val count = categoryCounts[cat.id]
            val isSport = cat.name.contains("رياض") || cat.name.uppercase().contains("SPORT") || cat.name.uppercase().contains("BEIN")
            SideNavItem(
                label = cat.name,
                selected = cat.id == selectedId,
                onClick = { onSelect(cat.id) },
                count = if (count != null && count > 0) count else null,
                trailingText = if (isSport && (count == null || count == 0)) "مباشر ⚽" else null,
                modifier = Modifier.restorableFocus(Routes.LIVE, "live_cat_${cat.id}"),
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun ChannelColumn(
    state: LiveUiState,
    channels: List<Channel>,
    favoriteIds: Set<String>,
    previewId: String?,
    onPreview: (Channel) -> Unit,
    onPlayAt: (Int) -> Unit,
    onToggleFavorite: (Channel) -> Unit,
    onManageChannel: ((Channel) -> Unit)? = null,
    onGuide: (Channel) -> Unit,
    onRetry: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val listState = rememberRestorableLazyListState(
        "live_channels_${state.selectedId ?: ALL_CAT_ID}_${state.query.trim()}"
    )

    Column(modifier) {
        Row(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = appDp(6), vertical = appDp(4)),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(8)),
            ) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .size(appDp(8))
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(Palette.LiveRed)
                )
                Text(
                    Ar.channelList,
                    fontSize = appSp(15),
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    color = Color.White,
                )
            }
            if (channels.isNotEmpty()) {
                Tag(Ar.itemsCount(channels.size), Palette.FocusCyan, fontSize = appSp(10))
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(appDp(4)))

        Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
            when {
                state.busy && channels.isEmpty() -> LoadingBox()
                state.error != null && channels.isEmpty() -> MessageBox(
                    state.error,
                    actionLabel = Ar.retry,
                    onAction = onRetry,
                )
                channels.isEmpty() -> MessageBox(
                    if (state.selectedId == FAV_CAT_ID) Ar.noFavorites else Ar.noChannels,
                )
                else -> LazyColumn(
                    state = listState,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().focusRestorer(),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = appDp(4)),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(8)),
                ) {
                    // LIVE-01: index-suffixed key survives duplicate stream ids in huge (10k+) provider lists;
                    // a single contentType lets Compose recycle row slots while flinging.
                    itemsIndexed(
                        channels,
                        key = { i, c -> "${c.id}_$i" },
                        contentType = { _, _ -> "live_channel_row" },
                    ) { index, channel ->
                        ChannelRow(
                            index = index + 1,
                            channel = channel,
                            isPreviewed = channel.id == previewId,
                            isFavorite = channel.id in favoriteIds,
                            isDefaultEntry = index == 0,
                            onActivate = { onPlayAt(index) },
                            onToggleFavorite = { onManageChannel?.invoke(channel) ?: onToggleFavorite(channel) },
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@kotlin.OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
internal fun ChannelRow(
    index: Int,
    channel: Channel,
    isPreviewed: Boolean,
    isFavorite: Boolean,
    isDefaultEntry: Boolean = false,
    onActivate: () -> Unit,
    onToggleFavorite: () -> Unit,
) {
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val dao = remember(container) { container.channelDb.channelDao() }
    val programs by produceState<Pair<EpgProgramEntity?, EpgProgramEntity?>>(
        initialValue = null to null,
        channel.id,
        channel.epgId,
    ) {
        if (channel.epgId.isBlank()) {
            value = null to null
            return@produceState
        }
        // LIVE-01: rows that only fly past during a fast scroll leave composition before this
        // delay ends, so they never hit Room (avoids hundreds of EPG queries/sec on 10k lists).
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(EPG_ROW_SETTLE_MS)
        while (true) {
            val t = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
            val cur = runCatching { dao.currentProgramFor(channel.id, t) }.getOrNull()
            val nxt = runCatching { dao.nextProgramFor(channel.id, t) }.getOrNull()
            value = cur to nxt
            kotlinx.coroutines.delay(60_000L)
        }
    }
    val program = programs.first
    val next = programs.second
    var focused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val active = focused || isPreviewed
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(appDp(16))
    val borderColor = when {
        focused -> Palette.FocusCyan
        isPreviewed -> Palette.FocusCyan.copy(alpha = 0.65f)
        else -> Palette.CardBorder
    }
    val bgColor = when {
        focused -> Palette.CardSurfaceElevated
        isPreviewed -> Palette.Royal.copy(alpha = 0.28f)
        else -> Palette.CardSurface.copy(alpha = 0.92f)
    }
    val borderWidth = if (focused) appDp(2) else appDp(1)

    val primaryLogoUrl = remember(channel.icon, channel.name) {
        ChannelLogoResolver.resolvePrimaryUrl(channel.icon, channel.name)
    }
    val internetFallbackLogoUrl = remember(channel.name) {
        ChannelLogoResolver.resolveInternetLogoUrl(channel.name)
    }
    val (badgeText, _) = remember(channel.name) {
        ChannelLogoResolver.resolveBrandStyle(channel.name)
    }
    val logoPlacement = LocalThemeCustomization.current.componentPlacement["channel_logo"] ?: "start"
    val channelLogo: @Composable () -> Unit = {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(appDp(44))
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(Color.White)
                .border(
                    width = if (focused) appDp(2) else appDp(1),
                    color = if (focused) Palette.FocusCyan else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                    shape = CircleShape,
                )
                .padding(appDp(4)),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            RemoteImage(
                url = primaryLogoUrl,
                fallbackUrl = internetFallbackLogoUrl,
                fallbackText = badgeText,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().clip(CircleShape),
                contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
            )
        }
    }

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .restorableFocus(
                screenKey = Routes.LIVE,
                itemKey = "live_ch_${channel.id}_$index",
                isDefaultEntry = isDefaultEntry,
            )
            .then(
                if (active) {
                    Modifier.shadow(
                        elevation = appDp(12),
                        shape = shape,
                        ambientColor = Palette.FocusCyan,
                        spotColor = Palette.FocusCyan,
                    )
                } else Modifier,
            )
            .clip(shape)
            .background(bgColor)
            .border(borderWidth, borderColor, shape)
            .onFocusChanged { focused = it.isFocused }
            .combinedClickable(
                onClick = onActivate,
                onLongClick = onToggleFavorite,
            )
            .padding(horizontal = appDp(10), vertical = appDp(8)),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(10)),
    ) {
        val showLogo = LocalThemeCustomization.current.isVisible("channel_logo")
        if (showLogo && logoPlacement == "start") channelLogo()

        Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(3))) {
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(6)),
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = index.toString().padStart(2, '0'),
                    fontSize = appSp(10),
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    color = if (active) Palette.FocusCyan else Palette.TextDim,
                )
                Text(
                    text = channel.name,
                    fontSize = appSp(14),
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    color = Color.White,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
                )
            }
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(6)),
            ) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(appDp(5)))
                        .background(Palette.LiveRed)
                        .padding(horizontal = appDp(5), vertical = appDp(1)),
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "مباشر",
                        fontSize = appSp(8),
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        color = Color.White,
                    )
                }
                Text(
                    text = if (program != null && program.title.isNotBlank()) program.title else "بث مباشر",
                    fontSize = appSp(11),
                    color = if (program != null) Palette.FocusCyan else Palette.TextDim,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
            }
            if (next != null && next.title.isNotBlank()) {
                Text(
                    text = "${Ar.nextProgramLabel} ${next.title}",
                    fontSize = appSp(10),
                    color = Palette.TextDim,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
            }
        }

        if (showLogo && logoPlacement != "start") channelLogo()

        if (isFavorite) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = Ic.Heart,
                contentDescription = null,
                tint = Palette.LiveRed,
                modifier = Modifier.size(appDp(15)),
            )
        }

        if (isPreviewed) {
            LiveBadge()
        }

        qualityOf(channel.name)?.let { q ->
            Tag(q, if (q == "4K") Palette.Gold else Palette.Glow, fontSize = appSp(10))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun LiveBadge() {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "livePulse")
    val dotAlpha by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.4f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(900, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse,
        ),
        label = "dotAlpha",
    )
    Row(
        Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(50))
            .background(Palette.Live.copy(alpha = 0.22f))
            .border(appDp(1), Palette.Live.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(50))
            .padding(horizontal = appDp(8), vertical = appDp(3)),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(4)),
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(appDp(6))
                .graphicsLayer { alpha = dotAlpha }
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(Palette.Live),
        )
        Text(Ar.liveBadge, fontSize = appSp(10), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Palette.Live)
    }
}


/** LIVE-01: settle time before a channel row queries EPG (skips rows passed during fast scroll). */
private const val EPG_ROW_SETTLE_MS = 180L

@OptIn(UnstableApi::class)
@Composable
internal fun PreviewPanel(
    channel: Channel?,
    isFavorite: Boolean,
    onPlay: () -> Unit,
    onToggleFavorite: () -> Unit,
    onGuide: (Channel) -> Unit,
    showEpg: Boolean = true,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val container = LocalContainer.current
    val repo = container.repo
    val context = LocalContext.current

    var previewExo by remember { mutableStateOf<ExoPlayer?>(null) }
    var isScreenActive by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }

    var isPlaying by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var buffering by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var videoReady by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var muted by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    var formatAttempt by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var retryNonce by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var previewError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var tracks by remember { mutableStateOf(Tracks.EMPTY) }

    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        onDispose {
            SahabPlayer.releasePlayer(previewExo)
            previewExo = null
        }
    }

    DisposableEffect(previewExo) {
        val exo = previewExo
        if (exo == null) {
            isPlaying = false
            buffering = false
            videoReady = false
            tracks = Tracks.EMPTY
            return@DisposableEffect onDispose { }
        }
        exo.volume = if (muted) 0f else 1f
        val listener = object : Player.Listener {
            override fun onIsPlayingChanged(playing: Boolean) {
                isPlaying = playing
            }

            override fun onPlaybackStateChanged(state: Int) {
                buffering = state == Player.STATE_BUFFERING
            }

            override fun onRenderedFirstFrame() {
                videoReady = true
                previewError = null
            }

            override fun onTracksChanged(newTracks: Tracks) {
                tracks = newTracks
            }

            override fun onPlayerError(error: PlaybackException) {
                if (formatAttempt + 1 < repo.liveExtensions().size) {
                    formatAttempt += 1
                } else {
                    buffering = false
                    videoReady = false
                    previewError = "تعذّر تشغيل معاينة البث المباشر (${error.errorCodeName})"
                }
            }
        }
        exo.addListener(listener)
        onDispose {
            exo.removeListener(listener)
        }
    }

    LifecycleEventEffect(Lifecycle.Event.ON_START) {
        isScreenActive = true
    }

    LifecycleEventEffect(Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP) {
        isScreenActive = false
        SahabPlayer.releasePlayer(previewExo)
        previewExo = null
    }

    LaunchedEffect(channel?.id) {
        formatAttempt = 0
        videoReady = false
        previewError = null
        tracks = Tracks.EMPTY
    }

    LaunchedEffect(channel?.id, formatAttempt, isScreenActive, retryNonce) {
        val ch = channel
        if (ch == null || !isScreenActive) {
            previewExo?.stop()
            previewExo?.clearMediaItems()
            if (ch == null) {
                SahabPlayer.releasePlayer(previewExo)
                previewExo = null
            }
            videoReady = false
            previewError = null
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        previewError = null
        val url = runCatching {
            repo.streamUrl(PlayItem(Kind.LIVE, ch.id, ch.name, icon = ch.icon, url = ch.url), formatAttempt)
        }.getOrNull()
        if (url.isNullOrBlank()) {
            buffering = false
            videoReady = false
            previewError = "تعذّر تجهيز رابط البث للمعاينة"
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }

        val exo = previewExo ?: SahabPlayer.create(
            context = context,
            client = container.client,
            isLive = true,
            isPreview = true,
            accountHash = container.accountHash,
        ).also { created ->
            previewExo = created
            SahabPlayer.bindOnRelease(created) {
                if (previewExo === created) {
                    previewExo = null
                }
            }
        }

        exo.volume = if (muted) 0f else 1f
        exo.setMediaItem(MediaItem.fromUri(url))
        exo.prepare()
        exo.playWhenReady = true
    }

    // LIVE-01: recover the preview from silent hardware-decoder stalls as well.
    com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.player.LiveVideoStallWatchdog(
        player = previewExo,
        enabled = isScreenActive && channel != null,
        itemKey = channel?.id,
        onEscalate = {
            if (formatAttempt + 1 < repo.liveExtensions().size) {
                formatAttempt += 1
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        },
    )

    val openFullScreen: () -> Unit = {
        // Fully release preview player before opening full-screen player (prevents dual MediaCodec/RAM usage)
        SahabPlayer.releasePlayer(previewExo)
        previewExo = null
        onPlay()
    }

    val programs by produceState<List<Program>>(emptyList(), channel?.id) {
        value = if (channel != null && channel.epgId.isNotBlank()) {
            try { repo.shortEpg(channel.id, 6) } catch (_: Exception) { emptyList() }
        } else emptyList()
    }
    val today = formatNowMillis(rememberNow(), "EEEE، d MMMM", Locale.forLanguageTag("ar"))

    Column(
        modifier = modifier,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(14)),
    ) {
        // Card 1: Live Video Preview & Control Toolbar
        GlassPanel(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(appDp(24)),
            padding = appDp(12),
        ) {
            var previewFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .aspectRatio(16f / 9f)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(appDp(16)))
                    .background(Color.Black)
                    .onFocusChanged { previewFocused = it.isFocused }
                    .border(
                        width = if (previewFocused) appDp(2.5f) else appDp(1),
                        color = if (previewFocused) Palette.FocusCyan else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(appDp(16)),
                    )
                    .clickable(enabled = channel != null, onClick = openFullScreen),
            ) {
                AndroidView(
                    factory = { ctx ->
                        PlayerView(ctx).apply {
                            useController = false
                            resizeMode = AspectRatioFrameLayout.RESIZE_MODE_ZOOM
                            setShowBuffering(PlayerView.SHOW_BUFFERING_NEVER)
                            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            )
                            player = previewExo
                        }
                    },
                    update = { view ->
                        if (view.player !== previewExo) {
                            view.player = previewExo
                        }
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                )

                if (!videoReady) {
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(PreviewPlaceholderBrush),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                    ) {
                        if (channel != null) {
                            val primaryPreviewLogo = remember(channel.icon, channel.name) {
                                ChannelLogoResolver.resolvePrimaryUrl(channel.icon, channel.name)
                            }
                            val fallbackPreviewLogo = remember(channel.name) {
                                ChannelLogoResolver.resolveInternetLogoUrl(channel.name)
                            }
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .size(appDp(64))
                                    .clip(CircleShape)
                                    .background(Color.White)
                                    .border(appDp(2), Palette.FocusCyan, CircleShape)
                                    .padding(appDp(6)),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                            ) {
                                RemoteImage(
                                    url = primaryPreviewLogo,
                                    fallbackUrl = fallbackPreviewLogo,
                                    fallbackText = channel.name,
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().clip(CircleShape),
                                    contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(PreviewShadeBrush),
                )

                if (channel == null) {
                    Column(
                        Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.Center)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(appDp(14)))
                            .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.65f))
                            .border(appDp(1), Palette.Glow.copy(alpha = 0.35f), RoundedCornerShape(appDp(14)))
                            .padding(horizontal = appDp(16), vertical = appDp(10)),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(6)),
                    ) {
                        Icon(Ic.Play, contentDescription = null, tint = Palette.Glow, modifier = Modifier.size(appDp(26)))
                        Text(
                            "اختر قناة واضغط موافق أو المسها للمعاينة",
                            fontSize = appSp(12),
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = Color.White,
                        )
                    }
                } else if (previewError != null) {
                    Column(
                        Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.Center)
                            .padding(horizontal = appDp(14))
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(appDp(14)))
                            .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.80f))
                            .border(appDp(1), Palette.Danger.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(appDp(14)))
                            .padding(horizontal = appDp(16), vertical = appDp(12)),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(8)),
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            previewError ?: "تعذّر تشغيل المعاينة",
                            fontSize = appSp(12),
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = Color.White,
                        )
                        GlassButton(
                            text = Ar.retry,
                            onClick = {
                                previewError = null
                                formatAttempt = 0
                                retryNonce += 1
                            },
                            primary = true,
                        )
                    }
                } else if (buffering && !videoReady) {
                    Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.Center)) {
                        CircularProgressIndicator(
                            color = Palette.Glow,
                            trackColor = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f),
                            modifier = Modifier.size(appDp(32)),
                            strokeWidth = appDp(3),
                        )
                    }
                }

                // Top-right badge: "مباشر - 1080p 60fps"
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .align(Alignment.TopStart)
                        .padding(appDp(10))
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(appDp(8)))
                        .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.70f))
                        .border(appDp(1), Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f), RoundedCornerShape(appDp(8)))
                        .padding(horizontal = appDp(10), vertical = appDp(5)),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(6)),
                ) {
                    Box(Modifier.size(appDp(7)).clip(CircleShape).background(Palette.Live))
                    val vBadge = SahabPlayer.videoBadge(tracks, channel?.let { qualityOf(it.name) })
                    Text("${Ar.liveBadge} - $vBadge", fontSize = appSp(11), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Color.White)
                }

                // Bottom-left badge: Audio stream info or channel name
                if (channel != null) {
                    val aBadge = SahabPlayer.audioBadge(tracks) ?: channel.name
                    Row(
                        Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.BottomEnd)
                            .padding(appDp(10))
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(appDp(8)))
                            .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.70f))
                            .border(appDp(1), Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f), RoundedCornerShape(appDp(8)))
                            .padding(horizontal = appDp(10), vertical = appDp(5)),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(6)),
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            aBadge,
                            fontSize = appSp(11),
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = Palette.Glow,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            if (channel != null) {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(appDp(10)))
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(12), Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    PlayerControlButton(
                        icon = if (isPlaying) Ic.Pause else Ic.Play,
                        description = if (isPlaying) Ar.pause else Ar.play,
                        onClick = {
                            previewExo?.let { exo ->
                                if (exo.isPlaying) exo.pause() else exo.play()
                            }
                        },
                    )
                    PlayerControlButton(
                        icon = if (muted) Ic.VolumeOff else Ic.VolumeUp,
                        description = if (muted) Ar.unmute else Ar.mute,
                        onClick = {
                            muted = !muted
                            previewExo?.volume = if (muted) 0f else 1f
                        },
                    )
                    PlayerControlButton(
                        icon = if (isFavorite) Ic.Heart else Ic.HeartOutline,
                        description = Ar.favorites,
                        onClick = onToggleFavorite,
                        isRed = true,
                    )
                    PlayerControlButton(icon = Ic.Search, description = Ar.guide, onClick = { onGuide(channel) })
                    PlayerControlButton(icon = Ic.Aspect, description = Ar.fullscreen, onClick = openFullScreen)
                }
            }
        }

        // Card 2: EPG Schedule (shown on Tablet/TV where vertical space allows both video and schedule)
        if (showEpg) {
            GlassPanel(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .weight(1f),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(appDp(24)),
                padding = appDp(16),
            ) {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    DotTitle(Ar.epgTitle, Palette.Gold, fontSize = appSp(14))
                    Text(today, fontSize = appSp(11), color = Palette.TextDim)
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(appDp(10)))

                if (channel == null) {
                    Text(Ar.pickChannel, fontSize = appSp(13), color = Palette.TextDim)
                } else {
                    val now = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
                    val past = programs.lastOrNull { it.end <= now }
                    val current = programs.firstOrNull { now in it.start until it.end }
                    val upcoming = programs.filter { it.start > (current?.start ?: now) }.take(2)

                    if (past == null && current == null && upcoming.isEmpty()) {
                        Text(Ar.noEpgShort, fontSize = appSp(13), color = Palette.TextDim)
                    } else {
                        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(8))) {
                            past?.let { prog ->
                                EpgScheduleRow(
                                    time = "${formatClock(prog.start)} - ${formatClock(prog.end)}",
                                    title = prog.title.ifBlank { Ar.noName },
                                    state = EpgRowState.ENDED,
                                    onClick = { onGuide(channel) },
                                )
                            }
                            current?.let { prog ->
                                EpgScheduleRow(
                                    time = "${formatClock(prog.start)} - ${formatClock(prog.end)}",
                                    title = prog.title.ifBlank { Ar.noName },
                                    state = EpgRowState.NOW,
                                    onClick = { onGuide(channel) },
                                )
                            }
                            upcoming.forEach { prog ->
                                EpgScheduleRow(
                                    time = "${formatClock(prog.start)} - ${formatClock(prog.end)}",
                                    title = prog.title.ifBlank { Ar.noName },
                                    state = EpgRowState.SOON,
                                    onClick = { onGuide(channel) },
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

internal enum class EpgRowState { ENDED, NOW, SOON }

@Composable
internal fun EpgScheduleRow(
    time: String,
    title: String,
    state: EpgRowState,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(appDp(12))
    val isNow = state == EpgRowState.NOW
    val bg: Brush = if (isNow) Palette.ActiveFill else Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Palette.Glass, Palette.Glass))
    val borderColor = if (isNow) Palette.Glow else Palette.GlassBorder

    Row(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(shape)
            .background(bg)
            .border(appDp(1), borderColor, shape)
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(horizontal = appDp(12), vertical = appDp(9)),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
        Row(
            Modifier.weight(1f),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(appDp(10)),
        ) {
            Text(
                time,
                fontSize = appSp(11),
                fontWeight = if (isNow) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                color = if (isNow) Palette.Gold else Palette.TextDim,
                maxLines = 1,
            )
            Text(
                title,
                fontSize = appSp(13),
                fontWeight = if (isNow) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                color = if (state == EpgRowState.ENDED) Palette.TextDim else Palette.Text,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.width(appDp(8)))
        when (state) {
            EpgRowState.ENDED -> Tag(Ar.ended, Palette.TextDim, fontSize = appSp(10))
            EpgRowState.NOW -> Tag(Ar.onAirNow, Palette.Live, filled = true, fontSize = appSp(10))
            EpgRowState.SOON -> Tag(Ar.soon, Palette.Glow, fontSize = appSp(10))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun PlayerControlButton(
    icon: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector,
    description: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    isRed: Boolean = false,
) {
    var focused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val bg = when {
        isRed -> Palette.Live.copy(alpha = if (focused) 0.55f else 0.30f)
        focused -> Palette.Royal.copy(alpha = 0.55f)
        else -> Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f)
    }
    val borderColor = when {
        focused -> Palette.Glow
        isRed -> Palette.Live.copy(alpha = 0.55f)
        else -> Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.14f)
    }
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .size(appDp(40))
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .background(bg)
            .border(if (focused) appDp(2) else appDp(1), borderColor, CircleShape)
            .onFocusChanged { focused = it.isFocused }
            .clickable(onClick = onClick),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Icon(
            icon,
            contentDescription = description,
            tint = if (isRed) Palette.Live else Color.White,
            modifier = Modifier.size(appDp(18)),
        )
    }
}
