internal fun hostOf(server: String): String = server.substringAfter("://").trimEnd('/')

@Composable
internal fun InfoRow(label: String, value: String) {
    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 6.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        Text(label, fontSize = 14.sp, color = Palette.TextDim, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
        Text(value, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Palette.Text)
    }
}



@Composable
internal fun SourcesPanel(container: AppContainer) {
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val activeAccount by container.prefs.account.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = null)
    val isSwitching by container.switchingAccount.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    var accounts by remember { mutableStateOf<List<Account>>(emptyList()) }
    var showAddDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    LaunchedEffect(activeAccount) {
        accounts = container.prefs.getAccounts()
    }

    GlassPanel(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), strong = true, padding = 20.dp) {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Box(Modifier.size(44.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(Palette.Royal.copy(alpha = 0.28f)).border(1.dp, Palette.Glow.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        Icon(Ic.Tv, null, tint = Palette.Glow, modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp))
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                    Column {
                        Text("المصادر والاشتراكات", fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Palette.Text)
                        Text("اختر المصدر النشط أو أضف مصدراً جديداً", fontSize = 13.sp, color = Palette.TextDim)
                    }
                }
                GlassButton(
                    text = "+ إضافة",
                    onClick = { showAddDialog = true },
                    primary = true,
                    icon = Ic.Cloud
                )
            }

            accounts.forEach { acc ->
                val isActive = acc.id == activeAccount?.id
                GlassPanel(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .then(
                            if (isActive) Modifier.border(1.5.dp, Palette.FocusCyan.copy(alpha = 0.7f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                            else Modifier,
                        ),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                    padding = 16.dp,
                ) {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text(acc.name, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Color.White)
                            Text(if (acc.type == "M3U") "رابط M3U مباشر" else acc.server, fontSize = 12.sp, color = Palette.TextDim)
                        }
                        
                        if (!isActive) {
                            if (isSwitching) {
                                CircularProgressIndicator(color = Palette.Glow, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
                            } else {
                                GlassButton(text = "تفعيل", onClick = {
                                    if (!isSwitching) {
                                        container.switchAccount(acc)
                                    }
                                })
                            }
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        } else {
                            Tag("نشط", Palette.Emerald)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        }
                        
                        GlassButton(text = "حذف", onClick = {
                            scope.launch {
                                container.prefs.deleteAccount(acc.id)
                                val newList = container.prefs.getAccounts()
                                accounts = newList
                                container.userSyncService.saveAccounts(newList)
                                if (acc.id == activeAccount?.id) {
                                    val next = newList.firstOrNull()
                                    if (next != null) {
                                        container.switchAccount(next)
                                    } else {
                                        container.clearAllLocalData(clearPrefsAccount = true)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (showAddDialog) {
        AddSourceDialog(
            container = container,
            onDismiss = { showAddDialog = false },
            onAdded = { newAcc ->
                scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    accounts = container.prefs.getAccounts()
                    container.userSyncService.saveAccounts(accounts)
                    container.switchAccount(newAcc)
                }
                showAddDialog = false
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun AddSourceDialog(container: AppContainer, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onAdded: (Account) -> Unit) {
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var selectedTab by remember { mutableStateOf("XTREAM") }
    var name by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var server by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var user by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var pass by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var m3uUrl by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var loading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var errorMsg by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismiss) {
        GlassPanel(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), strong = true, padding = 22.dp) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                    .imePadding(),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
            ) {
                Text("إضافة مصدر جديد", fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Palette.Text)
                
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    GlassCard(onClick = { selectedTab = "XTREAM" }, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), selected = selectedTab == "XTREAM") {
                        Text("سيرفر Xtream", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(12.dp), textAlign = TextAlign.Center, color = if (selectedTab == "XTREAM") Color.White else Palette.TextDim)
                    }
                    GlassCard(onClick = { selectedTab = "M3U" }, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), selected = selectedTab == "M3U") {
                        Text("رابط M3U", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(12.dp), textAlign = TextAlign.Center, color = if (selectedTab == "M3U") Color.White else Palette.TextDim)
                    }
                }

                GlassTextField(value = name, onValueChange = { name = it }, placeholder = "اسم المصدر (مثال: اشتراكي)", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                
                if (selectedTab == "XTREAM") {
                    GlassTextField(value = server, onValueChange = { server = it }, placeholder = "عنوان السيرفر (http://...)", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    GlassTextField(value = user, onValueChange = { user = it }, placeholder = "اسم المستخدم", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    GlassTextField(value = [REDACTED]
                } else {
                    GlassTextField(value = m3uUrl, onValueChange = { m3uUrl = it }, placeholder = "رابط M3U المباشر (http://...)", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                }
                val activeUrl = (if (selectedTab == "XTREAM") server else m3uUrl).trim()
                if (activeUrl.isNotEmpty() && !activeUrl.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)) {
                    HttpSecurityWarningBanner()
                }
                errorMsg?.let { msg ->
                    Text(msg, fontSize = 12.sp, color = Palette.Gold)
                }

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    GlassButton(
                        text = if (loading) "جاري الفحص..." else "حفظ",
                        onClick = {
                            if (loading) return@GlassButton
                            val normalizedServer = if (selectedTab == "XTREAM") {
                                com.saydlawy.sahab.util.ServerUrl.normalizeServer(server)
                            } else null
                            val validUrl = if (selectedTab == "XTREAM") {
                                normalizedServer != null && user.isNotBlank() && pass.isNotBlank()
                            } else {
                                m3uUrl.trim().startsWith("http://", ignoreCase = true) ||
                                    m3uUrl.trim().startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)
                            }
                            if (!validUrl) {
                                errorMsg = "تأكد من إدخال رابط صحيح مع كامل البيانات."
                                return@GlassButton
                            }
                            errorMsg = null
                            loading = true
                            scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                                try {
                                    val acc = if (selectedTab == "XTREAM") {
                                        Account(name = name.ifBlank { "Xtream Server" }, type = "XTREAM", server = normalizedServer!!, user = user.trim(), pass = pass)
                                    } else {
                                        Account(name = name.ifBlank { "M3U List" }, type = "M3U", m3uUrl = m3uUrl.trim())
                                    }
                                    container.repo.login(acc)
                                    container.prefs.saveAccount(acc)
                                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                        loading = false
                                        onAdded(acc)
                                    }
                                } catch (e: Exception) {
                                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                        loading = false
                                        errorMsg = e.message?.take(120) ?: "تعذر الاتصال بالمصدر، تأكد من الرابط والبيانات."
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        },
                        primary = true,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                    )
                    GlassButton(text = "إلغاء", onClick = onDismiss, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun ActiveSourceDetailsPanel(
    container: AppContainer,
    account: Account?,
    info: UserInfo?,
    onSyncNow: () -> Unit,
) {
    if (account == null) return
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var liveInfo by remember(account.id, info) { mutableStateOf(info) }
    var refreshingInfo by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    GlassPanel(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), strong = true, padding = 20.dp) {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Box(
                    Modifier.size(44.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(Palette.Royal.copy(alpha = 0.28f)).border(1.dp, Palette.Glow.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                ) {
                    Icon(Ic.Person, null, tint = Palette.Glow, modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp))
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                Column {
                    Text("تفاصيل المصدر النشط", fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Palette.Text)
                    Text(if (account.type == "M3U") "رابط M3U" else account.server, fontSize = 13.sp, color = Palette.Glow)
                }
            }
            if (account.type == "XTREAM" && liveInfo != null) {
                Tag(liveInfo?.status.orEmpty().ifBlank { "Active" }, Palette.Emerald)
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
        
        if (account.type == "XTREAM") {
            InfoRow("الخادم", hostOf(account.server))
            InfoRow("اسم المستخدم", account.user)
            liveInfo?.let { currentInfo ->
                InfoRow("الحالة", if (currentInfo.status.isBlank()) "Active" else currentInfo.status)
                val expiry = currentInfo.expiry
                InfoRow("ينتهي الاشتراك", if (expiry == null || expiry <= 0L) Ar.subscriptionOpenShort else formatDate(expiry))
                if (currentInfo.maxConnections.isNotBlank()) {
                    val maxText = if (currentInfo.maxConnections == "0") "غير محدود" else currentInfo.maxConnections
                    InfoRow("الأجهزة المتصلة", "${currentInfo.activeConnections.ifBlank { "0" }} / $maxText")
                }
            }
        } else {
            InfoRow("الرابط", account.m3uUrl.take(40) + "...")
        }
        
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
            if (account.type == "XTREAM") {
                GlassButton(
                    text = if (refreshingInfo) "جاري تحديث الاشتراك..." else "تحديث بيانات الاشتراك",
                    onClick = {
                        if (refreshingInfo) return@GlassButton
                        refreshingInfo = true
                        scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            val result = runCatching { container.repo.refreshUserInfo() }
                            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                refreshingInfo = false
                                result.onSuccess { updated ->
                                    liveInfo = updated
                                    Toast.makeText(context, "تم تحديث بيانات الاشتراك", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                }.onFailure { err ->
                                    Toast.makeText(context, err.message ?: "تعذر تحديث بيانات الاشتراك", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    icon = Ic.Person,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            GlassButton(
                text = "تحديث ومزامنة القنوات الآن",
                onClick = onSyncNow,
                icon = Ic.Refresh,
                primary = true,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            )
        }
    }
}

    OledAccentPresets.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: OledAccentPresets.first()

fun applyOledCinemaTokens(base: [REDACTED]

private fun colorMapForTheme(themeId: String, oledAccentPreset: String = "oled_cyan"): Map<String, Color> {
    val cosmic = mutableMapOf(
        "DeepBlue" to Color(0xFF0B0F24), "TextMuted" to Color(0xFF94A3B8),
        "CinematicBg" to Color(0xFF0B0D17), "CinematicBgSecondary" to Color(0xFF101322),
        "CardSurface" to Color(0xFF161A29), "CardSurfaceElevated" to Color(0xFF1E2336),
        "CardBorderIdle" to Color(0x26FFFFFF), "FocusCyan" to Color(0xFF38BDF8),
        "FocusBlueGlow" to Color(0xFF0EA5E9), "LiveBadgeRed" to Color(0xFFE53935),
        "NewBadgeBlue" to Color(0xFF2563EB), "CategorySeriesStart" to Color(0xFF5B21B6),
        "CategorySeriesEnd" to Color(0xFF2E1065), "CategoryMoviesStart" to Color(0xFF991B1B),
        "CategoryMoviesEnd" to Color(0xFF450A0A), "CategoryLiveStart" to Color(0xFF0E7490),
        "CategoryLiveEnd" to Color(0xFF083344), "Royal" to Color(0xFF8E45FF),
        "Glow" to Color(0xFF7DC4FF), "Gold" to Color(0xFFE0A23B),
        "Blue" to Color(0xFF2563EB), "Emerald" to Color(0xFF34D399),
        "Glass" to Color(0x8C12122D), "GlassStrong" to Color(0xA612122D),
        "GlassBorder" to Color(0x14FFFFFF), "InputBg" to Color(0xB30F0B1E),
        "BgTop" to Color(0xFF111433), "Text" to Color.White, "TextDim" to Color(0xFFA9AEC7),
        "DialogBg" to Color(0xF212122D), "Danger" to Color(0xFFFF6B6B),
        "ProgressStart" to Color(0xFF60A5FA),
        "OsdSurfaceLowest" to Color(0xFF0F0B1E), "OsdSurfaceLow" to Color(0xFF1D192C),
        "OsdSurfaceContainer" to Color(0xFF211D31), "OsdSurfaceHigh" to Color(0xFF2B273C),
        "OsdSurfaceHighest" to Color(0xFF363247), "OsdPrimary" to Color(0xFFDCB8FF),
        "OsdPrimaryContainer" to Color(0xFF8A2BE2), "OsdOnPrimary" to Color(0xFF480081),
        "OsdCyan" to Color(0xFF00FBFB), "OsdTertiary" to Color(0xFFC4C1FB),
        "OsdOnSurface" to Color(0xFFE7DEFA), "OsdOnSurfaceVariant" to Color(0xFFCFC2D7),
        "OsdOutline" to Color(0xFF988CA0), "OsdOutlineVariant" to Color(0xFF4C4354),
    )
    when (themeId) {
        "cosmic_glass_pro" -> {

            cosmic["GlassStrong"] = Color(0xCC12122D)

}

fun themeBaseColor(themeId: String, token: String, oledAccentPreset: String = [REDACTED]
    colorMapForTheme(themeId, oledAccentPreset)[token] ?: [REDACTED]

private fun parseThemeColor(value: String): Color? {
    val hex = value.trim().removePrefix("#")
    val parsed = hex.toLongOrNull(16) ?: return null
    return when (hex.length) {
        6 -> Color((0xFF000000L or parsed).toInt())
        8 -> Color(parsed.toInt())
        else -> null
    }
}

private fun resolvedColors(settings: ThemePreferences): Map<String, Color> {
    val id = settings.selectedThemeId
    val base = colorMapForTheme(id, settings.oledAccentPreset).toMutableMap()
    settings.customization(id).colorOverrides.forEach { (key, value) ->
        parseThemeColor(value)?.let { color -> if (key in base) base[key] = color }
    }
    settings.customization(id).let { customization ->
        val alpha = customization.glassOpacity.coerceIn(0.15f, 1f)
        listOf("Glass", "GlassStrong").forEach { key ->
            base[key]?.let { color -> base[key] = color.copy(alpha = color.alpha * alpha) }
        }
    }
    return base
}

/** Dynamic palette backed by persisted theme state; every screen observes the same tokens. */
object Palette {
    private var colors by mutableStateOf(colorMapForTheme("cosmic_glass"))
    internal fun install(resolved: Map<String, Color>) { colors = resolved }
    internal fun install(settings: ThemePreferences) { colors = resolvedColors(settings) }
    fun color(token: String): Color = [REDACTED]
    private fun token(name: String) = [REDACTED]

    val DeepBlue get() = [REDACTED]
    val TextMuted get() = [REDACTED]
    val CinematicBg get() = [REDACTED]

/**
 * Google Font "Cairo" (static TrueType instances bundled in res/font, so it works offline,
 * on Android TV boxes without Google Play Services, and on API 23+).
 */
val CairoFamily = FontFamily(
    Font(R.font.cairo_regular, FontWeight.Normal),
    Font(R.font.cairo_medium, FontWeight.Medium),
    Font(R.font.cairo_semibold, FontWeight.SemiBold),
    Font(R.font.cairo_bold, FontWeight.Bold),
    Font(R.font.cairo_extrabold, FontWeight.ExtraBold),
)

@Composable
fun SahabTheme(
    settings: ThemePreferences = ThemePreferences(),
    content: @Composable () -> Unit,
) {
    val customization = remember(settings) { settings.customization() }
    val colors = remember(settings) {
        val resolved = resolvedColors(settings)
        Palette.install(resolved)
        resolved
    }
    val sourceDensity = LocalDensity.current
    val tvFontBoost = if (com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.LocalIsTv.current) 1.06f else 1f
    val scaledDensity = remember(sourceDensity, customization.fontScale, tvFontBoost) {
        Density(density = sourceDensity.density, fontScale = (sourceDensity.fontScale * customization.fontScale * tvFontBoost).coerceIn(0.7f, 1.65f))
    }
    val selectedFont = remember(customization.fontFamily) {
        when (customization.fontFamily) {
            "sans" -> FontFamily.SansSerif
            "serif" -> FontFamily.Serif
            "mono" -> FontFamily.Monospace
            else -> CairoFamily
        }
    }
    val scheme = darkColorScheme(
        primary = colors["Royal"] ?: Color(0xFF8E45FF),
        secondary = colors["Glow"] ?: Color(0xFF7DC4FF),
        background = colors["DeepBlue"] ?: Color(0xFF0B0F24),
        surface = colors["CardSurface"] ?: Color(0xFF161A29),
        onSurface = colors["Text"] ?: Color.White,
        onBackground = colors["Text"] ?: Color.White,
    )
    val base = Typography()
    val typography = base.copy(
        displayLarge = base.displayLarge.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        displayMedium = base.displayMedium.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        displaySmall = base.displaySmall.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        headlineLarge = base.headlineLarge.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        headlineMedium = base.headlineMedium.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        headlineSmall = base.headlineSmall.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        titleLarge = base.titleLarge.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        titleMedium = base.titleMedium.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        titleSmall = base.titleSmall.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        bodyLarge = base.bodyLarge.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        bodyMedium = base.bodyMedium.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        bodySmall = base.bodySmall.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        labelLarge = base.labelLarge.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        labelMedium = base.labelMedium.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
        labelSmall = base.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = selectedFont),
    )
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalSahabColors provides colors,
        LocalThemePreferences provides settings,
        LocalThemeCustomization provides customization,
        LocalDensity provides scaledDensity,
    ) {
        MaterialTheme(colorScheme = scheme, typography = typography) {
            CompositionLocalProvider(
                LocalLayoutDirection provides LayoutDirection.Rtl,
                LocalTextStyle provides TextStyle(
                    fontFamily = selectedFont,
                    color = colors["Text"] ?: Color.White,
                    fontSize = 16.sp,
                ),
                LocalContentColor provides (colors["Text"] ?: Color.White),
            ) {
                content()
            }
        }
    }
}

val LocalSahabColors = compositionLocalOf { colorMapForTheme("cosmic_glass") }
val LocalThemePreferences = compositionLocalOf { ThemePreferences() }
val LocalThemeCustomization = compositionLocalOf { ThemeCustomization() }

fun ThemeCustomization.isVisible(componentId: String): Boolean = when (componentId) {
    "global_navigation", "details_actions", "player_controls" -> true
    else -> componentVisibility[componentId] ?: true
}
fun ThemeCustomization.placement(componentId: String, fallback: String = "end"): String = componentPlacement[componentId] ?: fallback

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/util/ChannelLogoResolver.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.util

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Resolves high-availability internet channel logos for Arabic & International IPTV channels
 * whenever the Xtream server provides an empty, broken, or unreachable `stream_icon`.
 */
object ChannelLogoResolver {

    private const val TV_LOGOS_BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tv-logo/tv-logos/main/countries"
    private const val WIKI_COMMONS = "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons"

    data class ChannelBrandInfo(
        val logoUrl: String,
        val accentColor: Color,
        val badgeLabel: String,
    )

    /**
     * Returns the best primary URL to try first (either the server icon if valid HTTP/HTTPS,
     * or the resolved internet logo URL if the server icon is blank).
     */
    fun resolvePrimaryUrl(rawIcon: String, channelName: String): String {
        val trimmed = rawIcon.trim()
        if (trimmed.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true) ||
            trimmed.startsWith("http://", ignoreCase = true)
        ) {
            return trimmed
        }
        return resolveInternetLogoUrl(channelName).orEmpty()
    }

    /**
     * Returns a reliable internet fallback logo URL based on the channel's Arabic or English name.
     * Used both when `channel.icon` is blank and when `channel.icon` fails to load from the IPTV server.
     */
    fun resolveInternetLogoUrl(channelName: String): String? {
        val n = normalizeChannelName(channelName)
        if (n.isBlank()) return null

        return when {
            // --- beIN SPORTS ---
            n.contains("bein") && (n.contains("news") || n.contains("اخبار") || n.contains("إخبار")) ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-news-me.png"
            n.contains("bein") && n.contains("max") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/france/bein-sports-max-4-fr.png"
            n.contains("bein") && n.contains("premium 1") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-1-premium-me.png"
            n.contains("bein") && n.contains("premium 2") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-2-premium-me.png"
            n.contains("bein") && n.contains("premium 3") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-3-premium-me.png"
            (n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت")) && n.contains("2") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-2-me.png"
            (n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت")) && n.contains("3") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-3-me.png"
            (n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت")) && n.contains("4") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-4-me.png"
            (n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت")) && n.contains("5") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-5-me.png"
            (n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت")) && n.contains("6") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-6-me.png"
            (n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت")) && n.contains("7") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-7-me.png"
            n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") || n.contains("بين سبورت") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/middle-east/bein-sports-1-me.png"

            // --- SSC & ARAB SPORTS ---
            n.contains("ssc") || n.contains("اس اس سي") ->
                "$WIKI_COMMONS/thumb/c/c8/SSC_Sports_logo.svg/512px-SSC_Sports_logo.svg.png"
            n.contains("alkass") || n.contains("al kass") || n.contains("الكاس") || n.contains("الكأس") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/qatar/alkass-one-qa.png"
            n.contains("ad sport") || n.contains("abu dhabi sport") || n.contains("ابوظبي الرياض") || n.contains("أبوظبي الرياض") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/united-arab-emirates/abu-dhabi-sports-1-ae.png"
            n.contains("dubai sport") || n.contains("دبي الرياض") ->
                "$TV_LOGOS_BASE/united-arab-emirates/dubai-sports-1-ae.png"
            n.contains("ontime") || n.contains("on time") || n.contains("اون تايم") || n.contains("أون تايم") ->
                "$WIKI_COMMONS/thumb/9/9e/OnTime_Sports_logo.png/512px-OnTime_Sports_logo.png"

    /**
     * Returns a clean, human-readable short brand badge (and category color) for any channel
     * so even if offline or while the image loads, the badge looks like the reference design.
     */
    fun resolveBrandStyle(channelName: String): Pair<String, Color> {
        val n = normalizeChannelName(channelName)
        return when {
            n.contains("bein") || n.contains("بي ان") -> "beIN" to Color(0xFF5B21B6)
            n.contains("ssc") || n.contains("اس اس سي") -> "SSC" to Color(0xFF047857)
            n.contains("alkass") || n.contains("الكاس") || n.contains("الكأس") -> "الكأس" to Color(0xFF991B1B)
            n.contains("sport") || n.contains("رياض") -> "رياضية" to Color(0xFF6D28D9)
            n.contains("mbc") || n.contains("ام بي سي") -> "MBC" to Color(0xFF1D4ED8)
            n.contains("rotana") || n.contains("روتانا") -> "روتانا" to Color(0xFF059669)
            n.contains("jazeera") || n.contains("الجزيرة") -> "الجزيرة" to Color(0xFFD97706)
            n.contains("arabiya") || n.contains("العربية") || n.contains("الحدث") -> "العربية" to Color(0xFF7C3AED)
            n.contains("action") || n.contains("اكشن") || n.contains("أكشن") -> "أكشن" to Color(0xFFDC2626)
            n.contains("drama") || n.contains("دراما") -> "دراما" to Color(0xFF2563EB)
            n.contains("cinema") || n.contains("سينما") || n.contains("movie") || n.contains("افلام") || n.contains("أفلام") -> "سينما" to Color(0xFFB91C1C)
            n.contains("kids") || n.contains("اطفال") || n.contains("أطفال") || n.contains("spacetoon") || n.contains("سبيستون") -> "أطفال" to Color(0xFF0284C7)
            n.contains("news") || n.contains("اخبار") || n.contains("إخبار") -> "إخبارية" to Color(0xFF0F766E)
            else -> {
                val clean = channelName
                    .replace(Regex("""\[.*?]|\(.*?\)"""), "")
                    .replace(Regex("""\b(HD|FHD|4K|UHD|SD|AR|VIP|HEVC|RAW)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "")
                    .replace(Regex("""^[A-Z]{2,3}\s*[:|\-]\s*""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "")
                    .trim()
                clean.take(8).ifBlank { "مباشر" } to Color(0xFF1E3A8A)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun normalizeChannelName(raw: String): String {
        return raw.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .replace('أ', 'ا')
            .replace('إ', 'ا')
            .replace('آ', 'ا')
            .replace('ة', 'ه')
            .replace('ى', 'ي')
            .replace(Regex("""[^\p{L}\p{N}]+"""), " ")
            .trim()
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.util

import android.app.Activity
import android.app.UiModeManager
import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.content.res.Configuration
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.ApiException
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

fun isTelevision(context: Context): Boolean {
    if (context.packageManager.hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_LEANBACK)) return true
    val ui = context.getSystemService(Context.UI_MODE_SERVICE) as? UiModeManager
    return ui?.currentModeType == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION
}

tailrec fun Context.findActivity(): Activity? = when (this) {
    is Activity -> this
    is ContextWrapper -> baseContext.findActivity()
    else -> null
}

fun Throwable.userMessage(): String = (this as? ApiException)?.message ?: Ar.errUnknown

fun appVersion(context: Context): String = try {
    context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(context.packageName, 0).versionName.orEmpty()
} catch (e: Exception) {
    ""
}

/** Lower-cases and removes Arabic diacritics and letter variants so searching is forgiving. */
fun String.normalizeForSearch(): String {
    val out = StringBuilder(length)
    for (c in lowercase(Locale.ROOT)) {
        when {
            c == 'أ' || c == 'إ' || c == 'آ' -> out.append('ا')
            c == 'ى' -> out.append('ي')
            c == 'ة' -> out.append('ه')
            c == 'ـ' || c in 'ً'..'ْ' -> Unit
            else -> out.append(c)
        }
    }
    return out.toString()
}

private val dateFormatCache: ThreadLocal<MutableMap<String, java.text.SimpleDateFormat>> =
    ThreadLocal.withInitial { HashMap() }

private fun cachedDateFormat(
    pattern: String,
    locale: Locale = Locale.US,
    timeZone: java.util.TimeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getDefault(),
): java.text.SimpleDateFormat {
    val key = "$pattern|${locale.toLanguageTag()}|${timeZone.id}"
    val map = dateFormatCache.get()!!
    return map.getOrPut(key) {
        java.text.SimpleDateFormat(pattern, locale).apply { this.timeZone = timeZone }
    }
}

fun formatClock(epochSeconds: Long): String =
    cachedDateFormat("HH:mm", Locale.US).format(Date(epochSeconds * 1000))

fun formatDate(epochSeconds: Long): String =
    cachedDateFormat("yyyy/MM/dd", Locale.US).format(Date(epochSeconds * 1000))

fun formatNowMillis(epochMillis: Long, pattern: String = "HH:mm", locale: Locale = Locale.US): String =
    cachedDateFormat(pattern, locale).format(Date(epochMillis))

fun formatDayOffsetYmd(offsetDays: Int): String {
    val calendar = java.util.Calendar.getInstance()
    calendar.add(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, offsetDays)
    return cachedDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US).format(calendar.time)
}

fun utcDateToLocalYmd(utcDate: String, utcTime: String): String {
    val cleanDate = utcDate.trim().take(10)
    if (cleanDate.length < 10) return utcDate
    val hm = utcTime.trim().take(5)
    if (hm.length < 5 || hm == "null") return cleanDate
    return try {
        val utc = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
        val parsed = cachedDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.US, utc).parse("$cleanDate $hm")
        if (parsed != null) {
            cachedDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US, java.util.TimeZone.getDefault()).format(parsed)
        } else {
            cleanDate
        }
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        cleanDate
    }
}

fun formatUtcClockToLocal(rawTime: String, dateStr: String = ""): String {
    val clean = rawTime.trim()
    if (clean.isBlank() || clean == "null") {
        return ""
    }
    val hm = clean.take(5)
    return try {
        val utc = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
        val effectiveDate = dateStr.trim().take(10).ifBlank {
            cachedDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US, utc).format(Date())
        }
        val parsed = cachedDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.US, utc).parse("$effectiveDate $hm")
        if (parsed != null) {
            cachedDateFormat("HH:mm", Locale.US, java.util.TimeZone.getDefault()).format(parsed)
        } else {
            hm.lowercase(Locale.US)
        }
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        hm.lowercase(Locale.US)
    }
}

fun formatDuration(ms: Long): String {
    val total = (ms / 1000).coerceAtLeast(0)
    val h = total / 3600
    val m = (total % 3600) / 60
    val s = total % 60
    return if (h > 0) String.format(Locale.US, "%d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
    else String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", m, s)
}

=== FILE: app/src/main/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/util/ServerUrl.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.util

internal object ServerUrl {
    private val HOST_PORT_REGEX = Regex("^(https?://[^/?#]+)", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)

    /** Keeps only scheme, host and port: "host:8080/anything" becomes "http://host:8080". */
    fun normalizeServer(raw: String): String? {
        var text = raw.trim().replace(" ", "")
        if (text.isEmpty()) return null
        if (!text.startsWith("http://", ignoreCase = true) && !text.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)) {
            text = "http://$text"
        }
        val match = HOST_PORT_REGEX.find(text) ?: return null
        return match.groupValues[1].trimEnd('/')
    }
}

        val user = "alice"
        val pass = [REDACTED]
        val account = Account(

    @Test

        assertTrue(GithubReleaseUpdater.isTrustedReleaseUrl("https://github.com/saydlawy/-Sahab/releases/download/latest/app.apk"))
        assertTrue(GithubReleaseUpdater.isTrustedReleaseUrl("https://objects.githubusercontent.com/github-production-release-asset/app.apk"))
        assertFalse(GithubReleaseUpdater.isTrustedReleaseUrl("http://github.com/saydlawy/-Sahab/releases/download/latest/app.apk"))
        assertFalse(GithubReleaseUpdater.isTrustedReleaseUrl("https://evil.example.com/app.apk"))

        val server = MockWebServer()
        server.start()
        try {
            val expectedHash = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
            server.enqueue(
                MockResponse()
                    .setResponseCode(200)
                    .setBody(
                        """
                        {
                          "name": "Build 999999",
                          "html_url": "https://github.com/saydlawy/-Sahab/releases/tag/latest",
                          "body": "Release notes",
                          "assets": [
                            {
                              "name": "sahab-release.apk",
                              "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/saydlawy/-Sahab/releases/download/latest/sahab-release.apk",
                              "digest": "sha256:$expectedHash"
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                        """.trimIndent(),
                    ),
            )
            val update = GithubReleaseUpdater.checkForUpdate(
                client = OkHttpClient(),

            assertEquals(999999, update?.versionCode)
            assertEquals(expectedHash, update?.sha256)
            assertEquals("https://github.com/saydlawy/-Sahab/releases/download/latest/sahab-release.apk", update?.apkUrl)

            // Rejects release payload if both apk asset & html_url point to untrusted domain
            server.enqueue(
                MockResponse()
                    .setResponseCode(200)
                    .setBody(
                        """
                        {
                          "name": "Build 999999",

            )

                client = OkHttpClient(),
                endpointUrl = server.url("/release").toString(),
                currentVersionCode = 1,
            )
            assertNull(rejected)
        } finally {

        }

            server.shutdown()

package com.saydlawy.sahab

import android.content.SharedPreferences

    @Test
    fun weatherService_parsesOpenMeteoAndGeocodingViaKotlinxSerialization() = runTest {

    @Test
    fun adaptiveWindowInfo_classifiesTvTabletLandscapeAndPortraitCleanly() {
        val tv = computeAdaptiveWindowInfo(maxWidth = 960.dp, maxHeight = 540.dp, isTv = true)
        assertEquals(DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV, tv.mode)

        val tablet = computeAdaptiveWindowInfo(maxWidth = 800.dp, maxHeight = 1280.dp, isTv = false)
        assertEquals(DisplayMode.TABLET_OR_TV, tablet.mode)

        val phoneLandscape = computeAdaptiveWindowInfo(maxWidth = 800.dp, maxHeight = 360.dp, isTv = false)
        assertEquals(DisplayMode.PHONE_LANDSCAPE, phoneLandscape.mode)

        assertEquals(DisplayMode.PHONE_PORTRAIT, phonePortrait.mode)
    }

    private class SimpleInMemoryPrefs : SharedPreferences {
        private val map = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>()
        override fun getAll(): MutableMap<String, *> = map.toMutableMap()
        override fun getString(key: String?, defValue: String?): String? = (map[key] as? String) ?: defValue
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        override fun getStringSet(key: String?, defValues: MutableSet<String>?): MutableSet<String>? =
            (map[key] as? MutableSet<String>) ?: defValues
        override fun getInt(key: String?, defValue: Int): Int = (map[key] as? Int) ?: defValue
        override fun getLong(key: String?, defValue: Long): Long = (map[key] as? Long) ?: defValue
        override fun getFloat(key: String?, defValue: Float): Float = (map[key] as? Float) ?: defValue
        override fun getBoolean(key: String?, defValue: Boolean): Boolean = (map[key] as? Boolean) ?: defValue
        override fun contains(key: String?): Boolean = map.containsKey(key)
        override fun edit(): SharedPreferences.Editor = object : SharedPreferences.Editor {
            private val pending = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>()
            private var clearAll = false
            override fun putString(k: String?, v: String?) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = v }
            override fun putStringSet(k: String?, v: MutableSet<String>?) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = v }
            override fun putInt(k: String?, v: Int) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = v }
            override fun putLong(k: String?, v: Long) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = v }
            override fun putFloat(k: String?, v: Float) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = v }
            override fun putBoolean(k: String?, v: Boolean) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = v }
            override fun remove(k: String?) = apply { if (k != null) pending[k] = null }
            override fun clear() = apply { clearAll = true }
            override fun commit(): Boolean { apply(); return true }
            override fun apply() {
                if (clearAll) map.clear()
                pending.forEach { (k, v) -> if (v == null) map.remove(k) else map[k] = v }
                pending.clear()
                clearAll = false
            }
        }
        override fun registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(l: SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener?) {}
        override fun unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(l: SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener?) {}
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/test/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/DatabaseMigrationRegressionTest.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import android.content.ContentResolver
import android.content.ContentValues
import android.database.CharArrayBuffer
import android.database.ContentObserver
import android.database.Cursor
import android.database.DataSetObserver
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import android.util.Pair
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteQuery
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteStatement
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog.CatalogDatabase
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.channel.ChannelDatabase
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.Locale

class DatabaseMigrationRegressionTest {

    /**
     * Lightweight SQLite schema + data simulator implementing [SupportSQLiteDatabase] so Room
     * migrations (`ChannelDatabase.MIGRATION_1_2` and `CatalogDatabase.MIGRATION_1_2..3_4`) can
     * be executed and verified in pure JVM unit tests without requiring an emulator.
     */
    private class RecordingSqliteDatabase : SupportSQLiteDatabase {
        val tables = linkedMapOf<String, MutableSet<String>>()
        val indices = linkedMapOf<String, Boolean>() // indexName -> unique
        val tableRows = linkedMapOf<String, MutableList<Map<String, Any?>>>()
        val executedSql = mutableListOf<String>()

        fun defineTable(name: String, columns: List<String>, rows: List<Map<String, Any?>> = emptyList()) {
            tables[name] = columns.toMutableSet()
            tableRows[name] = rows.map { it.toMap() }.toMutableList()
        }

        override fun execSQL(sql: String) {
            val normalized = sql.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
            executedSql += normalized

            val addColRegex = Regex(
                "ALTER TABLE `?(\\w+)`? ADD COLUMN `?(\\w+)`?.*",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )
            val renameTableRegex = Regex(
                "ALTER TABLE `?(\\w+)`? RENAME TO `?(\\w+)`?",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )
            val createTableRegex = Regex(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?(\\w+)`? \\((.+)\\)",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )
            val dropTableRegex = Regex(
                "DROP TABLE (?:IF EXISTS )?`?(\\w+)`?",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )
            val dropIndexRegex = Regex(
                "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS `?(\\w+)`?",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )
            val createIndexRegex = Regex(
                "CREATE (UNIQUE )?INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `?(\\w+)`? ON `?(\\w+)`? \\((.+)\\)",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )
            val migrateLegacyListsRegex = Regex(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO `channel_lists` .* FROM `channel_lists_legacy`",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
            )

            addColRegex.matchEntire(normalized)?.let { m ->
                val table = m.groupValues[1]
                val col = m.groupValues[2]
                tables.getOrPut(table) { linkedSetOf() }.add(col)
                return
            }

            renameTableRegex.matchEntire(normalized)?.let { m ->
                val oldName = m.groupValues[1]
                val newName = m.groupValues[2]
                tables.remove(oldName)?.let { tables[newName] = it }
                tableRows.remove(oldName)?.let { tableRows[newName] = it }
                return
            }

            createTableRegex.matchEntire(normalized)?.let { m ->
                val table = m.groupValues[1]
                val body = m.groupValues[2]
                if (!tables.containsKey(table)) {
                    val cols = body.split(",")
                        .map { it.trim() }
                        .filterNot { it.uppercase(Locale.US).startsWith("PRIMARY KEY") }
                        .mapNotNull { def ->
                            Regex("^`?(\\w+)`?\\s+").find(def)?.groupValues?.get(1)
                        }
                        .toMutableSet()
                    tables[table] = cols
                    tableRows.putIfAbsent(table, mutableListOf())
                }
                return
            }

            if (migrateLegacyListsRegex.containsMatchIn(normalized)) {
                val legacyRows = tableRows["channel_lists_legacy"].orEmpty()
                val targetRows = tableRows.getOrPut("channel_lists") { mutableListOf() }
                for (row in legacyRows) {
                    targetRows += mapOf(
                        "listId" to row["id"],
                        "name" to row["name"],
                        "icon" to "",
                        "sortOrder" to row["sortOrder"],
                        "sortMode" to "custom",
                        "createdAt" to row["updatedAt"],
                        "updatedAt" to row["updatedAt"],
                    )
                }
                return
            }

            dropTableRegex.matchEntire(normalized)?.let { m ->
                val table = m.groupValues[1]
                tables.remove(table)
                tableRows.remove(table)
                return
            }

            dropIndexRegex.matchEntire(normalized)?.let { m ->
                indices.remove(m.groupValues[1])
                return
            }

            createIndexRegex.matchEntire(normalized)?.let { m ->
                val isUnique = m.groupValues[1].isNotBlank()
                val idxName = m.groupValues[2]
                indices[idxName] = isUnique
                return
            }
        }

        override fun query(query: String): Cursor = query(query, emptyArray())

        override fun query(query: String, bindArgs: Array<out Any?>): Cursor {
            val trimmed = query.trim()
            val pragmaMatch = Regex("PRAGMA table_info\\(`?(\\w+)`?\\)", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).find(trimmed)
            if (pragmaMatch != null) {
                val table = pragmaMatch.groupValues[1]
                val cols = tables[table].orEmpty()
                return SingleColumnCursor("name", cols.toList())
            }
            if (trimmed.contains("sqlite_master", ignoreCase = true)) {
                val tableName = bindArgs.firstOrNull()?.toString()
                val values = if (tableName != null && tables.containsKey(tableName)) {
                    listOf(tableName)
                } else {
                    emptyList()
                }
                return SingleColumnCursor("name", values)
            }
            return SingleColumnCursor("name", emptyList())
        }

        // Unused SupportSQLiteDatabase members for migration unit tests
        override fun compileStatement(sql: String): SupportSQLiteStatement = throw UnsupportedOperationException()
        override fun beginTransaction() = Unit
        override fun beginTransactionNonExclusive() = Unit
        override fun beginTransactionWithListener(transactionListener: android.database.sqlite.SQLiteTransactionListener) = Unit
        override fun beginTransactionWithListenerNonExclusive(transactionListener: android.database.sqlite.SQLiteTransactionListener) = Unit
        override fun endTransaction() = Unit
        override fun setTransactionSuccessful() = Unit
        override fun inTransaction(): Boolean = false
        override val isDbLockedByCurrentThread: Boolean = false
        override fun yieldIfContendedSafely(): Boolean = false
        override fun yieldIfContendedSafely(sleepAfterYieldDelayMillis: Long): Boolean = false
        override var version: Int = 1
        override val maximumSize: Long = 0L
        override fun setMaximumSize(numBytes: Long): Long = 0L
        override var pageSize: Long = 4096L
        override fun query(query: SupportSQLiteQuery): Cursor = throw UnsupportedOperationException()
        override fun query(query: SupportSQLiteQuery, cancellationSignal: CancellationSignal?): Cursor = throw UnsupportedOperationException()
        override fun insert(table: String, conflictAlgorithm: Int, values: ContentValues): Long = 0L
        override fun delete(table: String, whereClause: String?, whereArgs: Array<out Any?>?): Int = 0
        override fun update(table: String, conflictAlgorithm: Int, values: ContentValues, whereClause: String?, whereArgs: Array<out Any?>?): Int = 0
        override fun execSQL(sql: String, bindArgs: Array<out Any?>) = execSQL(sql)
        override val isReadOnly: Boolean = false
        override val isOpen: Boolean = true
        override fun needUpgrade(newVersion: Int): Boolean = true
        override val path: String = ":memory:"
        override fun setLocale(locale: Locale) = Unit
        override fun setMaxSqlCacheSize(cacheSize: Int) = Unit
        override fun setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(enabled: Boolean) = Unit
        override fun enableWriteAheadLogging(): Boolean = true
        override fun disableWriteAheadLogging() = Unit
        override val isWriteAheadLoggingEnabled: Boolean = true
        override val attachedDbs: List<Pair<String, String>>? = emptyList()
        override val isDatabaseIntegrityOk: Boolean = true
        override fun close() = Unit
    }

    private class SingleColumnCursor(
        private val columnName: String,
        private val values: List<String>,
    ) : Cursor {
        private var pos = -1
        private var closed = false

        override fun getCount(): Int = values.size

        override fun getPosition(): Int = pos

        override fun move(offset: Int): Boolean = moveToPosition(pos + offset)

        override fun moveToPosition(position: Int): Boolean {
            if (position >= values.size) {
                pos = values.size
                return false
            }
            if (position < 0) {
                pos = -1
                return false
            }
            pos = position
            return true
        }

        override fun moveToFirst(): Boolean = moveToPosition(0)

        override fun moveToLast(): Boolean = moveToPosition(values.size - 1)

        override fun moveToNext(): Boolean = moveToPosition(pos + 1)

        override fun moveToPrevious(): Boolean = moveToPosition(pos - 1)

        override fun isFirst(): Boolean = pos == 0 && values.isNotEmpty()

        override fun isLast(): Boolean = pos == values.lastIndex && values.isNotEmpty()

        override fun isBeforeFirst(): Boolean = values.isEmpty() || pos < 0

        override fun isAfterLast(): Boolean = values.isEmpty() || pos >= values.size

        override fun getColumnIndex(columnName: String?): Int =
            if (columnName == this.columnName) 0 else -1

        override fun getColumnIndexOrThrow(columnName: String?): Int {
            val index = getColumnIndex(columnName)
            if (index < 0) throw IllegalArgumentException("Column '$columnName' does not exist.")
            return index
        }

        override fun getColumnName(columnIndex: Int): String {
            if (columnIndex != 0) throw IndexOutOfBoundsException("Invalid column index: $columnIndex")
            return columnName
        }

        override fun getColumnNames(): Array<String> = arrayOf(columnName)

        override fun getColumnCount(): Int = 1

        override fun getBlob(columnIndex: Int): ByteArray = throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getString(columnIndex: Int): String {
            if (columnIndex != 0) throw IndexOutOfBoundsException("Invalid column index: $columnIndex")
            return values[pos]
        }

        override fun copyStringToBuffer(columnIndex: Int, buffer: CharArrayBuffer?) =
            throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getShort(columnIndex: Int): Short = throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getInt(columnIndex: Int): Int = throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getLong(columnIndex: Int): Long = throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getFloat(columnIndex: Int): Float = throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getDouble(columnIndex: Int): Double = throw UnsupportedOperationException()

        override fun getType(columnIndex: Int): Int = Cursor.FIELD_TYPE_STRING

        override fun isNull(columnIndex: Int): Boolean = false

        override fun deactivate() = Unit

        @Deprecated("Deprecated in Java")
        override fun requery(): Boolean = false

        override fun close() {
            closed = true
        }

        override fun isClosed(): Boolean = closed

        override fun registerContentObserver(observer: ContentObserver?) = Unit

        override fun unregisterContentObserver(observer: ContentObserver?) = Unit

        override fun registerDataSetObserver(observer: DataSetObserver?) = Unit

        override fun unregisterDataSetObserver(observer: DataSetObserver?) = Unit

        override fun setNotificationUri(cr: ContentResolver?, uri: Uri?) = Unit

        override fun getNotificationUri(): Uri? = null

        override fun getWantsAllOnMoveCalls(): Boolean = false

        override fun setExtras(extras: Bundle?) = Unit

        override fun getExtras(): Bundle = Bundle()

        override fun respond(extras: Bundle?): Bundle = Bundle()
    }

    @Test
    fun channelDatabase_migration1To2_addsFirebaseColumnAndCanonicalListTablesWithoutDataLoss() {
        val db = RecordingSqliteDatabase()
        db.defineTable(
            name = "channels",
            columns = listOf(
                "streamId", "name", "displayName", "logoUrl", "categoryId", "categoryName",
                "channelNumber", "epgId", "qualityTag", "groupId", "streamUrlTemplate",
                "sortOrder", "isFavorite", "isHidden", "lastWatchedAt", "updatedAt",
            ),
            rows = listOf(mapOf("streamId" to "1001", "name" to "Al Jazeera")),
        )

        ChannelDatabase.MIGRATION_1_2.migrate(db)

        // Verify channels table gained lastFirebaseCheckAt and its index while preserving existing rows
        assertTrue(db.tables["channels"]!!.contains("lastFirebaseCheckAt"))
        assertTrue(db.indices.containsKey("index_channels_lastFirebaseCheckAt"))
        assertEquals(1, db.tableRows["channels"]!!.size)
        assertEquals("1001", db.tableRows["channels"]!![0]["streamId"])

        // Verify channel_lists matches ChannelListEntity schema
        val listCols = db.tables["channel_lists"]!!
        assertEquals(

        db.defineTable(
            name = "catalog_movies",
            columns = listOf(
                "sahabId", "novaStreamId", "categoryId", "titleAr", "titleEn", "year",

        )
        db.indices["index_catalog_movies_novaStreamId"] = true

        CatalogDatabase.MIGRATION_1_2.migrate(db)
        val colsAfterV2 = db.tables["catalog_movies"]!!

        assertTrue(db.indices.containsKey("index_catalog_movies_lastSeen"))
        assertTrue(db.indices.containsKey("index_catalog_movies_deleted"))

        // Existing catalog row preserved intact across v1 -> v2 -> v3 -> v4
        assertEquals(1, db.tableRows["catalog_movies"]!!.size)
        assertEquals("tmdb:550", db.tableRows["catalog_movies"]!![0]["sahabId"])

=== FILE: app/src/test/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/DiskCacheTest.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.serializer
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder

class DiskCacheTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tempFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    @Test
    fun putAndGet_roundTripsValueWithinTtl() = runTest {
        val cache = DiskCache(tempFolder.root, maxCatalogBytes = 1024L * 1024L)
        val ok = cache.put("k1", String.serializer(), "hello_sahab")
        assertEquals(true, ok)
        val loaded = cache.get("k1", String.serializer(), ttlMs = 60_000L)
        assertEquals("hello_sahab", loaded)
    }

    @Test
    fun put_evictsOldestFilesWhenCatalogExceedsCap() = runTest {
        val payload = "A".repeat(180)
        // Small cap (~300 bytes) holds at most 1 payload (~182 bytes encoded) so older entries are evicted.
        val cache = DiskCache(tempFolder.root, maxCatalogBytes = 300L)

        cache.put("oldest", String.serializer(), payload)
        Thread.sleep(30)
        cache.put("middle", String.serializer(), payload)
        Thread.sleep(30)
        cache.put("newest", String.serializer(), payload)

        assertNull(cache.get("oldest", String.serializer(), ttlMs = 60_000L))
        assertNotNull(cache.get("newest", String.serializer(), ttlMs = 60_000L))
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/test/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/M3uParserTest.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class M3uParserTest {

    private val parser = M3uParser(OkHttpClient())

    @Test
    fun parseLines_acceptsHttpAndHttpsOnlyAndIgnoresMalformedEntries() {
        val sample = listOf(
            "#EXTM3U",
            "",
            "   ",
            "#EXTINF:-1 tvg-logo=\"https://logo.png\" group-title=\"News\" tvg-id=\"ch1\",Channel One",
            "https://stream.example.com/live/ch1.m3u8",
            "#EXTINF:-1,Bad Protocol",
            "rtsp://stream.example.com/bad",
            "#EXTINF:-1,No Protocol At All",
            "stream.example.com/missing-scheme.ts",
            "#EXTINF:-1,Orphaned ExtInf Without Url",
            "#EXTINF:-1 group-title=\"Sports\",Http Stream",
            "HTTP://cdn.example.com/live/2.ts",
        )

        val result = parser.parseLines(sample.asSequence())
        assertEquals(2, result.size)
        assertEquals("Channel One", result[0].name)
        assertEquals("https://stream.example.com/live/ch1.m3u8", result[0].url)
        assertEquals("News", result[0].categoryId)
        assertEquals("Http Stream", result[1].name)
        assertEquals("HTTP://cdn.example.com/live/2.ts", result[1].url)
    }

    @Test
    fun parseLines_returnsEmpty_whenOnlyCommentsOrBlankLines() {
        val result = parser.parseLines(sequenceOf("#EXTM3U", "", "#EXTINF:-1,Empty Only"))
        assertTrue(result.isEmpty())
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/test/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/PrefsTest.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data

import android.content.SharedPreferences
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.PreferenceDataStoreFactory
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.stringPreferencesKey
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collect
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.advanceUntilIdle
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

class PrefsTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tempFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    @Test
    fun saveAndClearAccount_removesAccountFavsAndRecents() = runTest {
        val fakeSecure = InMemorySharedPreferences()
        val ds = PreferenceDataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = backgroundScope,
            produceFile = { File(tempFolder.root, "prefs_clear.preferences_pb") },
        )
        val prefs = Prefs(context = null, secureStoreOverride = fakeSecure, dataStoreOverride = ds)

        val account = Account(server = "https://portal.example.com", user = "user1", pass = "pass1")
        prefs.saveAccount(account)
        prefs.toggleFavorite(FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "42", "فيلم تجريبي"))
        prefs.recordPlayback(RecentItem(Kind.MOVIE, "42", "فيلم تجريبي", positionMs = 15_000L, durationMs = 120_000L))

        assertEquals(account, prefs.account.first())
        assertEquals(1, prefs.favorites.first().size)
        assertEquals(1, prefs.recents.first().size)

        prefs.clearAccount()

        assertNull(prefs.account.first())
        assertTrue(prefs.favorites.first().isEmpty())
        assertTrue(prefs.recents.first().isEmpty())
        assertFalse(fakeSecure.contains("enc_accounts_list"))
        assertFalse(fakeSecure.contains("enc_active_id"))
    }

    @Test
    fun legacyPlainDataStoreAccount_migratesToEncryptedAndDeletesPlainKeys() = runTest {
        val fakeSecure = InMemorySharedPreferences()
        val ds = PreferenceDataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = backgroundScope,
            produceFile = { File(tempFolder.root, "prefs_migrate.preferences_pb") },
        )
        val srvKey = stringPreferencesKey("server")
        val usrKey = stringPreferencesKey("user")
        val pwdKey = stringPreferencesKey("pass")
        ds.edit {
            it[srvKey] = "https://legacy.example.com"
            it[usrKey] = "legacy_user"
            it[pwdKey] = "legacy_pass"
        }

        val prefs = Prefs(context = null, secureStoreOverride = fakeSecure, dataStoreOverride = ds)
        val loaded = prefs.account.first()

        // نتحقق من الحقول الفردية بدلاً من الكائن بالكامل لتجنب اختلاف الـ id العشوائي
        assertEquals("https://legacy.example.com", loaded?.server)
        assertEquals("legacy_user", loaded?.user)
        assertEquals("legacy_pass", loaded?.pass)
        assertEquals("حسابي القديم", loaded?.name)
        assertEquals("XTREAM", loaded?.type)
        assertTrue(fakeSecure.contains("enc_accounts_list"))
        assertTrue(fakeSecure.contains("enc_active_id"))
        val after = ds.data.first()
        assertFalse(after.contains(srvKey))
        assertFalse(after.contains(usrKey))
        assertFalse(after.contains(pwdKey))
    }

    @Test
    fun favoritesFlow_deduplicatesIdenticalUnrelatedDataStoreWrites() = runTest {
        val fakeSecure = InMemorySharedPreferences()
        val ds = PreferenceDataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = backgroundScope,
            produceFile = { File(tempFolder.root, "prefs_distinct.preferences_pb") },
        )
        val prefs = Prefs(context = null, secureStoreOverride = fakeSecure, dataStoreOverride = ds)
        val emissions = mutableListOf<List<FavItem>>()
        val job = launch {
            prefs.favorites.collect { emissions.add(it) }
        }
        advanceUntilIdle()
        prefs.setShowRecents(false)
        prefs.setShowRecents(true)
        advanceUntilIdle()
        // Unrelated preference writes must not re-emit identical favorite lists.
        assertEquals(1, emissions.size)
        job.cancel()
    }

    private class InMemorySharedPreferences : SharedPreferences {
        private val map = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>()

        override fun getAll(): MutableMap<String, *> = map.toMutableMap()
        override fun getString(key: String?, defValue: String?): String? = (map[key] as? String) ?: defValue
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        override fun getStringSet(key: String?, defValues: MutableSet<String>?): MutableSet<String>? =
            (map[key] as? MutableSet<String>) ?: defValues
        override fun getInt(key: String?, defValue: Int): Int = (map[key] as? Int) ?: defValue
        override fun getLong(key: String?, defValue: Long): Long = (map[key] as? Long) ?: defValue
        override fun getFloat(key: String?, defValue: Float): Float = (map[key] as? Float) ?: defValue
        override fun getBoolean(key: String?, defValue: Boolean): Boolean = (map[key] as? Boolean) ?: defValue
        override fun contains(key: String?): Boolean = map.containsKey(key)
        override fun edit(): SharedPreferences.Editor = EditorImpl()
        override fun registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(listener: SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener?) {}
        override fun unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(listener: SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener?) {}

        private inner class EditorImpl : SharedPreferences.Editor {
            private val pending = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>()
            private var clearAll = false

            override fun putString(key: String?, value: String?): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = value
            }
            override fun putStringSet(key: String?, values: MutableSet<String>?): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = values
            }
            override fun putInt(key: String?, value: Int): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = value
            }
            override fun putLong(key: String?, value: Long): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = value
            }
            override fun putFloat(key: String?, value: Float): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = value
            }
            override fun putBoolean(key: String?, value: Boolean): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = value
            }
            override fun remove(key: String?): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply {
                if (key != null) pending[key] = null
            }
            override fun clear(): SharedPreferences.Editor = apply { clearAll = true }
            override fun commit(): Boolean {
                apply()
                return true
            }
            override fun apply() {
                if (clearAll) map.clear()
                for ((k, v) in pending) {
                    if (v == null) map.remove(k) else map[k] = v
                }
                pending.clear()
                clearAll = false
            }
        }
    }
}

            assertEquals(0L, prefs.lastCatalogSyncTime.first())

import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException

import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class RepositoryTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tempFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    private lateinit var server: MockWebServer
    private lateinit var repo: Repository

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        server = MockWebServer()
        server.start()
        val client = OkHttpClient.Builder().build()
        repo = Repository(
            api = XtreamApi(client),
            tmdb = TmdbApi(client, ""),
            disk = null,
        )
        val base = server.url("/").toString().trimEnd('/')
        repo.setAccount(Account(server = base, user = "alice user", pass = "p@ss/1"))
    }

        server.shutdown()
    }

    fun streamUrl_buildsEncodedLiveMovieAndEpisodeUrls() {
        val base = server.url("/").toString().trimEnd('/')
        val live = repo.streamUrl(PlayItem(Kind.LIVE, "101", "Live"))
        val movie = repo.streamUrl(PlayItem(Kind.MOVIE, "202", "Movie", ext = "mkv"))
        val ep = repo.streamUrl(PlayItem(Kind.EPISODE, "303", "Ep"))

        assertEquals("$base/live/alice%20user/p%40ss%2F1/101.m3u8", live)
        assertEquals("$base/movie/alice%20user/p%40ss%2F1/202.mkv", movie)
        assertEquals("$base/series/alice%20user/p%40ss%2F1/303.mp4", ep)
    }

    @Test
    fun liveCategories_concurrentCallsDeduplicateIntoSingleNetworkRequest() = runTest {
        server.enqueue(
            MockResponse()
                .setBodyDelay(150, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                .setResponseCode(200)
                .setBody("""[{"category_id":"1","category_name":"رياضة"},{"category_id":"2","category_name":"أفلام"}]"""),
        )

        val (first, second) = awaitAll(
            async { repo.liveCategories() },
            async { repo.liveCategories() },
        )

        assertEquals(2, first.size)
        assertEquals(first, second)
        assertEquals(1, server.requestCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun shortEpg_cachesInMemoryForPeekShortEpg() = runTest {
        server.enqueue(
            MockResponse().setResponseCode(200).setBody(
                """{"epg_listings":[{"title":"أخبار","description":"","start_timestamp":"1700000000","stop_timestamp":"1700003600"}]}""",
            ),
        )
        assertEquals(null, repo.peekShortEpg("55", 2))
        val loaded = repo.shortEpg("55", 2)
        assertEquals(1, loaded.size)
        assertEquals(loaded, repo.peekShortEpg("55", 2))
    }

        assertEquals("الرسالة", details.name)
        assertEquals("قصة تاريخية", details.plot)
        assertEquals("1976", details.year)
        assertEquals("177m", details.duration)
        assertEquals("8.5", details.rating)
    }

    @Test
    fun cachedPersistent_leaderCancellationDoesNotAbortIndependentAwaiter() = runTest {
        server.enqueue(
            MockResponse()
                .setBodyDelay(150, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                .setResponseCode(200)
                .setBody("""[{"category_id":"1","category_name":"أولى"}]"""),
        )
        server.enqueue(
            MockResponse()
                .setResponseCode(200)
                .setBody("""[{"category_id":"2","category_name":"ثانية"}]"""),
        )

        val leader = async { repo.liveCategories(forceNetwork = false) }
        delay(20)
        val follower = async { repo.liveCategories() }
        leader.cancel(CancellationException("caller navigated away"))

        val result = follower.await()
        assertTrue(result.isNotEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun m3uAccountsWithDifferentUrls_doNotShareDiskCache() = runTest {
        val disk = DiskCache(tempFolder.root)
        val diskRepo = Repository(
            api = XtreamApi(OkHttpClient()),
            tmdb = TmdbApi(OkHttpClient(), ""),
            disk = disk,
        )
        val base = server.url("/").toString().trimEnd('/')
        server.enqueue(
            MockResponse().setResponseCode(200).setBody(
                """
                #EXTM3U
                #EXTINF:-1 group-title="A",Channel One
                http://stream.one/1.m3u8
                """.trimIndent(),
            ),
        )
        server.enqueue(
            MockResponse().setResponseCode(200).setBody(
                """
                #EXTM3U
                #EXTINF:-1 group-title="B",Channel Two
                http://stream.two/2.m3u8
                """.trimIndent(),
            ),
        )

        diskRepo.setAccount(Account(id = "m3u-1", type = "M3U", m3uUrl = "$base/list1.m3u"))
        val first = diskRepo.liveChannels(null)
        assertEquals(listOf("Channel One"), first.map { it.name })

        diskRepo.setAccount(Account(id = "m3u-2", type = "M3U", m3uUrl = "$base/list2.m3u"))
        val second = diskRepo.liveChannels(null)
        assertEquals(listOf("Channel Two"), second.map { it.name })
    }

import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.FavItem
import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.Kind

class CloudMergeCoordinatorTest {

    @Test
    fun localOnly_cloudNotFound_keepsLocalAndMarksMergeDone() = runTest {
        val coordinator = CloudMergeCoordinator()
        val localFavs = listOf(FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "10", "فيلم محلي"))
        var saved: List<FavItem>? = null

        val ok = coordinator.mergeFavorites(
            localFavs = { localFavs },
            fetchCloudFavs = { CloudFetchResult.NotFound },
            saveMergedFavs = { saved = it },
        )

        assertTrue(ok)
        assertTrue(coordinator.favoritesMergeDone)
        assertEquals(null, saved)
    }

    @Test
    fun cloudOnly_localEmpty_restoresCloudAndMarksMergeDone() = runTest {
        val coordinator = CloudMergeCoordinator()
        val cloudFavs = listOf(FavItem(Kind.LIVE, "5", "قناة سحابية"))
        var saved: List<FavItem>? = null

        val ok = coordinator.mergeFavorites(
            localFavs = { emptyList() },
            fetchCloudFavs = { CloudFetchResult.Success(cloudFavs) },
            saveMergedFavs = { saved = it },
        )

        assertTrue(ok)
        assertTrue(coordinator.favoritesMergeDone)
        assertEquals(cloudFavs, saved)
    }

    @Test
    fun bothLocalAndCloud_mergesWithoutDuplicatesAndKeepsNewestRecents() = runTest {
        val coordinator = CloudMergeCoordinator()
        val localFavs = listOf(FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "1", "فيلم 1"), FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "2", "فيلم 2"))
        val cloudFavs = listOf(FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "2", "فيلم 2"), FavItem(Kind.SERIES, "9", "مسلسل 9"))
        var savedFavs: List<FavItem> = emptyList()

        val favOk = coordinator.mergeFavorites(
            localFavs = { localFavs },
            fetchCloudFavs = { CloudFetchResult.Success(cloudFavs) },
            saveMergedFavs = { savedFavs = it },
        )

        assertTrue(favOk)
        assertTrue(coordinator.favoritesMergeDone)
        assertEquals(3, savedFavs.size)

        val localRecents = listOf(RecentItem(Kind.MOVIE, "1", "فيلم 1", positionMs = 1_000L, updatedAt = 100L))
        val cloudRecents = listOf(RecentItem(Kind.MOVIE, "1", "فيلم 1", positionMs = 5_000L, updatedAt = 200L))
        var savedRecents: List<RecentItem> = emptyList()

        val recOk = coordinator.mergeRecents(
            localRecents = { localRecents },
            fetchCloudRecents = { CloudFetchResult.Success(cloudRecents) },
            saveMergedRecents = { savedRecents = it },
        )

        assertTrue(recOk)
        assertTrue(coordinator.recentsMergeDone)
        assertEquals(1, savedRecents.size)
        assertEquals(5_000L, savedRecents.first().positionMs)
    }

    @Test
    fun fetchFailureOrTimeout_neverMarksMergeDone_retriesAndBlocksUpload() = runTest {
        val coordinator = CloudMergeCoordinator()
        var uploadCalled = false

        val okTimeout = coordinator.mergeFavorites(
            localFavs = { emptyList() },
            fetchCloudFavs = {
                delay(500L)
                CloudFetchResult.Success(listOf(FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "1", "لا يجب أن يصل")))
            },
            saveMergedFavs = { },
            timeoutMs = 50L,
        )

        assertFalse(okTimeout)
        assertFalse(coordinator.favoritesMergeDone)
        if (coordinator.favoritesMergeDone) uploadCalled = true
        assertFalse(uploadCalled)

        var attempts = 0
        coordinator.mergeAllWithRetry(
            isSignedIn = { true },
            localFavs = { emptyList() },
            fetchCloudFavs = {
                attempts++
                if (attempts < 3) CloudFetchResult.Error() else CloudFetchResult.Success(listOf(FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "7", "مستعاد")))
            },
            saveMergedFavs = { },
            localRecents = { emptyList() },
            fetchCloudRecents = { CloudFetchResult.Error() },
            saveMergedRecents = { },
            fetchCloudPrefs = { CloudFetchResult.NotFound },
            applyPrefs = { },
            timeoutMs = 1_000L,
            retryDelaysMs = listOf(10L, 10L, 10L),
        )

        assertEquals(3, attempts)
        assertTrue(coordinator.favoritesMergeDone)
        assertFalse(coordinator.recentsMergeDone) // Failed all retries -> stays false -> upload blocked!
        assertTrue(coordinator.prefsMergeDone)
    }

    @Test
    fun mergeRecents_ordersByUpdatedAtDescBeforeDistinctAndCapsAt30() = runTest {
        val coordinator = CloudMergeCoordinator()
        val local = listOf(
            RecentItem(Kind.MOVIE, "dup", "محلي أقدم", positionMs = 1_000L, updatedAt = 100L),
            RecentItem(Kind.MOVIE, "onlyLocal", "محلي فقط", positionMs = 2_000L, updatedAt = 500L),
        ) + (1..20).map { i ->
            RecentItem(Kind.LIVE, "l_$i", "قناة $i", positionMs = 0L, updatedAt = 1_000L + i)
        }
        val cloud = listOf(
            RecentItem(Kind.MOVIE, "dup", "سحابي أحدث", positionMs = 9_000L, updatedAt = 9_999L),
        ) + (21..40).map { i ->
            RecentItem(Kind.SERIES, "s_$i", "مسلسل $i", positionMs = 3_000L, updatedAt = 2_000L + i)
        }

        var saved: List<RecentItem> = emptyList()
        val ok = coordinator.mergeRecents(
            localRecents = { local },
            fetchCloudRecents = { CloudFetchResult.Success(cloud) },
            saveMergedRecents = { saved = it },
        )

        assertTrue(ok)
        assertEquals(30, saved.size)
        assertEquals("dup", saved.first().id)
        assertEquals(9_000L, saved.first().positionMs)
        assertTrue(saved.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.updatedAt >= b.updatedAt })
        assertEquals(1, saved.count { it.kind == Kind.MOVIE && it.id == "dup" })
    }

    @Test
    fun accountIsolation_keepsSameItemSeparateAcrossAccounts() = runTest {
        val coordinator = CloudMergeCoordinator()
        val acc1Fav = FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "100", "فيلم في حساب 1", accountId = "acc_1")
        val acc2Fav = FavItem(Kind.MOVIE, "100", "فيلم في حساب 2", accountId = "acc_2")

        var saved: List<FavItem> = emptyList()
        val ok = coordinator.mergeFavorites(
            localFavs = { listOf(acc1Fav) },
            fetchCloudFavs = { CloudFetchResult.Success(listOf(acc2Fav)) },
            saveMergedFavs = { saved = it },
        )

        assertTrue(ok)
        assertEquals(2, saved.size)
        assertTrue(saved.isFav("acc_1", Kind.MOVIE, "100"))
        assertTrue(saved.isFav("acc_2", Kind.MOVIE, "100"))
        assertEquals(1, saved.forAccount("acc_1").size)
        assertEquals(1, saved.forAccount("acc_2").size)
    }
}
