package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.auth

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class UserSyncEncryptionTest {

    @Test
    fun encryptV2_andDecrypt_succeedsWithCorrectPin_andRejectsWrongPin() {
        val secretPayload = [REDACTED]
        val pin = "4829"
        val uid = "user_uid_123"

        val cipher1 = [REDACTED]
        val cipher2 = [REDACTED]

        assertTrue(cipher1.startsWith("enc_v2:"))
        // Random 16-byte salt & 12-byte IV guarantee distinct ciphertexts for identical plaintexts
        assertNotEquals(cipher1, cipher2)

        val okResult = CloudAccountCrypto.decrypt(cipher1, uid, pin)
        assertTrue(okResult is CloudDecryptResult.Ok)
        assertEquals(secretPayload, (okResult as CloudDecryptResult.Ok).plain)

        val wrongPinResult = CloudAccountCrypto.decrypt(cipher1, uid, "0000")
        assertTrue(wrongPinResult is CloudDecryptResult.WrongPin)

        val noPinResult = CloudAccountCrypto.decrypt(cipher1, uid, null)
        assertTrue(noPinResult is CloudDecryptResult.PinRequired)
    }

    @Test
    fun decryptLegacyV1_worksForMigrationToV2() {
        val uid = "legacy_uid_999"
        val oldSecret = [REDACTED]
        val v1Encrypted = [REDACTED]

        val dec = CloudAccountCrypto.decrypt(v1Encrypted, uid, null)
        assertTrue(dec is CloudDecryptResult.Ok)
        assertEquals(oldSecret, (dec as CloudDecryptResult.Ok).plain)

        val migratedV2 = [REDACTED]
        assertTrue(migratedV2.startsWith("enc_v2:"))
        val v2Dec = CloudAccountCrypto.decrypt(migratedV2, uid, "9988")
        assertEquals(CloudDecryptResult.Ok(oldSecret), v2Dec)
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/test/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/data/catalog/TmdbMatcherTest.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.data.catalog

import com.saydlawy.sahab.data.TmdbSearchResult
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Unit tests for TmdbMatcher — ported from v5 Python results.
 * These verify pure functions only (no network, no Room).
 */
class TmdbMatcherTest {

    // ─────────────────── normalizeArabic ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `normalizeArabic unifies alef variants`() {
        assertEquals("اسد", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("أسد"))
        assertEquals("اسد", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("إسد"))
        assertEquals("اسد", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("آسد"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `normalizeArabic unifies ta-marbuta`() {
        assertEquals("اسره", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("أسرة"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `normalizeArabic strips diacritics`() {
        assertEquals("اسد", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("أَسَد"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `normalizeArabic converts roman numerals`() {
        assertEquals("2", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("II"))
        assertEquals("3", TmdbMatcher.normalizeArabic("III"))
    }

    // ─────────────────── cleanIptv ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `cleanIptv strips quality tags`() {
        assertEquals("Lions For Lambs", TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("[SD] Lions For Lambs"))
        assertEquals("Inception", TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("Inception 1080p BluRay x264"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `cleanIptv strips arabic junk`() {
        assertEquals("الفيل الازرق", TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("فيلم الفيل الازرق مترجم"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `cleanIptv strips prefix tags`() {
        assertEquals("The Transporter", TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("AR | The Transporter"))
    }

    // ─────────────────── extractYear ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `extractYear prefers trailing year`() {
        assertEquals(2007, TmdbMatcher.extractYear("Lions For Lambs 2007", ""))
        assertEquals(2019, TmdbMatcher.extractYear("1917 2019", ""))
    }

    @Test
    fun `extractYear ignores title-only years`() {
        // "1917" is the title, not the year — no trailing year → falls to category
        assertEquals(2019, TmdbMatcher.extractYear("1917", "MOVIES 2019"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `extractYear falls back to category`() {
        assertEquals(2026, TmdbMatcher.extractYear("Some Movie", "ARABIC MOVIES 2026"))
    }

    // ─────────────────── jaroWinkler ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `jaroWinkler exact match returns 1`() {
        assertEquals(1.0, TmdbMatcher.jaroWinkler("hello", "hello"), 0.001)
    }

    @Test
    fun `jaroWinkler similar strings high score`() {
        assertTrue(TmdbMatcher.jaroWinkler("mission", "missions") > 0.9)
    }

    @Test
    fun `jaroWinkler unrelated strings low score`() {
        assertTrue(TmdbMatcher.jaroWinkler("lion", "transformer") < 0.5)
    }

    // ─────────────────── scoreMatch ───────────────────
    private fun result(
        title: String,
        orig: String = "",
        year: String = "",
        votes: Int = 0,
        pop: Double = 0.0,
    ) = TmdbSearchResult(
        id = 1,
        title = title,
        originalTitle = orig.ifBlank { title },
        releaseDate = if (year.isNotEmpty()) "$year-01-01" else "",
        voteCount = votes,
        popularity = pop,
    )

    @Test
    fun `scoreMatch exact title with matching year is strong`() {
        val variants = listOf("what women want")
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, 2000, result("What Women Want", year = "2000", votes = 5000))
        assertEquals(TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG, TmdbMatcher.acceptLevel(s))
    }

    @Test
    fun `scoreMatch exact title no year with votes is strong`() {
        val variants = listOf("captain marvel")
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, null, result("Captain Marvel", year = "2019", votes = 18000))
        assertEquals(TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG, TmdbMatcher.acceptLevel(s))
    }

    @Test
    fun `scoreMatch unrelated title is rejected`() {
        val variants = listOf("the town of ghosts")
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, null, result("The Town", year = "2010", votes = 5000))
        assertTrue(s.titleSim < 0.90)
    }

    @Test
    fun `scoreMatch arabic title with matches`() {
        val variants = TmdbMatcher.extractTitleVariants("جحيم فى الهند")
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, 2016, result("جحيم في الهند", year = "2016", votes = 100))
        assertEquals(TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG, TmdbMatcher.acceptLevel(s))
    }

    // ─────────────────── extractTitleVariants ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `extractTitleVariants splits dual language`() {
        val variants = TmdbMatcher.extractTitleVariants("الفيل الازرق - The Blue Elephant")
        assertTrue(variants.any { it.contains("الفيل") })
        assertTrue(variants.any { it.contains("blue", ignoreCase = true) })
    }

    @Test
    fun `extractTitleVariants single language returns one`() {
        val variants = TmdbMatcher.extractTitleVariants("Inception")
        assertEquals(1, variants.size)
    }

    // ─────────────────── generateQueries ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `generateQueries produces non-empty cascade`() {
        val (queries, variants) = TmdbMatcher.generateQueries("Inception", "MOVIES 2010", 2010)
        assertTrue(queries.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(variants.any { it.equals("inception", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(queries.any { it.year == 2010 })
    }

    @Test
    fun `generateQueries for dual-language title`() {
        val (queries, _) = TmdbMatcher.generateQueries(
            "الفيل الازرق - The Blue Elephant",
            "ARABIC MOVIES 2019",
            2019,
        )
        assertTrue(queries.any { it.q.contains("الفيل") })
        assertTrue(queries.any { it.q.contains("blue", ignoreCase = true) })
    }

    // ─────────────────── Real v5 samples ───────────────────
    @Test
    fun `v5 sample - What Women Want`() {
        val variants = TmdbMatcher.extractTitleVariants(
            TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("What Women Want [C]")
        )
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, null, result("What Women Want", year = "2000", votes = 5000))
        assertEquals(TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG, TmdbMatcher.acceptLevel(s))
    }

    @Test
    fun `v5 sample - The Transporter`() {
        val variants = TmdbMatcher.extractTitleVariants(
            TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("[SD] The Transporter")
        )
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, null, result("The Transporter", year = "2002", votes = 4000))
        assertEquals(TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG, TmdbMatcher.acceptLevel(s))
    }

    @Test
    fun `v5 sample - Curse of the Witchs Doll should reject La Llorona`() {
        val variants = TmdbMatcher.extractTitleVariants(
            TmdbMatcher.cleanIptv("Curse Of The Witchs Doll[SD]")
        )
        val s = TmdbMatcher.scoreMatch(variants, null, result("The Curse of La Llorona", year = "2019", votes = 2700))
        // Should be weak or reject — NOT strong
        assertTrue(TmdbMatcher.acceptLevel(s) != TmdbMatcher.Level.STRONG)
    }
}

package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.player

import androidx.media3.common.PlaybackException
import androidx.media3.datasource.DataSpec
import androidx.media3.datasource.HttpDataSource
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class PlayerHttpErrorTest {

    private fun dummyDataSpec(): DataSpec {
        val field = Class.forName("sun.misc.Unsafe").getDeclaredField("theUnsafe")
        field.isAccessible = true
        val unsafe = field.get(null)
        val allocate = unsafe.javaClass.getMethod("allocateInstance", Class::class.java)
        return allocate.invoke(unsafe, DataSpec::class.java) as DataSpec
    }

    @Test
    fun extractHttpResponseCode_findsNestedInvalidResponseCodeException() {
        val dataSpec = dummyDataSpec()
        val httpEx = HttpDataSource.InvalidResponseCodeException(
            403,
            "Forbidden",
            null,
            emptyMap(),
            dataSpec,
            ByteArray(0),
        )
        val wrapped = PlaybackException("Playback failed", httpEx, PlaybackException.ERROR_CODE_IO_BAD_HTTP_STATUS)
        assertEquals(403, extractHttpResponseCode(wrapped))
    }

    @Test
    fun extractHttpResponseCode_ignoresNumbersInsideUrlMessageWhenNotHttpStatusException() {
        val fakeException = RuntimeException("Failed opening https://cdn.example.com/movies/403.mp4")
        val wrapped = PlaybackException("Error", fakeException, PlaybackException.ERROR_CODE_IO_UNSPECIFIED)
        assertNull(extractHttpResponseCode(wrapped))
    }
}

=== FILE: app/src/test/java/com/saydlawy/sahab/ui/player/PlayerLeaseCoordinatorTest.kt ===
package com.saydlawy.sahab.ui.player

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class PlayerLeaseCoordinatorTest {

    private class FakeLeasedPlayer(
        override val role: PlayerRole,
        private val onReleaseCallback: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    ) : LeasedPlayerHandle {
        var releaseCount: Int = 0
            private set

        override fun stopAndRelease() {
            releaseCount++
            onReleaseCallback?.invoke()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun acquire_fullscreenPreemptsActivePreviewSynchronously() {
        val coordinator = PlayerLeaseCoordinator()
        val events = mutableListOf<String>()
        var previewRefCleared = false

        val preview = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.PREVIEW) {
            previewRefCleared = true
            events += "preview_released"
        }
        val fullscreen = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.FULLSCREEN) {
            events += "fullscreen_released"
        }

        coordinator.acquire(preview)
        assertTrue(coordinator.isActive(preview))
        assertEquals(PlayerRole.PREVIEW, coordinator.activeRole())

        coordinator.acquire(fullscreen)

        assertEquals(1, preview.releaseCount)
        assertTrue(previewRefCleared)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isActive(preview))
        assertTrue(coordinator.isActive(fullscreen))
        assertEquals(PlayerRole.FULLSCREEN, coordinator.activeRole())
        assertEquals(listOf("preview_released"), events)
    }

    @Test
    fun acquire_previewPreemptsLingeringFullscreenDuringBackTransition() {
        val coordinator = PlayerLeaseCoordinator()
        val fullscreen = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.FULLSCREEN)
        val preview = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.PREVIEW)

        coordinator.acquire(fullscreen)
        assertEquals(PlayerRole.FULLSCREEN, coordinator.activeRole())

        coordinator.acquire(preview)

        assertEquals(1, fullscreen.releaseCount)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isActive(fullscreen))
        assertTrue(coordinator.isActive(preview))
        assertEquals(PlayerRole.PREVIEW, coordinator.activeRole())
    }

    @Test
    fun releaseByRole_releasesPreviewOnDoubleOkWithoutAffectingFullscreen() {
        val coordinator = PlayerLeaseCoordinator()
        val preview = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.PREVIEW)
        coordinator.acquire(preview)

        // Simulates LiveScreen.playAt() releasing active preview before navigating to fullscreen
        coordinator.releaseByRole(PlayerRole.PREVIEW)
        assertEquals(1, preview.releaseCount)
        assertNull(coordinator.activeRole())

        val fullscreen = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.FULLSCREEN)
        coordinator.acquire(fullscreen)

        // Releasing PREVIEW role while FULLSCREEN is active must not touch fullscreen
        coordinator.releaseByRole(PlayerRole.PREVIEW)
        assertEquals(0, fullscreen.releaseCount)
        assertTrue(coordinator.isActive(fullscreen))
    }

    @Test
    fun release_isIdempotentAcrossExplicitExitAndOnDispose() {
        val coordinator = PlayerLeaseCoordinator()
        val fullscreen = FakeLeasedPlayer(PlayerRole.FULLSCREEN)
        coordinator.acquire(fullscreen)

        // First release in exitPlayerNow() on Back press
        coordinator.release(fullscreen)
        // Second release in DisposableEffect.onDispose after NavHost popExitTransition completes
        coordinator.release(fullscreen)

        assertEquals(1, fullscreen.releaseCount)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isActive(fullscreen))
        assertNull(coordinator.activeRole())
    }
}
